notes.title: Tanki Online turns 16!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/9c3953aa8ac01b89b2ef8bb2e332f91e330237e9.png[/img]

Tanki Online is turning 16, an impressive milestone! You're invited to celebrate this special day together with loyal friends and like-minded players!

A festive program awaits you in the game: the new «Parma Remastered» map, 4 special event modes, «Gold Rush», «Team Arms Race», «Hazelball», and the new mode «Sumo». There will be 50% discounts, a brand-new Striker XT HD skin, along with many other XT and DK series skins available in Epic Containers. Plus, a new Elite Pass with a Legendary Key and Salyut grenades as rewards, a festive garage, a cake-themed Gold Box, and special gifts for each one of you!

The event will last from May 30th, 2 AM UTC till June 27th, 2 AM UTC!

Read more details in the announcement section in the game!

notes.title: Grenades
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/7e7725e4fa4a9a88ad16765fa4bde98377501802.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2SPR8bV.gif[/img]

[h2]Grenades are released![/h2]

Grenades significantly increase the tactical abilities of a tank. The standard grenade is an ideal anti-camper weapon, a precise throw can send a grenade over a wall or any other obstacle that an enemy tank is hiding behind.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/JdoBJ0H.png[/img]

The main value of grenades is the variety of tactics available for manipulating your enemies. Yes, it is difficult to destroy an enemy with a grenade launcher, but tanks have turrets for that purpose! Pushing an enemy out of cover with a grenade so you can blast them with your turret? Now that’s a feeling that’s hard to beat.

[h3]How will this work?[/h3]

Grenades can be bought in the garage in the special [b]“Grenades”[/b] section.

Grenades will become available to be purchased at 2 AM UTC on September 9th.
Default grenades will be available for all players by default.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/axLxGgt.jpeg[/img]

You will be able to purchase them like supplies. Each throw of a Grenade consumes 1 unit of the Grenade supply.
Also grenades can be upgraded, they have modifications just like regular turrets.

[h3]How to use grenades in battle?[/h3]

1) Grenades are used by pressing the throw button. By default, it is the F key.

2) Throwing a grenade and dropping a flag can’t be bound to different keys. If you have both a grenade and a flag, the flag is always higher in priority. This is shown on a tank. When a flag is carried, the grenade is hidden and the button on the interface is changed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WrvetS1.jpeg[/img]

3) Grenades are only reloaded when the tank respawns. Also there is a cooldown timer after the throw, so if you respawn too soon after throwing a grenade, you will not get a new one.

Only one type of grenade can be used at once. To use a different type, the equipment change function should be used to change the grenade type in the garage.

[h3]Types of Grenades[/h3]

The following grenades will be in the game:
[table][tr][td][b]Bomb[/b]
A standard Grenade that damages enemies when exploding. The best choice for getting an opponent out of cover.[/td][td]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gr4TnP5.png[/img][/td][/tr][/table]

[table][tr][td]Smoke[/td][td]A specialized Grenade that blocks the field of view.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Zvezda[/td][td]A specialized Grenade that deals continuous damage in a small area.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Salyut[/td][td]A rocket with fireworks inside. Explodes above a tank.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Flare[/td][td]Microgrenades that deal no damage. Instead, they knock off the enemy’s aiming system. [/td][/tr][tr][td]Medic[/td][td]A specialized Grenade that repairs allied tanks, including your own.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Foam[/td][td]A specialized Grenade that forms an impenetrable foam barrier.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Magnet[/td][td]A specialized Grenade that adheres to tanks.[/td][/tr][/table]

[b]Important:[/b] With the first release, only the [b]Bomb[/b] grenade will appear in the game, others will be added later.

[h3]How to get grenades?[/h3]

[list]
[*]Buy them in the special “Grenades” section in the garage. [/*]
[*]Earn in missions[/*]
[/list]

This will be fun, we’re looking forward to see a lot of interesting tactics!tactics!

notes.title: Steam Deck
notes.content:
[h2]Currently, Steam Deck support for the game is available in experimental mode. You can play, but with a number of restrictions which we are already working to eliminate.[/h2]

To play Tanki Online via Steam Deck, you need to manually enable the «[b]Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper)[/b]» compatibility mode in the project settings on SteamOS.
Go to the game page on your Steam Deck and click on the gear icon on the right. This will open the settings window. In the "Compatibility" section, enable forced use of compatibility settings and select "Steam Linux Runtime 3.0 (sniper)".

Another important feature: controllers on your Steam Deck emulate keyboard and mouse control. This is an experimental control option. Support for analog control for gamepads will appear later.

notes.title: Ultra Weekend January 13th - 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/18bdf1941a9693b92925330ca5d01b67d11ee96f.png[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the upcoming Friday, Saturday, and Sunday will be ULTRA![/b][/h2]
 

Let’s dive into the list of activities planned for this weekend.

 
[h3][b]Special mode[/b][/h3]
 

[b]From 2 AM UTC on January 13th till 2 AM UTC on January 16th[/b]:

Special «Deathmatch» mode — All moving objects on the map are your potential targets. Victory depends only on your tank and skill!

[b]Mode settings:[/b]
[list][*]Mode: DM[/*][*]Maps: Courage PRO, Gubakha PRO and Subway PRO[/*][*]Turret: Any[/*][*]Hull: Any[/*][*]Bonus Boxes: ON[/*][*]Upgrades: ON[/*][*]Augments: ON[/*][*]Gold Boxes: ON[/*][*]Equipment Change: OFF[/*][*]Overdrives: OFF[/*][*]Supplies: ON[/*][*]Nuclear Energy: OFF[/*][*]Smart Supplies: ON[/*][*]Drones: ON[/*][*]Protection Modules: ON[/*][*]Groups: OFF[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Ultra Containers[/b][/h3]
 

The 71st batch of Ultra Containers will please all fans of the «Scorpion» turret. We present to your attention the following augment:
[list][*]Scorpion’s «EMP Rounds» augment[/*][/list]
As always, you can also get the famous «Crisis» drone, the «Armadillo» module, and other prizes obtainable from regular Containers;

 
[h3][b]Special missions[/b][/h3]
 

You can never have enough Ultra Containers. Complete the special missions to get them!

[b][u]IMPORTANT: Your progress towards completing missions is only counted starting from the moment you first entered the «Missions» screen after the event started.[/u][/b]
 
[list][*][b][u]Supermission: The best at everything![/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Task: Complete «Medallist», «Team Spirit», «Earner», «Destroyer», «The Punisher», «Armadillo», «Armageddon» and «Supplier» missions.[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Reward: 7 Ultra Containers and 3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/u][/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b][u]Mission: Battle Elite[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Task: Be in the winning team of 3 battles in any matchmaking battles. [/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]IMPORTANT: The mission is only available for «Premium Pass» owners.[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Reward: 3 Ultra Containers[/u][/b][/*][/list]
[list][*][b][u]Mission: Special Authorization[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Task: Finish 6 battles in any matchmaking battles. [/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]IMPORTANT: The mission is only available for «Battle Pass» owners.[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Reward: 2 Ultra Containers[/u][/b][/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Medallist[/*][*]Task: Get into the TOP-3 1 time in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Team Spirit[/*][*]Task: Be in the winning team of 3 battles in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Earner[/*][*]Task: Earn 4000 crystals in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Destroyer[/*][*]Task: Deal 30 critical shots in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: The Punisher[/*][*]Task: Earn 1000 battle points in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Armadillo[/*][*]Task: Use boosted armor 50 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Armageddon[/*][*]Task: Use overdrive 10 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Supplier[/*][*]Task: Make any purchase in the game’s Shop.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Special Bundles in the Shop[/b][/h3]
 

Got a keen eye for a great deal? Cool. We’ve created 2 special bundles that will set you ahead of the competition at a really affordable price. 


[b][u]Special «Gold reserve» offer[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/a650ccf6e66934b78e0078e56c60de235fd632df.png[/img]
[list][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]7 days of Premium Pass[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Special «200 Ultra Containers» offer[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/f248be7b5a9095dc5da6712c1b2bf0b229c5b74e.png[/img]
[list][*]200 Ultra Containers[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Megagold[/b][/h3]
 

During this event, a rare and unusual box will be falling from the sky — the Megagold!

It contains a whopping 10 000 crystals! Only the luckiest among you will manage to catch it though, as it falls much less often than a regular gold box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/c6405ce7deeadbdc8255faaf78ffb78e787f20a6.png[/img]
By the way, it is available in all matchmaking battles!

 
[h3][b]Boosted Funds and Experience[/b][/h3]
 

During the event, get boosted funds and experience for every matchmaking battle!

This is the perfect opportunity to rank up faster and get access to new items if you haven’t unlocked them all yet, or to just get more crystals to upgrade your Garage.

 
[h3][b]Themed Decorations[/b][/h3]
 

Throughout the 3 days of the event, we’ll have themed decorations in the game:
[list][*]Festive skin for cargo drones[/*][*]A special paint[/*][*]Festive gold box drop zone skin[/*][*]Special loading screen[/*][*]Changed billboards[/*][/list]
So get ready to jump into the fray for three days of blazing combat starting with the server restart on Friday, January 13th.

notes.title: Festive season in Tanki Online!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/c843e935ed56a8ee9d839be30b1fdc639f5469df.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]The long-awaited, most magical and most mysterious holidays of the year are approaching! [/b][/h2]
 

We hope that all your wishes will come true this festive season and that you will enjoy the next year even more.

The season’s rush has already started — shopping, decorating Christmas trees, preparing presents, and small but pleasant chores.

Tanki Online is also actively preparing for the celebration! With the servers’ restart on December 23rd, our festive activity program starts and will last until January 9th!

Let’s start with the most interesting part – discounts!


[h3][b]Discounts[/b][/h3]
 

After all, you not only need to prepare presents for others, but also to please yourself! Get the items you want for half the price!

All the discounts start and end at 2 AM UTC.

[list][*][b]December 23rd — December 24th[/b][/*][*]-50% off in the Shop. Includes Crystals, Gold Boxes, Kits, and Stars.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 24th — December 25th[/b][/*][*]-50% off turrets.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 25th — December 26th[/b][/*][*]-50% off hulls.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 26th — December 27th[/b][/*][*]-50% off drones.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 27th — December 28th[/b][/*][*]-50% off modules.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 28th — December 29th[/b][/*][*]-50% off augments.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 29th — December 30th[/b][/*][*]-50% off paints, supplies and batteries.[/*][/list]
[list][*][b]December 30th — January 1st[/b][/*][*]Upgrades. -50% off launch and speedups.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Special modes[/b][/h3]
 

Here they are, the special modes you have all been waiting for! All the special modes start and end at 2 AM UTC.

[b][u]December 23rd – December 26th[/u][/b]
There can be no winter festivities without a snowball fight! The special festive [b][u]«Snowballs»[/u][/b] mode returns on the «Sandbox Remastered» map with a new «Winter» theme on the first weekend.
[list][*]Mode: TDM[/*][*]Map: Sandbox REMASTERED (Winter)[/*][*]Turret: Snowman[/*][*]Hull: Any[/*][*]Bonus Boxes: OFF[/*][*]Upgrades: OFF[/*][*]Augments: OFF[/*][*]Gold Boxes: ON[/*][*]Equipment Change: OFF[/*][*]Overdrives: OFF[/*][*]Supplies: OFF[/*][*]Nuclear Energy: OFF[/*][*]Smart Supplies: ON[/*][*]Drones: OFF[/*][*]Protection Modules: OFF[/*][*]Groups: ON[/*][/list]

[b][u]December 30th – January 2nd[/u][/b]
It’s time to restock your crystals! The festive [b][u]«Gold rush»[/u][/b] mode on the «Forest Remastered» map with a new «Winter» theme and increased gold box rate will be awaiting you on the second weekend!
[list][*]Mode: DM[/*][*]Map: Forest REMASTERED (Winter)[/*][*]Turret: Any[/*][*]Hull: Any[/*][*]Bonus Boxes: ON[/*][*]Upgrades: ON[/*][*]Augments: ON[/*][*]Gold Boxes: ON[/*][*]Equipment Change: OFF[/*][*]Overdrives: ON[/*][*]Supplies: ON[/*][*]Nuclear Energy: ON[/*][*]Smart Supplies: ON[/*][*]Drones: ON[/*][*]Protection Modules: ON[/*][*]Groups: ON[/*][/list]

[b][u]January 6th – January 9th[/u][/b]
The festive [b][u]«Arms race»[/u][/b] mode. Where else can you show everyone who is the boss while destroying enemy tanks using every turret available in the game and knocking out the last victim with the destructive B0-NK?
[list][*]Mode: Arms Race[/*][*]Map: Deathtrack PRO (Winter)[/*][*]Turret: Changes Every 3 Kills[/*][*]Hull: Viking[/*][*]Bonus Boxes: ON[/*][*]Upgrades: OFF[/*][*]Augments: OFF[/*][*]Gold Boxes: ON[/*][*]Equipment Change: OFF[/*][*]Overdrives: OFF[/*][*]Supplies: OFF[/*][*]Nuclear Energy: OFF[/*][*]Smart Supplies: ON[/*][*]Drones: OFF[/*][*]Protection Modules: ON[/*][*]Groups: OFF[/*][/list]
 

[h3][b]Updated Ultra Containers[/b][/h3]
 

Everyone likes to open presents and experience the sense of anticipation. You always expect that you will get that one gift you have been waiting for. We hope that in Tanki Online you will also get the desired item out of the updated Ultra Containers!

And we have a surprise for you, the 70th batch of Ultra Continers will please all fans of the GT series skins and wheeled hulls! We present the following skins:

notes.title: Arcade
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/2ac675948b564d43ddf15a0e9c0d37ce2ba066ed.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]We are glad to introduce you a new interesting event![/b][/h2]
 

From 2 AM UTC November 21st, till 2 AM December 12th, we invite you to join our treasure hunt! Explore the map of the mysterious island together with your team. Go in search of treasure and dig up valuable rewards!

Let’s get into details.

 
[h3][b]How to take part[/b][/h3]
 

The search begins at 2 AM on November 21st. To take part in the special «Arcade» event, you need to purchase a ticket in the form of the special [b]«[/b][b]Press Start[/b][b]» [/b]offer, that includes paints of all 4 factions:
[list][*][b]Plasma[/b][/*][*][b]Crimson[/b][/*][*][b]Lazurite[/b][/*][*][b]Citrus[/b][/*][/list]
 
[b]Important: All 4 paints will remain on your account no matter what faction you join. The paint you equip does not affect the stars you earn.[/b]

Right after purchasing this special «Ticket», you will be added to one of factions. Together with your teammates you can start looking for treasure! The «Ticket» will be available for purchase until December 12th at 2 AM UTC.

Based on experience with previous events, players will get disappointed after seeing that they have been added to a losing faction. So this time we included an option to change your team.

To change your faction you need to purchase the special [b]«Change character»[/b] offer, that includes:
[list][*]Changing player’s faction[/*][*]30 000 crystals[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Event rules[/b][/h3]
 

Each faction has its own token that will be used for moving around cells of the game board to look for treasure chests.

With the start of the event, you will be able to access the special «Arcade» event [b][url=https://arcade.tankionline.com/?lang=en]website[/url][/b]. There you will find a map of the treasure island on which you will vote where to move your team’s token next at each turn in search of treasure.

The event’s time is limited, and it can also end earlier if the right conditions are met.

[list][*]If players do not find all the treasure chests till the end of the event, the prizes that they did not find will be forfeited.[/*][*]If players find all the treasures before the end of the event, the game will be finished prematurely.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Treasure map[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/39f01545419b21240a0cb77f9fbb75b3f0146cbf.jpg[/img]
 

The map consists of multiple cells, and you can move around them without any special restrictions.

The map is completely covered with fog, but areas visited will be cleared so that a faction does not get lost and can know which cells they have already explored.

Each faction has its own token to move around the map with. 


[h3][b]Votes[/b][/h3]

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/33129f7a9a30d6c0b687d245e4e1744d5af66297.jpg[/img]
 

Each turn, players vote on where to move their faction’s token to.
[list][*]To vote you need to earn at least 3 stars during a current turn.[/*][*]You can only vote for cells that are around the one where your faction’s token is now. It does not matter if the cell has already been explored previously by any faction, is occupied by another faction, or will be occupied by another faction in the next round.[/*][*]You cannot change your vote.[/*][*]For each 3 stars earned during a current turn you get 1 vote. [/*][*]The more stars you earn during a current turn, the more significant your influence will be during the voting.[/*][*]Only earned stars are counted (including bonus stars from Premium). Stars purchased from the Shop or received from missions are not counted.[/*][*]One turn takes 23 hours 45 minutes (from 07:00 UTC of a current day till 06:45 UTC of the next one).[/*][*]The token will be moved to the cell that has received the most votes.[/*][/list]

[b]Important: If multiple cells tie for the most votes, the move will be chosen at random.[/b]

 
[h3][b]Fog[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/b50d10ce768056fd35f5639d3bd431b4c24fbc7c.jpg[/img]
 

Before starting the next turn, a faction’s token is moved and the fog around the next cell clears:

 
[list][*]The fog opens new cells only for your team.[/*][*]You won’t be able to see how it is going for other factions, but you can spy on them.[/*][/list]
 

[h3][b]Team fight for treasure[/b][/h3]
 

If multiple factions decided to go to the same cell:
[list][*]The faction with the highest number of stars earned captures the cell.[/*][*]Other factions stay on their current cells.[/*][*]If the number of stars earned for all factions fighting for the cell is the same, all of them stay on their current cells.[/*][/list]
 

If a faction stays on a cell, and another team votes to move to this cell:
[list][*]The faction standing on the cell will be defending, with the number of stars they have earned as their defending power.[/*][*]The faction that is moving to the cell will be attacking, with the number of stars they have earned as their attacking power.[/*][*]The faction whose power is greater wins:[list][*]Should the defending faction win:[list][*]The attacking faction stays on its current cell and likewise for the defending faction.[/*][/list][/*][*]Should the attacking faction win:[list][*]The two factions switch places.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]
 

If a faction opts to stay on a cell, and multiple factions vote to move to this cell:
[list][*]If the defending faction has less power than the attacking faction with the most power, the defending faction and the attacking faction with the most power switch places.[/*][/list]
 

If factions vote to move to cells of each other:
[list][*]The factions switch places.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Metal Detector[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/e06696feb3bdcd639b0076ebb1d9c8c05bf49191.png[/img]
 

All experienced treasure hunters use this tool to find treasures as quickly as possible.

Many of you know the «Hot or Cold» game. Our Metal Detector works in a similar way.

During a turn (and while players vote where to move), players can scan cells closest to their token with a metal detector.

Once turn is done, Metal Detector shows how close you are to a nearest treasure chest:
[list][*]If a faction’s token stands on a cell that has a treasure chest, the Metal Detector will indicate  — «Very hot».[/*][*]If a faction’s token stands on a cell that is adjacent to a cell with a treasure chest, the Metal Detector will indicate — «Hot».[/*][*]If a faction’s token stands on a cell that is 1 cell away from a cell with a treasure chest, the Metal Detector will indicate — «Warm».[/*][*]If a faction’s token stands on a cell that is 2 cells away from a cell with a treasure chest, the Metal Detector will indicate — «Cold».[/*][/list]


You can scan a cell using tankoins. The total cost of scanning one cell is 2000 tankoins per faction. The minimum payment from a player to fund the scan is 10 tankoins.

Tankoins spent are summed up, and the scan starts as soon as the crowdfunding collects the required amount.

 
[h3][b]Treasures[/b][/h3]
 

Well, now let’s talk about the most important thing, the goal of the event — treasures!

Factions need to find treasure chests which are hidden in special cells of the map.


[h3][b]Getting treasures[/b][/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/32d0f50f844642df947030577002a68b633c99ae.png[/img]
 
[list][*]Once a faction finds a cell with a treasure chest, it needs to spend a turn to dig it up. Voting becomes unavailable and the token is not moved during this turn.[/*][*]To get the treasure, the faction needs to defend this cell and stay on it till the next turn.[/*][*]If another faction captures the cell, the defending faction will not get the treasure, and the attacking faction will automatically start digging.[/*][/list]
 

Here are the rewards you can get from the treasure chests:
[list][*]100 Gold boxes[/*][*]1000 Tankoins[/*][*]1000 units of the «Boosted Armour» supply[/*][*]1000 units of the «Boosted Damage» supply[/*][*]1000 units of the «Speed Boost» supply[/*][*]1000 units of the «Mine» supply[/*][*]1000 units of the «Repair Kit» supply[/*][*]Thunder’s  «Nanotech» shells» augment[/*][*]Scorpion’s «Missile launcher «Tornado» augment[/*][*]Scorpion’s «Missile launcher «Javelin» augment[/*][*]Scorpion’s «Pulsar» augment[/*][*]«Crisis» drone[/*][*]«Armadillo» module[/*][/list]
 
Once the event is over, we will open the treasure chests your faction received and will deliver the rewards.


[h3][b]Faction chat channels[/b][/h3]
 

To make it easier to communicate with teammates, we will add chat channels in the Lobby. Each faction gets its own channel. Only the faction’s members can see it.In these chats you can discuss your tactics, share leaks of other factions’ progress, and discuss your next movements.


Good luck with your search, our dear tankers!

notes.title: eSports Tanki Fund
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/fce83cd8b5c47dabbc9a279c273abbe3355b7e29.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]We continue to tell you about eSports in Tanki Online. The Winter Major 2022 tournament is in full swing and its participants are fighting for real cash prizes.[/b][/h2]
 

On Monday, November 14th, we will find out which 16 teams proceed to the next stage where they will be fighting for the 8 places in the final stage where the fate of the real cash prize of 380,000 Russian rubles, unique prize paints, and modules offering 20-30%  protection from all turrets will be determined!

In honor of this tournament, we have prepared a themed «Tanki Fund» event for you! This time, there are 20 levels of rewards!

 
[h3][b]What is Tanki Fund?[/b][/h3]
 

The [url=https://pages.tankionline.com/winter-major?lang=en]«Tanki Fund»[/url] is a prize pool of Tankoins. Every themed special offer purchased will contribute towards the size of the fund. After the end of the event, we will be giving away portions of this fund among randomly selected participants of the event.

The distribution of eSports Tanki Fund will be a bit different from the norm. We will share 10% of the fund among the top 8 teams of the tournament and will divide the remaining 90% in equal parts among the winners of the giveaway*. 

There are two ways to receive prizes in this event:

[olist][*]Draw — From among those who have bought the special offers, a certain number of winners will be selected in a draw to receive equal shares of the Tanki Fund.[/*][*]Additional bonuses — All players who have bought at least one of the special offers will receive additional bonuses depending on the size of the Tanki Fund.[/*][/olist]
 
[b]The Tanki Fund will officially begin on November 15th 02:00 UTC and last until December 18th 17:00 UTC.[/b]

 
[h3][b]How to take part?[/b][/h3]
 

During this period, you will be able to purchase 3 special offers in the Shop. Purchasing any of the special offers — even the cheapest one — will grant you participation in the Tanki Fund.

[b]Special [/b]«[b]Livestream lover[/b]» [b]offer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/fd4c6346439554882bc1ecb25251041b89a84aa0.png[/img]
Upon purchasing this offer, 1000 Tankoins will be added to the pool.

[b]Special [/b]«[b]Devoted fan[/b]» [b]offer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/ff3032d13811f625428f34255d613fdb4f09b006.png[/img]
Upon purchasing this offer, 3000 Tankoins will be added to the pool.
[list][*]45 Ultra Containers[/*][*]130 000 crystals[/*][*]8 fan paints[/*][/list]

[b]Special [/b]«[b]Sports patron[/b]» [b]offer[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/347758b1ca7a2b65c5f1159b5664e546a3973dc5.png[/img]
Upon purchasing this offer, 8000 Tankoins will be added to the pool. 
[list][*]150 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear energy» supply[/*][*]Shot effect «Fire» for Isida[/*][*]Shot effect «Magma» for Hammer[/*][*]Shot effect «Gold» for Twins[/*][*]Shot effect «Magma» for Ricochet[/*][*]Shot effect «Gold» for Railgun[/*][*]Shot effect «Magma» for Shaft[/*][/list]
 

Each special offer can be purchased only once, except the special «Devoted fan» offer, which can be purchased multiple times. The more offers you purchase, the higher your chances of winning a share of Tanki Fund will be!

 
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 

All prizes, tankoins, and additional rewards will be added to the accounts after the end of the tournament and after the giveaway livestream, on December 21st.

With every 8000 Tankoins added to the fund, we will add 1 winner to the giveaway. All winners receive equal shares of the Tanki Fund, and some of you will be able to become a real Tankoin tycoon in an instant.

*Winners of the giveaway are players randomly chosen among those who bought the themed special offers. We will choose participants live on the stream, which will happen on December 21st. The number of winners depends on the number of special offers purchased.

You can observe the growth of the fund and the number of winners for the giveaway on the special website. The fund will begin to grow only after the first purchase. So far, there are 0 Tankoins in the prize pool.

 
[h3][b]Additional bonuses[/b][/h3]
 

All players who bought at least one of the themed special offers will receive additional bonuses depending on the size of the Tanki Fund. For every million tankoins added to the prize pool, the fund will upgrade to a new level.

[list][*][b]Level 1:[/b] +1 unit of the «Nuclear energy» supply[/*][*][b]Level 2:[/b] +15 Regular Containers[/*][*][b]Level 3:[/b] +15 Regular Containers[/*][*][b]Level 4:[/b] +1 additional module slot[/*][*][b]Level 5:[/b] +15 Ultra Containers[/*][*][b]Level 6:[/b] +15 Ultra Containers[/*][*][b]Level 7:[/b] +1 Skin Container[/*][*][b]Level 8:[/b] Striker’s «Stunning missiles» augment[/*][*][b]Level 9:[/b] Railgun’s «Jamming shells» augment[/*][*][b]Level 10:[/b] Isida’s «Vampire nanobots» augment[/*][*][b]Level 11:[/b] Smoky’s «Jamming rounds» augment[/*][*][b]Level 12:[/b] Smoky’s «Pulsar» augment[/*][*][b]Level 13:[/b] Twins’ «Blaster» shot effect[/*][*][b]Level 14:[/b] Scorpion’s «Uranium shells» augment[/*][*][b]Level 15:[/b] +1 Skin-container[/*][*][b]Level 16:[/b] Twins’ «Pulsar» augment[/*][*][b]Level 17:[/b] «Crisis» drone[/*][*][b]Level 18:[/b] «Armadillo» module[/*][*][b]Level 19:[/b] Thunder’s «Adaptive reload» augment[/*][*][b]Level 20:[/b] Tesla’s «Legacy» skin[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Match livestreams[/b][/h3]


In order to get a sense of this intense eSports event’s atmosphere, watch the eSports livestreams on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/team/tankionline]our Twitch channels[/url].

Let us remind you that on each livestream you can get a [url=https://tankionline.com/en/2022/10/twitch-drops/]Twitch Drop[/url] containing 1 Ultra Container for 20 minutes of watching!

Livestreams start at 17:00 and 18:00 UTC. You can follow the dates of the matches on [url=https://tankisport.com/tournament/775]the esports website[/url].

 

The event is held by APL Publishing Ltd. online on [url=https://pages.tankionline.com/winter-major?lang=en]the site[/url], in accordance with the General Rules for Promotions and Contests ([url=https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/]https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/[/url]).

Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]The Spirits have heard you![/b][/h2]
 

[b][u]Unfortunately, this year they are not able to bring you the festive decorations you have asked for, and they won’t replace megagolds with pumpkin goldboxes. However they’ve definitely prepared something that is sure to please you![/u][/b]


We will have two Deathmatch modes, three themed maps, even more Ultra Containers, and discounts!


[h3][b]Discounts[/b][/h3]
 

Save big on your purchases! Discounts are back starting from the 11th of November and ending on the 14th. Each offer starts and ends with the server restart at 02:00 UTC.

[b]Friday:[/b]

[list][*]30% sale in the Garage — applies to hulls, turrets, modules, augments, drones, supplies (including batteries), and paints[/*][/list]
[b]Sunday:[/b]

[b][u]Here they are – the fun-filled holiday modes you begged for![/u][/b]

[list][*]From 02:00 UTC on November 11th until 02:00 UTC on November 14th[/*][*]From 02:00 UTC on November 18th until 02:00 UTC on November 21st[/*][/list]
 
You will be able to reach new ranks faster and earn more crystals for each completed battle.


[h3][b]Megagold[/b][/h3]
 

During this event, Megagold will be falling from the sky!

[b][u]Yes, it may not be a pumpkin goldbox, but it contains a whopping 10 000 crystals![/u][/b] Only the luckiest among you will manage to catch it though, as it falls much less frequently than a regular gold box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/c6405ce7deeadbdc8255faaf78ffb78e787f20a6.png[/img]
By the way, it can fall in all matchmaking battles!

 
[h3][b]Themed Decorations[/b][/h3]
 

[b][u]We decided to forgo upping the festive atmosphere with decorated bushes and other cosmetics, but there are reasons for this. At the moment, we are constantly working on updating the battle interface and the design of multiple sections of the Lobby, not to mention preparing new Remastered maps. Follow our social media pages to be the first to know which map will be remastered next![/u][/b]


Nevertheless, we still prepared some themed designs for you. To add some atmosphere and festive spirit, the following decorations will be available in all battles:

[list][*]Festive paint[/*][*]Festive billboards[/*][*]Festive skin for cargo drones[/*][*]Festive markers for gold box drop zones [/*][/list]

Have a good mood and stay positive!

notes.title: The «Trick-or-Treat» mini-game
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/39c5c3e424c14eae24fd355a2355587a4bbf4190.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]The «Trick-or-Treat» mini-game has already become a Halloween tradition. Have you been waiting for it? [/b][/h2]
 

On October 28th, we invite you to take part in our dangerous journey to search for valuable prizes!

With the server restart on Friday, from October 28th 2 AM UTC, the «Trick-or-Treat» mini-game starts on [url=https://halloween.tankionline.com/]the special website[/url]. You will have time to conquer all the demonic islands in the afterlife and to grab all the prizes till November 24th, 2 AM UTC!

To get your tank move between mysterious islands, your tank will need fuel — [b]lollipops.[/b]

 
[h3][b]Lollipops[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/cfa86c52eb28eebe812d3a90558bee754e72de89.png[/img]
They are the special event currency. You can track the number of your lollipop reserves in the interface of the mini-game.

Here are the ways you can get lollipops:
[list][*]Complete a daily mission — 4 lollipops[/*][*]Complete a special event mission — 40 lollipops[/*][*]Catch a lollipop goldbox — 1 lollipop[/*][*]Purchase Halloween special offers, packs of Premium Pass, and tankoins[/*][/list]

[b]Important: [/b]The «Trick-or-Treat» mini-game’s website is only available on PC; You still can earn lollipops by playing the mobile version of the game, but to enter the website you will need a PC.


[h3][b]How to start[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/2c6bae42c2a16c1537aeb01489195d5aa2342188.jpg[/img]
 

To start your journey, you need to log in to [url=https://halloween.tankionline.com/]the mini-game website[/url], using the nickname and the password of your in-game account.

If you use Facebook to log in to your account, you will need to [url=https://tankionline.com/forms/free/en/]contact our customer service[/url] to get a password for your account to enter the website.

 
[h3][b]Islands[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/a2058c6ef8335849ae5322ac9e715de218bf9e4d.jpg[/img]
 

The mini-game map consists of islands and on each of them either a trick or treat awaits you. 

Let’s start with treats — crystals, tankoins, containers and batteries. When you visit an island, a treat is sent to a special storage at the Checkpoint, and is not immediately credited to your in-game account.


When your launch engines of your tank, [b]10 lollipops[/b] are consumed and they may be enough to move one, two or three islands forward.


And now let’s talk about tricks — there will be special «Islands of Fortune» on your way. By entering them, you can move either forward, or go 5 islands back. Within the same lap, each trap can only work once, so if you hit an «Island of Fortune» and are pushed back, this one «Island of Fortune» will not push you back in this lap again.

Don’t worry, even if luck is not on your side and you get pushed back, you can receive a reward for each island that you pass twice on your way forwards.


[h3][b]Checkpoints[/b][/h3]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/7066f67e551a2af19bd38d7e9b04b6987282b92a.jpg[/img]


After passing the whole lap, a player gets to the checkpoint – the main island. There is a special vault on it to store all the prizes that the player received on these islands. When visiting a main island, the player can transfer the prizes from the vault to their in-game account.

Moreover, whenever you visit a checkpoint, we add more unique rewards to your vault.

A player starts their journey from the 1st checkpoint. The mini-game ends after 5 laps — when you reach the 6th checkpoint.


[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 

«Demonic» skins for Hammer and Viking and the themed «Horror» paint!   

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/4263fbaa92990317c7172de2da28086e8a2cafc2.png[/img]
 
[b]Checkpoint №1[/b]
[list][*]The themed «Horror» paint[/*][/list]
[b]Checkpoint №2[/b]
[list][*]Units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]Additional protection module slot[/*][*]«Jamming Shot» augment for Hammer[/*][/list]
[b]Checkpoint №3[/b]
[list][*]«Legacy» skin for Smoky[/*][*]«Legacy» skin for Wasp[/*][*]«Blunderbuss» augment for Hammer[/*][/list]
[b]Checkpoint №4[/b]
[list][*]«Crisis» drone[/*][*]«Pulsar» augment for Hammer[/*][/list]
[b]Checkpoint №5[/b]
[list][*]«Demonic» skin for Viking[/*][*]«Armadillo» module[/*][/list]
[b]Checkpoint №6[/b]
[list][*]«Demonic» skin for Hammer[/*][/list]

[h3][b]Special missions with lollipops[/b][/h3]
 

Want to get more lollipops? Complete these special missions!


[list][*][b]Mission: Devourer of Souls[/b][/*][*]Task: Get into the TOP-3 9 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 7 containers and 40 lollipops[/*][/list]

notes.title: Winter Major Rankings I
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/e9bb766dcac4d70aa304f3980e6f43554ebe7386.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]Summer Major 2022 is finished so we are ready to announce the first ranking tournament of the Winter season![/b][/h2]
 

If you’re still unsure whether to participate in tournaments or not, then now is the time to decide! After all, as we said earlier, the eSport format is designed to simplify participation in eSports, which means that everyone has a chance to compete for impressive in-game rewards and even for real cash rewards. 

Who knows, perhaps it will be you and your team that will achieve the highest results.

We also want to remind you that in order to simplify the search for players and teams, we have updated our [url=https://tankisport.com/finder]eSports website[/url] and added a special section in which teams search for players, and players search for teams.

 
[h3][b]Tournament rules[/b][/h3]
 
[list][*]Ranks: Sergeant — Legend[/*][*]The team consists of 7 players.[/*][*]In battle – 5 tankers from each team.[/*][*]Your garage doesn’t matter as battles are played in Sport mode.[/*][*]On the battlefield, in each team, hulls and turrets should not be repeated. For example, if you use Hornet and Ricochet, no one else from your team should be in the battle with Ricochet or Hornet.   [/*][*]More detailed rules can be found on the tournament page on the eSports portal.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 
[list][*]Invitation to the Major tournament with cash prizes[/*][*]Unique «Impulse» paint[/*][*]96,000 Tankoins[/*][*]88,000,000 crystals[/*][*]4,375 containers[/*][*]And 1,071 days of «Premium Pass»[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Tournament dates[/b][/h3]
 
[list][*]Tournament registration will last from 13:00 UTC on August 10th till 09:00 UTC on August 22nd.[/*][*]The first match will start on August 22nd.[/*][*]The tournament will end before September 20th.[/*][/list]
 

The tournament will be attended by 32 to 128 teams. You can apply [url=https://tankisport.com/tournament/769]here[/url]. 

 

Almost immediately after the first rating tournament, we will announce the second one and after the two rating tournaments there will be a Major one. In the Major tournament, they will fight not only for in-game rewards, but also for real cash.

Go to the [url=https://tankisport.com/tournament/769]eSports portal[/url], create your team, read the rules, register and get ready for the second rating tournament! And if you have any questions, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/tankisport]eSports Discord server[/url], they will definitely help you.

 

See you on the battlefields and eSports broadcasts!

notes.title: eSports Tanki Fund
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/75bcbb5b68b3ed0c474cad7c83a0cc52d2edbda2.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]eSports in the game is developing — nowadays the participants of the «Summer Major 2022» tournament are fighting for real cash prizes.[/b][/h2]
 

After a few weeks of tough competition, only 16 teams are left to take part in the «Legends» stage:

 
[list][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/8779]Team Pointers[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/11657]Black Mirror[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/12857]Toxic[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/13037]Feechki[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/13683]The Dreamers[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/13988]Team Sincerity[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14022]Knockout[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14049]Horizon[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14105]Despite[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14110]Gold edition[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14159]ATB[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14251]Death Sight[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14290]Diamonds[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14423]6AM[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14434]VTB[/url][/*][*][url=https://tankisport.com/teams/14576]Red Notice[/url][/*][/list]
 

These teams will be fighting for the 8 places in the final stage where the fate of the real cash prize of 380,000 Russian rubles, unique prize paints, and modules with 20-30%  protection from all turrets (Including the brand-new Scorpion) will be determined!

In honor of this tournament, we have prepared a themed «Tanki Fund» event!

 
[h3][b]What is Tanki Fund?[/b][/h3]
 

[url=https://tankionline.com/pages/summer-major/?lang=en]«Tanki Fund»[/url] is a fund or a pool of tankoins. Every themed special offer purchased will contribute towards the size of the fund. After the end of the event, we will be giving away this fund among the participants of the event.

Rules of eSports Tanki Fund are a bit different: We will share 10% of the fund among the top  8 teams of the tournament, and 90% of the Tanki fund will be divided in equal parts among the winners of the giveaway*. 

 

There are two ways to receive prizes in this event:

 
[olist][*]Draw — Among those who have bought the special offers, a certain number of winners will be selected in a draw to receive equal shares of the Tanki Fund.[/*][*]Additional bonuses — All players who have bought at least one of the special offers will receive additional bonuses depending on the size of the Tanki Fund.[/*][/olist]
 

[b]The Tanki Fund will officially begin on July 4th 02:00 UTC and last until August 7th 17:00 UTC.[/b]

 
[h3][b]How to take part?[/b][/h3]
 

During this period, you will be able to purchase 3 special offers in the Shop. Purchasing any of the special offer, even the cheapest one, will grant you access to participate in the Tanki Fund.

 

[u][b]Special [/b]«[b]Doping[/b]» [b]offer[/b][/u]

Upon purchasing this offer, 1000 tankoins will be added to the pool. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/57e9f1ca9f366d2a4251d52fe16ffffd97ec7386.png[/img]
[list][*]1 unit of the «Nuclear energy» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Repair kit» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Boosted damage» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Boosted  armor» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Speed boost» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Mine» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Battery» supply[/*][/list]
 

[u][b]Special [/b]«[b]Fan’s bundle[/b]» [b]offer[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/7bce72ccb7d30b5871bdab2f0e2cfd4de0f471bb.png[/img]
Upon purchasing this offer, 3000 tankoins will be added to the pool. 

[list][*]50 Ultra Containers[/*][*]240 000 crystals[/*][*]8 fan paints[/*][/list]
 

[u][b]Special [/b]«[b]Green light[/b]» [b]offer[/b][/u]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/60016acead2bee2630fcb33fbf4ae546c247cb76.png[/img]
Upon purchasing this offer, 8000 tankoins will be added to the pool. 

[list][*]150 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear energy» supply[/*][*]Shot effect «Toxic» for Freeze[/*][*]Shot effect «Toxic» for Hammer[/*][*]Shot effect «Toxic» for Ricochet[/*][*]Shot effect «Toxic» for Striker[/*][*]Shot effect «Green» for Railgun[/*][*]Shot effect «Toxic» for Magnum[/*][*]Shot effect «Green» for Shaft[/*][/list]
 

Each special offer can be purchased only once, except the special «Fan’s bundle» offer, which can be purchased multiple times. The more offers you purchase, the higher are your chances to win a share of Tanki Fund!

 
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 

[b]All prizes, tankoins, and additional rewards will be added to the accounts after the end of the tournament and after the giveaway livestream, on August 10th.[/b]

 

With every 8000 Tankoins added to the fund, we will add 1 winner to the giveaway. All winners receive equal shares of the Tanki Fund, and some of you will be able to become a real Tankoin tycoon in an instant.

*Winners of the giveaway are players randomly chosen among those who bought the themed special offers. We will choose participants live on the stream, which will happen on August 10th. The number of winners depends on the number of special offers purchased.

You can observe the growth of the fund and the number of winners in the giveaway on [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/summer-major/?lang=en]the special website[/url]. The fund will begin to grow only after the first purchase. So far, there are 0 Tankoins.

 
[h3][b]Additional bonuses[/b][/h3]
 

All players who bought at least one of the special offers will receive additional bonuses depending on the size of the Tanki Fund. For every million tankoins added to the prize pool, the fund will upgrade to a new level.

 
[list][*][b]Level 1:[/b] +1 unit of the «Nuclear energy» supply[/*][*][b]Level 2:[/b] +15 Regular Containers[/*][*][b]Level 3:[/b] +15 Regular Containers[/*][*][b]Level 4:[/b] +1 additional module slot[/*][*][b]Level 5:[/b] +15 Ultra Containers[/*][*][b]Level 6:[/b] +15 Ultra Containers[/*][*][b]Level 7:[/b] +1 Skin-container[/*][*][b]Level 8:[/b] Hammer’s «Magnetic Pellets» augment[/*][*][b]Level 9:[/b] Ricochet’s «Helios» augment[/*][*][b]Level 10:[/b] Hammer’s «Legacy» skin[/*][*][b]Level 11:[/b] Thunder’s «Vacuum shell» augment[/*][*][b]Level 12:[/b] Scorpion’s «Missile Launcher «Swarm» augment[/*][*][b]Level 13:[/b] Tesla’s «Pulsar» augment[/*][*][b]Level 14:[/b] «Armadillo» module[/*][*][b]Level 15:[/b] «Crisis» drone[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Match livestreams[/b][/h3]
 

In order to get a sense of this intense eSports event’s atmosphere, watch the eSports livestreams on our new Twitch channel starting from July 8th at 17 and 18 UTC. Do not forget to follow it. 

Let us remind you that on each of the livestreams, we will be giving out a promo code which every viewer can trade in for 1 Ultra Container!

 

The event is held by APL Publishing Ltd. online on [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/summer-major/?lang=en]the site[/url], in accordance with the General Rules for Promotions and Contests([url=https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/]https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/[/url]).

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/8e79c6d81905ecee2bab9219236aa401f21befb8.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]Great news: the super novelty is in Early access already this Friday![/b][/h2]
 

Meet the new turret — «Scorpion». 

We have already talked about Scorpion in [url=https://tankionline.com/en/2022/06/new-turret-scorpion/]the separate announcement[/url], and many of you have already tried it in the «Arms race» mode battles.

 
[h3][b]How to get it?[/b][/h3]
 

Do you want to be the first to check out the new turret?

During the Early Access period, which will last for the whole summer, Scorpion will only be obtainable from Ultra Containers. Complete special missions or check out the Shop offers to get the updated Ultra Containers.

 
[h3][b]Module[/b][/h3]
 

Once the turret is in the Early access stage, we will also add the corresponding «Vulture» protection module. You will be able to buy this protection against the new turret with crystals in the Garage.

 
[h3][b]Augments[/b][/h3]
 

Do you want to have alternative ways of launching rockets (e.g. horizontally)? Soon we will add augments for the new turret that change the way it works, and you can find the best setup for yourself.

We will let you know about the augments which will be released and the ways to get them in the patch notes.

Lucky owners of the Scorpion turret, share your screenshots in the comments!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/6e2c221049f4c7a62f5e6b1530490942ecc0b905.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]On June 4th, «Tanki Online» turns 13 years old! [/b][/h2]
 

Thank you for staying with us and supporting us for so many years! We promise to continue developing the game. In honor of this milestone, we have prepared a lot of interesting activities for the next few weeks!

[b]We are announcing a special holiday event![/b]

From [b]02:00 UTC on May 27 to 02:00 UTC on June 13[/b], enjoy festive decorations, Gold Boxes, special missions, boosted funds and experience, Coinboxes, updated Ultra Containers, holiday special modes, discounts, special offers, and much more!

Here’s everything in order:

 
[h3][b]Discounts[/b][/h3]
 

We’re going to the greatest extent to celebrate – [b]50% discounts [/b]in both the Shop and the Garage.

 
[list][*][b]02:00 UTC on May 27[/b] — [b]02:00 UTC on May 28[/b]:
We kick off Tanki Online’s birthday celebrations with a 50% discount on Crystals, Gold Boxes, Kits, Stars, Containers, and Ultra Containers.[/*][*][b]02:00 UTC on May 28[/b] — [b]02:00 UTC on May 29[/b]:
Next, discounts in the garage on Turrets, Hulls, Modules, Augments, Drones, Supplies, and Paints.[/*][*][b]02:00 UTC on May 29 [/b]— [b]02:00 UTC on May 30[/b]:
And last but certainly not least, you will find 50% discounts on Upgrades and their Speedups.[/*][/list]

[list][*]From 02:00 UTC on May 27th until 02:00 UTC on May 30th[/*][*]From 02:00 UTC on June 3rd until 02:00 UTC on June 6th[/*][*]From 02:00 UTC on June 10th until 02:00 UTC on June 13th[/*][/list]
 

You will reach new ranks faster and earn more crystals for each completed battle.

 
[h3][b]Special Gold Box[/b][/h3]
 

In honor of the game’s birthday, throughout the holiday event, we will add a special Gold Box with a face value of 13,000 Crystals! This wondrous Gold Box will go only to the luckiest and most agile as it will drop with utmost irregularity.

Keep an eye out for it in battles!

 
[h3][b]Holiday modes[/b][/h3]
 

This holiday promises both a hot and interesting experience! We have prepared 3 brand new holiday modes for you – one for each weekend.

notes.title: Ultra Weekend May 20th - 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/c0fc8feb970f759ce764dcf1fdfb120d3012731a.jpg[/img]


[list][*]Event: Ultra Weekend May 20th – 22nd[/*][*]Duration: 3 days[/*][*]Starts: Friday, May 20th[/*][*]Ends: Monday, May 23rd[/*][/list]
 
Important note: Unless otherwise stated, all events and activities start and end with the server restart at 02:00 UTC.

Tankers!


[h2]We are happy to announce that the upcoming Friday, Saturday, and Sunday will be ULTRA![/h2]
 

There will be a special mode, special missions, boosted funds and experience, Ultra Containers, 2 valuable special offers, and a themed design.

This Ultra Weekend will start on Friday, May 20th, at 2:00 UTC, and will last until Monday, May 23rd, at 2:00 UTC. 

 
[h3][b]Special mode[/b][/h3]
 

From Friday, May 20th 02:00 UTC till Monday, May 23rd 02:00 UTC play in the special «Goldhunters» mode.

Everyone’s favorite Deathmatch mode is back! Along with the awaited return comes a sharp increase in the drop rate of gold boxes!

Special Event Parameters:
[list][*]Battle Mode: DM[/*][*]Maps: Sandbox, Skylark, and Dusseldorf[/*][*]Turret: Any[/*][*]Hull: Any[/*][*]Bonus boxes: ON[/*][*]Micro-upgrades: ON[/*][*]Augments: ON[/*][*]Overdrives: ON[/*][*]Drones: ON[/*][*]Modules: ON[/*][*]Supplies: ON[/*][*]MM Groups: ON[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Ultra containers[/b][/h3]
 

Of course, you can’t forget about Ultra Containers, which you can earn for completing various special missions as well as purchase from the shop.

Here are some of the epic prizes you can get from these containers:

[list][*][b][u]NEW Ricochet’s «Tectonic field» augment[/u][/b][/*][*]Ricochet’s «Helios» augment[/*][*]Firebird’s «Toxic mix» augment[/*][*]Unique [b]XT skin[/b] for Ares in HD;[/*][*]Detailed [b]Ultra skins[/b] for Vulcan and Viking;[/*][*]The famous «Crisis» drone and «Armadillo» module;[/*][*]Other prizes obtainable from common containers.[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Special missions[/b][/h3]
 

You can never have enough Ultra Containers. Complete the special missions to get them and… stars!

[list][*][b][u]Mission: Battle Elite[/u][/b][/*][*]Task: Be in the winning team of 1 battle in any matchmaking battles. [/*][*]IMPORTANT: This mission is only available for «Premium Pass» owners.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 1 unit of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
[list][*][b][u]Mission: Special Authorization[/u][/b][/*][*]Task: Finish 3 battles in any matchmaking battles. [/*][*]IMPORTANT: This mission is only available for «Battle Pass» owners.[/*][*]Reward: 3 Ultra Containers and 3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
[list][*]Supermission: The best at everything![/*][*]Task: Complete «Medallist», «Team Spirit», «Earner», «Destroyer», «The Punisher», «Armageddon» and «Armadillo» missions.[/*][*]Reward: 7 Ultra Containers[/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Medallist[/*][*]Task: Get into the TOP-3 5 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Team Spirit[/*][*]Task: Be in the winning team of 10 battles in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Earner[/*][*]Task: Earn 15000 crystals in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Destroyer[/*][*]Task: Deal 200000 damage in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: The Punisher[/*][*]Task: Earn 4000 battle points in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Armageddon[/*][*]Task: Use overdrive 40 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
[list][*]Mission: Armadillo[/*][*]Task: Use boosted armor 330 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward:1 Ultra Container and 50 stars [/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]2 Special Bundles in the Shop[/b][/h3]
 

Got a keen eye for a great deal? Cool! We’ve created 2 special bundles that will set you ahead of the competition at really affordable prices.

These bundles will be exclusively available in the Shop for the duration of the festivities.


[b][u]Special «Ammunition» offer[/u][/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dRVa6xC.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch Update #684 - Released 22nd April 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/d8e836fbb6b0341d6c21c67a977c25847cde0670.jpg[/img]


[h2][b]Patch Update #684 - Released 22nd April 2022[/b][/h2]

 
[list][*]
A new augment for Ricochet has been added to Ultra Containers  — «Cryo field».
[list][*]
(Note) Just like Vaporizer ignites a target, this new augment freezes it.
We have seen your comments that these augments should also have an explosion or ricochet. We might add such features in the future.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
The maximum number of players per group has been decreased from 4 to 3.
[list][*]
(Note) We have conducted a study to find out how often tankers play in groups of 4 and asked their opinion about such groups in matchmaking. After analyzing the results and taking into account that the matchmaking system works better when the maximum group size is lower, we have decided to reduce the maximum number of players in a group from 4 to 3.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Duration of Repair kit’s protection from status effect decreased from 1 to 0.9 s.
[list][*]
(Note) Longer protection from status effects duplicates the functions of hull immunity augments. Thus we do not see any reasons to increase the duration. Instead, we are decrease the duration to emphasize not only a new feature of the Repair kit but also to make its use more skill-dependent. 
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Added lighting for headlights and lamps on turrets and hulls
[/*][*]
Isida
[list][*]
Critical damage (not healing) chance decreased from 12% to 7%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Smoky
[list][*]
«Sorted Ammunition» augment
[list][*]
The first shot after respawn is critical;
[/*][*]
Fixed the bug when you shoot to the sky and it doesn’t update critical chance counter. It caused the «Sorted Ammunition» augment to function incorrectly.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Thunder
[list][*]
Regular damage decreased from 405-810 to 355-710 HP;
[/*][*]
Critical damage increased from 495-990 to 505-1010 HP;
[/*][*]
Critical hit chance increased from 15% to 30%;
[/*][*]
Minimum and average damage ratio increased from 25%-10% to 60%-60%;
[/*][*]
Radius of weak splash damage decreased from 12-12 to 8-12 m;
[/*][*]
Radius of average splash damage decreased from 5 to 2 m;
[/*][*]
Сritical damage explosion radius decreased from 12 to 1 m;
[/*][*]
Reload duration changed from 3.2-2.3 to 3.3-2.0 s;
[/*][*]
«Small caliber charging machine» augment:
[list][*]
Reload duration decrease changed from 20% to 25%;
[/*][*]
Regular Damage decrease changed from 20% to 25%;
[/*][*]
Critical damage no longer decreased;
[/*][*]
Price increased from 149 000 to 245 000 crystals.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«Subcaliber rounds» augment
[list][*]
Reload duration decrease changed from 15% to 10%;
[/*][*]
Projectile speed increase changed from 50% to 100%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«"Sledgehammer" rounds» augments:
[list][*]
Range of Max Damage decrease changed from 95% to 80%;
[/*][*]
Reload duration decrease removed;
[/*][*]
Added Regular Damage increase of 50%;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) The previous version of Thunder allowed dealing effective splash damage with critical hits. The new version is different in that it applies full and critical damage only on direct hits. But splash damage is no longer dependent on distance, and you always deal 60% of damage if your splash damage reached the opponent. We hope that it will make shooting at the ground and obstacles a more viable tactic.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Railgun
[list][*]
Shot warmup time increased from 1.5 to 1.6 s;
[/*][*]
Shot reload time decreased from 4.4-2.6 to 4.3-2.5 s;
[/*][*]
Impact force decreased from 4-12 to 3-9;
[/*][*]
Changed the sound file so that the moment of the shot and the sound of the shot will be synchronized.
[/*][*]
(Note) We are glad you like the new and more skill-dependent Railgun. Let’s make it even better.
[/*][*]
«Hyperspace rounds» augment 
[list][*]
Added  a10% increase to the Shot warmup time;
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Shaft
[list][*]
Critical damage increased from 350-700 to 465-930;
[/*][*]
Critical hit chance increased from 12% to 30%;
[/*][*]
Initial Field of view increased from 40 to 90 deg.;
[/*][*]
Final Field of view decreased from 20 to 15 deg.;
[/*][*]
Aiming acceleration decreased from 27 to 20 units;
[/*][*]
Scope exit delay decreased from 0.5 to 0.2 s;
[/*][*]
Scope enter delay decreased from 0.5 to 0.4 s;
[/*][*]
(Note) New FOV zooms slower when you enter the sniping mode and zooms faster at the end. It will be useful for those players who prefer to make quick scoped shots at short distances.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Terminator:
[list][*]
Initial rocket speed decreased from 120 to 100 m/s;
[/*][*]
Max rocket speed (m/s) decreased from 60 to 50 m/s;
[/*][*]
(Note) A bit more emphasis on melee range fights for the rocket launcher.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Containers
[list][*]
Freeze’s «Magnetic mix» and «Paralyzing Mix» augments have been added to regular containers;
[/*][*]
You are guaranteed to get an item of «RARE» rarity every 15 regular containers.
[/*][*]
You are guaranteed to get an item of «EPIC» rarity every 15 Ultra Containers.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Matchmaking equipment change cooldown increased from 14 to 15 minutes.
[/*][*]
PRO battle equipment change cooldown decreased from 8 to 7 minutes.
[/*][*]
Fixed the bug with the «Unequip» button for modules in the Garage;
[/*][*]
Fixed the bug on low resolution screens where the tank in the Garage was displayed on top of the interface.
[/*][*]
In Rugby mode, the speed of a parachute with a ball has been increased by a third.
[/*][/list]

[list][*]
A new augment for Twins added to the Ultra Containers — «Plasma Disruptor».

[/*][/list][/*][*]

[Note] We realize that communication is important for you. We return the battle chats, but for now in a limited form. If we notice an increase in the number of violations of the rules, we will be forced to disable chats again.

Bonus box parachutes are replaced with cargo drones.

Updated the design of bonus boxes and their zones on maps.

Increased the number of containers for completing weekly missions from 1 to 3.

«Destabilized plasma» augment

Increased damage in the blast radius for non-critical shots;

[/*][/list][/*][*]

[/*][/list][/*][*]

notes.title: New bonus box design
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/7f2ee9a8314876dd8b6f954243b85ed23233043e.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!


[h2][b]We continue updating graphics in the game, and in addition to updating the interface and the Sandbox Remastered map, we decided to update supply bonus boxes![/b][/h2]


Our art department has reviewed the appearance of these boxes in the game and the parachutes used to deliver them. The new design is supposed to fit the future look of the game when all maps have been redesigned in the same style as the new Sandbox, and all equipment have been given their HD skins.

In addition to the visuals, we are also changing the sounds of bonus boxes.


[h3][b]New bonus box design[/b][/h3]


This design update includes changes to the color contrast of the boxes, as well as their shape. It will now be easier for you to figure out the type of bonus box that is falling.


[h3][b]Parachutes update[/b][/h3]


Instead of the usual parachutes, special cargo drones will now deliver bonus boxes, crystal boxes, gold boxes, and containers. You can check them out in [url=https://youtu.be/ebIYHncG3NA?t=15]this[/url] episode of the V-LOG.

Features of cargo drones:

[list][*]Unlike parachutes, drones are highly detailed 3D models.[/*][*]When a player picks up a box, the drone unfastens itself from the box, flies up, and only after that disappears.[/*][*]Cargo drones also have skins. The default one is white, but during events we will be changing them to themed ones.[/*][/list]

Enter the game tomorrow to check out these changes!

NB: as yet we have not provided for the possibility of standing on drones ;)

[h2][b]Patch Update #680 - Released 4th March 2022[/b][/h2]


[list][*]A new augment for Freeze added to the Ultra Containers — «Paralyzing Mix».[/*][list][*][Note] Adds a paralyzing mixture into the cooling agent. A critical concentration of the mixture may cause all the target's systems to be paralyzed. Freezing power and critical damage reduced.[/*][/list][*]Added a delay before battle start in Matchmaking battles. For a short period of time, map objectives like flags, bases, balls, etc. won’t be activated, and teams won’t be able to earn battle score points.[/*][list][*]DM — no delay;[/*][*]TDM — 30 seconds;[/*][*]CP — 45 seconds;[/*][*]CTF — 60 seconds;[/*][*]ASL — 60 seconds;[/*][*]RGB — 60 seconds;[/*][*]SGE — 45 seconds;[/*][*]TJR — 30 seconds;[/*][*]JGR — no delay.[/*][*][Note] You will no longer be in situations where you join a battle and an opponent already has battle score points. It will be fairer.[/*][/list][*]Hammer:[/*][list][*]Number of pellets increased from 9 to 30;[/*][*]The number of pellets that may hit the same target is limited to 9;[/*][*]Horizontal spread increased from 10 to 20 deg.;[/*][*]Impact force per pellet decreased from 35-70 to 20-40;[/*][*]Clip reload time decreased from 4,4-3,3 to 6,2-4,4 sec.;[/*][*]«Slugger» augment:[/*][list][*]Horizontal scatter angle decrease is now -75% instead of  -50%;[/*][*]Range of min damage now increases by 25%;[/*][*]Price increased from 149 000 to 245 000 crystals.[/*][/list][*]«Duplet» augment:[/*][list][*]Clip reload increase is now +25% instead of +50%.[/*][/list][*]«Blunderbuss» augment:[/*][list][*]Does not increase the number of pellets per shot, but increases the number of pellets that can hit the same target to 15.[/*][/list][*][Note] It is now more efficient to play with Hammer without being close to an opponent. When you shoot at the maximum distance, damage will be the same as if you shoot at close range.[/*][/list][*]Equipment change cooldown increased from 10 to 11 minutes.[/*][*]Hammer’s «Stunning Pellets» augment is added as a legendary item to Common and Ultra Containers.[/*][*]Weekly mission to complete some number of daily missions now give you the same number of stars as other missions.[/*][*]Decreased the number of battles in which you need to take one of the top three places in the winner's team to complete this type of daily mission from 3 to 2.[/*][list][*][Note] No changes to the «Take one of the top three places in the winner's team in 1 battle» mission.[/*][/list][*]Fixed the bug with Juggernaut getting self-destroyed after becoming a Juggernaut when you are in the Garage.[/*][list][*][Note] A player can no longer become a Juggernaut while being in the Garage.[/*][/list][*]Fixed the bug with the allowed number of players per team being exceeded when new players enter a battle.[/*][*]The feature to get bonuses for watching ads in the mobile version of the game is disabled due to the lack of opportunity to ensure the stability of its operation for all users.[/*][/list]

notes.title: New interface
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/0d9608235267294cb61dd5e35e6440b62c88e11f.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]Tomorrow, February 18th, the new interface will be released in Tanki![/b][/h2]
 

Now, upon entering the game, you will be greeted with a modern design, a new color palette, updated lobbies and the Garage. We took into account your wishes and made the interface more informative.

 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/dsYBgGb.jpeg[/img]
 

This important update will make your time in the game more enjoyable and convenient, and changes in the structure of the Garage will make it easier to find items and view up-to-date information about current turrets.

 

[b]What changed:[/b]

 
[h3][b]Updated logo[/b][/h3]
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/66db68135a01fd853acd900b8406ee23f5b39aa2.png[/img]
 

For the first time in the history of the game, Tanki changes its logo!

The main concept of the symbol, created a decade ago – a tank inscribed in a pentagon with a turned turret – has been preserved. However, we have refreshed the logo to make it more concise and modern to match the new interface.

 
[h3][b]New color palette[/b][/h3]
 

Restrained, but saturated colors, so as not to strain your eyes and focus on the main thing.

A new library of icons and notifiers that are easily scalable for different screens.

 
[h3][b]Updated background[/b][/h3]
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/7jvHAga.jpeg[/img]
 

We listened to your feedback regarding the previous game design and took into account the comments. The most attentive of you may have already noticed the changes in our episodes of the V-LOG or on the test server.

We’ve changed the background on the lobby, garage, settings, menu, and shop screens. We brought all the screens to a common sustained style.

 
[h3][b]Lobby[/b][/h3]
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/f5Tj7Ky.jpeg[/img]
 

It is on this screen that you find yourself after loading the game.

Almost everything has changed here: new icons for the news block, chat and friends screen, a new menu, notifications and a battle selection button. And, of course, a stylish upper with a nickname, balance and a new game logo.

The Premium account has moved to the upper left corner, and the clans are now at the bottom left.

 
[h3][b]Garage[/b][/h3]
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/a90f3tt.jpeg[/img]
 

Be surprised with its minimalism and convenience.

Immediately after opening, you will see all currently equipped gear, what items are available for upgrading, and other relevant information.

For turrets, hulls, drones, protection modules and supplies, all their parameters and the upgrade process are visible, and a new sorting mechanism has been added for paints.

 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/0jsAkpW.jpeg[/img]
 
[img]https://i.imgur.com/f0WMqJu.jpeg[/img]

We designed the new interface to be simple, convenient and attractive. Hope you will enjoy!

 
[h3][b]What’s next?[/b][/h3]
 

We will continue working on the interface of the game. All other windows will also be improved, and the changes that come with this release will be further developed.

Keep sharing your opinion about the new interface with us. We will carefully read your feedback and make the respective changes!

 
[h3][b]Tanki Online Stickers[/b][/h3]
 

A historic moment: Tanki Online have their own stickers for the first time! There are 20 of them, and they are very cool! You can get the full pack by clicking on one of them in our [url=https://t.me/rutankionline]Telegram channel[/url] or if you wish to use them in Discord just join one of our Discord servers!

 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/47b2bb530fecd52120aa470d6d67944ca5634851.png[/img]
 

Use our stickers and share them with your friends, let Tanki become even closer to them!

notes.title: Youtuber Battle
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/14d5301569d64c2ef62ebe3bfd89ac883d983b2a.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]Let’s start this year with a brand-new, cool event that we have never had in Tanki before![/b][/h2]
 

Starting from January 29, 2 AM UTC, till February 14, 2 AM UTC, get one of the special offers to support a YouTuber, earn stars, and get prizes!

«YouTuber Battle» is a competition among six Tanki YouTube content creators:

 
[list][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Waiderol]Waider[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/BigTanks_TO]BigTanks[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/user/JERRYYY21]JERRYYY21[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Quirky69]Quirky[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Taspens]Taspens[/url][/*][*][url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCfPO87UL9ivASmo4wdjXfJA]Jumper[/url][/*][/list]
 

On [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/youtubers-battle/]the special landing page[/url], you can find all the information about the event, read interviews with the YouTubers, follow the battle process, compare team ratings, and see your personal statistics. Once you log in, you will see the number of stars you earned (if it is higher than 300) and an avatar of the YouTuber whose special offer you purchased.

The information on [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/youtubers-battle/]the landing page[/url] is updated once every half an hour.

 
[h3][b]Special offers[/b][/h3]
 

We have created themed special offers for each of our participating content creators. They will be available starting from January 29, 2 AM UTC, till February 14, 2 AM UTC. Make your decision, choose whom you want to support, and purchase their unique bundle.

 

[b][u]Waider’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]«Waider» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]BigTanks’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]«BigTanks» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]JERRYYY21’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]«JERRYYY21» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Quirky’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]«Quirky» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]JMPR’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]«JMPR» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Taspens’s Pack[/u][/b]

 
[list][*] «Taspens» paint[/*][*]15 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b]Important: [/b]A player can buy only one of the special offers. Paints will remain in the participants’ Garages after the event.

 
[h3][b]How to participate[/b][/h3]
 

Starting from January 29, 2 AM UTC, till February 14, 2 AM UTC, you must meet the following 2 requirements in order to participate:

 
[olist][*]Get one of the YouTuber-themed special offers[/*][*]Play in Matchmaking and earn no less than 300 stars[/*][/olist]
 

[b]Important:[/b] Stars that you purchase are also counted.

 
[h3][b]How to win[/b][/h3]
 

Teams are ranked by their efficiency which will be calculated using the following formula: the total number of stars earned by a team divided by the total number of players in the team. This coefficient shows the average number of stars earned by each member of a team. The more stars each team member earns, the higher the coefficient will be. The team with the highest efficiency wins.

With this scoring system, the number of players in a team will not determine the outcome of the battle. Rather, the team that works the hardest will emerge victorious.

For example, if there are 1,000 participants in a team and they have earned a combined total of 20,000 stars, the team’s efficiency rate will be 20,000/1,000 = 20.

In another example, another team has 2,000 participants and they have earned a combined 30,000 stars; the team’s efficiency rate will be 30,000/2,000 = 15.

In such a situation, the first team would win with an efficiency rating of 20 stars per participant.

[b]IMPORTANT: We log your stars starting from the moment you purchase one of the special offers but these stars are counted towards team results only once you earn 300 stars.[/b]

 
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 

All the participants who meet the requirements (bought a special offer and earned no less than 300 stars) will receive rewards. The more stars you earn, the more prizes you will receive:

 
[list][*]300 Stars; Container х1[/*][*]600 Stars; Container х1[/*][*]900 Stars; Container х2[/*][*]1200 Stars; Container х2[/*][*]1500 Stars; Container х3[/*][*]1800 Stars; Container х3[/*][*]2100 Stars; Container х4[/*][*]2400 Stars; Container х4[/*][*]2700 Stars; Container х5[/*][*]3000 Stars; Container х5[/*][*]3300 Stars; Container х6[/*][*]3600 Stars; Container х6[/*][*]3900 Stars; Container х7[/*][*]4200 Stars; Ultra Container х5[/*][*]4500 Stars; Ultra Container х10[/*][*]5000 Stars; Freeze SE skin[/*][/list]
 

Participants of the winning team will also get additional rewards:

 
[list][*]50 Containers[/*][*]30 Ultra Containers[/*][/list]
 

The prizes are accumulated. Thus, a player who earned 5,000 stars and whose team won, may get 99 Containers, 45 Ultra Containers, and the unique «Freeze SE» skin! 

The prizes will be added to your accounts on February 14.

For the duration of the event, we will create special chat channels on our official Discord server — one for each of the YouTubers’ teams. Find teammates, play together, and discuss strategies to win!

The event is held in accordance with the General Rules for Promotions and Contests ([url=https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/]https://tankionline.com/en/general-rules-contests-promotions/[/url]).

[u]The event is promotional in nature, is not a lottery or other risk-based event, and does not require payment for participation.[/u]

Good luck to everyone, and earn a lot of stars! If you have any questions — do not hesitate to ask in the comments section of the forum topic.

 
[h3][b]F.A.Q.[/b][/h3]
 

[b]How many special offers can I buy?
[/b]You can buy only 1 of the themed special offers. Once you have successfully purchased any of the bundles, the others will become unavailable.

[b]Why do the teams have 0 stars and 0 participants on [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/youtubers-battle/]the website[/url]?[/b]

This may happen during the first few hours of the event. It means that none of the participants who bought a special offer has earned at least 300 stars yet.

[b]When can I buy a special offer?[/b]

[u]You can purchase a special offer at any moment during the event. However, you are considered as a participant of the event and stars you earn are counted towards team results only once you purchase a special offer and earn 300 stars.[/u]

[b]Will the stars I earned before buying a special offer be counted?[/b]

[u]No. You are considered as a participant of the event and stars you earn are counted towards team results only once you meet all the following criteria:[/u]
[olist][*][u]You got one of the YouTuber-themed special offers.[/u][/*][*][u]You played in Matchmaking and earned no less than 300 stars.[/u][/*][/olist]

[b]Are the stars I purchase also counted?[/b]

As in all other events, the stars that you purchase are also counted.
