notes.title: Ultra Weekend January 21st - 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/88d9fc09d69b79ffeb754777f244840e06bb717c.jpg[/img]

[list][*]Event: Ultra Weekend January 21st – 23rd[/*][*]Duration: 3 days[/*][*]Starts: Friday, January 21st[/*][*]Ends: Monday, January 24th[/*][/list]
 

[b]Important note: Unless otherwise stated, all events and activities start and end with the server restart at 02:00 UTC.[/b]

Tankers!


[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the upcoming Friday, Saturday, and Sunday will be ULTRA![/b][/h2]
 

There will be a special mode, special missions, boosted funds and experience, Ultra Containers, 2 valuable special offers, and a themed design.

This Ultra Weekend will start on Friday, January 21st, at 2:00 UTC, and will last until Monday, January 24th, at 2:00 UTC. 

 
[h3][b]Special mode[/b][/h3]
 

«Battle Parkour» mode is back in the game – but only during this Ultra Weekend. Time to showcase your skills and catch tons of gold boxes!

 
[list][*]Weapon: Wasp and Thunder[/*][*]Increased gold box rate[/*][*]Maps: Gravity[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Ultra Containers[/b][/h3]
 

Of course, you can’t forget about Ultra Containers, which you can get for completing various special missions as well as by purchasing them in the shop.

Here are some of the epic prizes you can get from these containers:

 
[list][*]Twins’ «Tectonic Plasma» augment[/*][*]Freeze’s «Magnetic Mix» augment[/*][*]Exclusive XT skin for Paladin, as well as the luxurious XT skin for Hammer;[/*][*]High-quality Ultra skins for Striker and Viking;[/*][*]The famous «Crisis» drone and «Armadillo» module;[/*][*]Other prizes obtainable from common containers;[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Special missions[/b][/h3]
 

You can never have enough Ultra Containers. Complete the special missions to get them and… stars!

 
[list][*][b]Supermission: The best at everything![/b][/*][*][b]Task: Complete «Medallist», «Armadillo», «Aggressor», «Driver», «Miner» missions.[/b][/*][*][b]Prize: 7 Ultra Containers and 150 stars[/b][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Medallist[/*][*]Task: Get into the top 3 of the winning team 1 time in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Prize: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Armadillo[/*][*]Task: Use boosted armor 250 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Prize: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Aggressor[/*][*]Task: Use boosted damage 250 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Prize: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Driver[/*][*]Task: Use «Speed Boost» supply 250 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Prize: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Miner[/*][*]Task: Use mines 250 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Prize: 1 Ultra Container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Special Bundles in the Shop[/b][/h3]
 

Got a keen eye for a great deal? Cool. We’ve created 2 special bundles that will set you ahead of the competition at a really affordable price.

These bundles will be exclusively available in the Shop for the duration of the festivities.

 

[b]Special «Full Ammunition» bundle:[/b]

 
[list][*]10 Ultra Containers[/*][*]1 unit of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Repair Kit» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Boosted Armor» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Boosted Damage» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Speed Boost» supply[/*][*]300 units of the «Mine» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b]Special «Radioactive Zircon» bundle:[/b]

 
[list][*]190 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]Animated «Green Zircon» paint[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Boosted Funds and Experience[/b][/h3]
 

During the event, get boosted funds and experience for every matchmaking battle! That’s a great chance to rank up faster and get access to new items if you haven’t unlocked them all yet or to get more crystals to upgrade your Garage.

 
[h3][b]Themed Decorations[/b][/h3]
 

Throughout the 3 days of the event, we’ll have themed decorations in the game:

 
[list][*]A holiday-themed paint; [/*][*]Holiday-themed billboards on all maps; [/*][*]Special parachutes for drop boxes; [/*][*]Holiday-themed gold box skin and drop zone.[/*][/list]
 

So get ready to jump into the fray for three days of blazing combat starting with the server restart on Friday, January 21st.

notes.title: Patch Update #675 - Released 14th January 2022
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/55660788f97f2bf71718cbab32c59821ee9247c5.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Patch Update #675 - Released 14th January 2022[/b][/h2]

 
[list][*]
Added a new augment into Ultra Containers: Twins’ «Tectonic Plasma» augment
[list][*]
(Note) This augment applies a micro «Stun» effect to an opponent with each critical shot. The micro «Stun» effect is less effective in stopping opponents than the normal one but can be used to disable some abilities that take time to be activated (some overdrives and Vulcan’s barrel startup)
[/*][/list][/*][*]
When aiming at an opponent, you will now see an indication of turret reloading.  Red outlines indicate that your turret is ready to shoot, and orange outlines show that your turret is still reloading.
[list][*]
(Note) We are interested in your feedback about this feature. It might be useful against Tesla, Shaft, Gauss, Thunder, etc.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Common containers have been updated
[list][*]
Updated rarity group chances
[list][*]
The chance to get a COMMON item is 50%
[/*][*]
The chance to get an UNCOMMON item is 34%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a RARE item is 10%
[/*][*]
The chance to get an EPIC item is 5%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a LEGENDARY item is 1%
[/*][*]
EXOTIC items are no longer found in common containers
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the list of items available from common containers
[list][*]
Removed gold boxes, Premium Pass, skins, and sets of supplies
[/*][*]
Added legendary augments that were only available in Ultra Containers
[/*][*]
Added shot effects and paints that were only available in Ultra Containers or Challenges
[/*][*]
Added base modifications of all turrets, hulls, and drones (except Brutus and Crisis)
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the different ways of getting common containers
[list][*]
Special mission to rank up now rewards you with 1 common container
[/*][*]
Special daily mission for Premium Pass owners now rewards you with 1 common container
[/*][*]
Crystals and supplies have now been replaced with 1 common container in the daily mission prizes
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) It will now be much easier to get updated common containers after this update, and you will have access to new turret augments from common containers. 
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated Ultra Containers
[list][*]
Updated rarity group chances
[list][*]
The chance to get a COMMON item is <1%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a UNCOMMON item is 67%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a RARE item is 20%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a EPIC item is 10%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a LEGENDARY item is 2%
[/*][*]
The chance to get a EXOTIC item is <1%
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) Now, chances to get cool items from Ultra Containers are twice as likely as getting them from common containers. Exotic items will be items that are available for the duration of an ongoing event (new augments, skins, equipment that are released as a part of an event)
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Passive income of shards disabled
[list][*]
We have abandoned our plans on developing Shards in favor of giving more containers. The container you were getting from Shards every day can now be received for completing daily missions.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Firebird:
[list][*]
Ordinary damage increased from 240-740 to 380-1060;
[/*][*]
Critical damage decreased from 500-1500 to 380-1060;
[/*][*]
Range of max damage decreased from 10-10 to 7-10 m.;
[/*][*]
Critical damage chance decreased from 20% to 12%;
[/*][*]
Energy consumption increased from 200 to 333 (eng/sec);
[/*][*]
Energy Recharge duration decreased from 6 to 1 sec;
[/*][*]
Cone angle decreased from 30 to 20 (º);
[/*][*]
Firebird’s «High-pressure pump» augment:
[list][*]
Range of max damage increased by 50%;
[/*][*]
Range of min damage increased by 50%;
[/*][*]
Price increased to 245 000 crystals;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Firebird’s «Compact fuel tanks» augment:
[list][*]
Heating rate is always 100%;
[/*][*]
Temperature limit is always 100%;
[/*][*]
Reload time doubled;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Firebird’s «Incendiary mix» augment:
[list][*]
No longer affects energy consumption;
[/*][*]
Ordinary damage change increased by 20% instead of 50%;
[/*][*]
Critical damage change increased by 20% instead of 50%;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) These changes are needed not only to buff Firebird but also to make its gameplay different from that of Freeze. The faster energy reload is reminiscent of the old Firebird, where you needed to rely on the afterburn effect. This version of Firebird will deplete its fuel faster, forcing you to make a decision on whether to attack the target again or to rely on the afterburn effect.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Freeze:
[list][*]
Ordinary damage increased from 450-900 to 500-1000;
[/*][*]
Critical damage decreased from 1800-3600 to 1500-3000;
[/*][*]
Range of max damage decreased from 10-10 to 7-10 m.;
[/*][*]
Rate of freezing (temp/sec) decreased from 0,6 to 0,2-0,5;
[/*][*]
Cone angle decreased from 30 to 20 (º);
[/*][*]
Freeze’s «Shock freeze» augment:
[list][*]
No longer affects energy consumption;
[/*][*]
Freezing rate is always 100%;
[/*][*]
No longer deal critical damage;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) We are slightly moving focus from critical to ordinary damage. We are glad that you like the new Freeze, but we needed to moderately nerf it in order to keep balance.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Tesla:
[list][*]
Chain lightning reload increased from 0.9 to 1 (s);
[/*][*]
Tesla’s «Endothermic lightning» augment:
[list][*]
Lightning ball damage decrease changed from -50% to -75%;
[/*][*]
Lightning ball warmup time doubled;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Tesla’s «Superconducting discharge» augment:
[list][*]
Lightning ball damage decrease changed from -50% to -75%;
[/*][*]
Lightning ball warmup time doubled;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Tesla’s «Armour-piercing discharge» augment:
[list][*]
Lightning ball damage decrease changed from -50% to -75%;
[/*][*]
Lightning ball warmup time doubled;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Tesla’s «Jamming discharge» augment:
[list][*]
Lightning ball damage decrease changed from -50% to -75%;
[/*][*]
Lightning ball warmup time doubled;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) These augments apply status effects and the idea behind them is to use them at long distances. However, players found it more useful to use these augments at melee range. Therefore, we had to nerf them as they were too effective in the melee range.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Striker:
[list][*]
Striker’s «Stunning Missiles» augment:
[list][*]
The «Stun» effect duration decreased from 2 to 0.5 s.; 
[/*][*]
Aiming time reduction increased from 50% to 80%;
[/*][*]
Salvo reload time increased by 40%;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
(Note) The previous version of the stunning Striker could immobilize a target too easily. We have replaced the Stun status effect with the Micro-stun status effect, similar to the one that the new Twins augment gives.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Paladin:
[list][*]
Critical damage protection during overdrive disabled.
[/*][*]
(Note) The idea behind Paladin’s overdrive was that Crusader’s overdrive would be the main counter to it. Unfortunately, much fewer players use Crusader than Paladin, so we have decided to let the overdrives of Hornet and Viking, the most popular hulls in the game, be effective against Paladin’s overdrive.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Hull augments:
[list][*]
Prices of «Lightweight Construction» and «Heavyweight Construction» augments are now at 245 000 crystals instead of 4990 Tankoins.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Equipment change time increased from 7 to 8 minutes;
[/*][*]
PRO battles
[list][*]
PRO battles are available starting from the Sergeant rank;
[/*][*]
Sport and Classic formats are added to PRO battles, but you cannot earn crystals or experience in them (like in the Parkour mode);
[/*][*]
Removed DR, XP, and BP formats. The XP/BP format is kept;
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated Shop prices for particular countries.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Festive season
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/0e5f9aceac3059bd9292a2764a120714e38ec104.jpg[/img]


Ho ho ho, tankers!

The long-awaited, most magical and most mysterious holidays are approaching — Christmas and New Year! The festive atmosphere is already in the air.


[h2][b]It’s time to announce the holiday program in Tanki Online![/b][/h2]


Several New Year’s maps, the special festive theme for the Garage and festive holiday music, holiday activities, special event «Snowman» turret, unusual discounts in the Shop and Garage, special missions, Ultra Containers, and much, much more awaits you in this festive season!


[h3][b]First things first[/b][/h3]


We will start with the most popular announcement – discounts.

This festive season, give yourself the perfect gift – buy your dream equipment at only half-price!

[b]From 2 AM UTC December 24th till 2 AM UTC December 25th:[/b]
[list][*]50% off in the Shop. Discounts are applied to crystals, gold boxes, kits, and stars.[/*][/list]
[b]From 2 AM UTC December 25th till 2 AM UTC December 26th:[/b]
[list][*]50% off all turrets.[/*][/list]

notes.title: eSports Tanki Fund. TankiSport 2021 Season IV
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/b1cc80a92fb4a2e54746006dbc75837ca1462278.jpg[/img]


Hello, tankers!

 
[h2][b]The eSports in «Tanki» is in full swing: the 4th season of TankiSport 2021 is reaching the home stretch![/b][/h2]
 

After several weeks of struggle, the following teams have reached the finals:
[list][*]Team Pointers[/*][*]Bulls[/*][*]Stepbrothers[/*][*]Carnage[/*][/list]
 

There are only a few matches left to play before we know who will become the champion of the last tournament of the year and receive the exclusive paint «Champion», the unique protection module with 30% protection from all turrets and mines «Spectrum A», and a special prize which is given for the first time in the entire history of the game. Read about it below.

We have also prepared some entertainment for the fans — participate in the «Tanki Fund» and vote for your favorite teams to stand a chance to win great prizes!

 
[h3][b]Tanki Fund[/b][/h3]
 

[b]The Tanki Fund is a Tankoins fund that will be divided among true eSports fans.[/b]

The Tanki Fund will be accumulated from [b]December 6th 02:00 UTC till December 19th 17:00 UTC[/b].
During this period, you can purchase 3 special offers in the Shop:

 

[b][u]Special offer «Bronze»:[/u][/b]
[list][*]1 Nuclear Energy [/*][*]300 Repair kits[/*][*]300 units of Boosted Damage[/*][*]300 units of Boosted Armor[/*][*]300 units of Speed Boost[/*][*]300 Mines[/*][*]300 Batteries[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Special offer «Silver»:[/u][/b]
[list][*]50 Ultra Containers[/*][*]240 000 Crystals[/*][*]4 Finalists’ clan paints[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Special offer «Gold»:[/u][/b]
[list][*]150 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 Nuclear Energy[/*][*]«Crimson» Shot effect for Firebird[/*][*]«Blood» Shot effect for Hammer[/*][*]«Crimson» Shot effect for Ricochet[/*][*]«Mysterious Red» Shot effect for Vulcan[/*][*]«Crimson» Shot effect for Striker[/*][*]«Blood» Shot effect for Railgun[/*][*]«Crimson» Shot effect for Magnum[/*][*]«Blood» Shot effect for Shaft[/*][/list]
 

With every purchase of a special offer, we will add the following amount of Tankoins to the fund: for «Bronze» – 1000 Tankoins, for «Silver» – 3000 Tankoins, and for «Gold» – 7000 Tankoins.

 
[h3][b]Prizes[/b][/h3]
 

Every time a million Tankoins are added to the Tanki fund, it will level up, and everyone who bought at least one special offer will receive additional prizes:

 
[list][*][b]Level 1:[/b] Nuclear Energy +1[/*][*][b]Level 2:[/b] Additional Protection Module Slot +1[/*][*][b]Level 3:[/b] Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 4:[/b] Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 5:[/b] Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 6: [/b]Additional Protection Module Slot +1[/*][*][b]Level 7:[/b] Ultra Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 8:[/b] Ultra Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 9:[/b] Ultra Containers +5[/*][*][b]Level 10:[/b] Additional Protection Module Slot +1[/*][*][b]Level 11:[/b] Skin Container +1[/*][*][b]Level 12:[/b] Skin Container +1[/*][*][b]Level 13:[/b] Skin Container +1[/*][*][b]Level 14:[/b] Armadillo Protection Module[/*][*][b]Level 15:[/b] Crisis drone[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Tanki Fund distribution[/b][/h3]
 

[b][u]This time we decided to do something special in support of the finalist clans: We will share 10% of the fund among the top three finalist clans, and 90% of the Tanki fund will be divided into equal parts among the participants of the giveaway*. [/u][/b]

We hope this news will raise the morale of the clans! Share your opinions with us; how do you like this change? Would you be willing to participate in eSports if we keep it in the future?

* The participants of the giveaway are the players selected by the randomizer among those who bought the event special offers. If a player has bought several offers, there is a chance that he will be included in the list of winners several times and will be able to receive several parts of the fund. 

 

The selection of participants will take place on December 22 during the day on our official [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPF8cFT3sJHYSV189qXeHIg]YouTube channel[/url]. With every 8000 Tankoins added to the fund, we will add 1 participant to the giveaway. Therefore the number of participants in the giveaway depends on the size of the fund.

 

You can observe the growth of the fund and the number of participants in the giveaway on [url=https://tankionline.com/pages/tanki-sport-season4/]the special website[/url]. The fund will begin to grow only after the first purchase. So far, there are 0 Tankoins.

 
[h3][b]Vote[/b][/h3]
 

You can cheer for your favorite teams not only during the official live broadcasts, but also right in the game!

notes.title: Patch Update #671 - Released 3rd December 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/b9ef8229f0c328a56946d3890b893699ee006088.jpg[/img]

[h2][b]Patch Update #671 - Released 3rd December 2021[/b][/h2]

[list][*]
Updated the standard skin for Twins to the HD version
[/*][*]
Updated the shot sound effects of Twins
[/*][*]
Added new augment for Twins — «Vaporizer», available in Ultra Containers
[list][*]
Critical damage ignites a target with a limit of 50% of the maximum temperature.
[/*][*]
Projectile speed is reduced by 45%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the effects inflicted by «Jammer»
[list][*]
In addition to blocking overdrive activation, it now also disables drones and, if applicable, their boosted effects for the entire duration of the status effect.
[/*][*]
Drones «Brutus» and «Hyperion» are immune to this effect.
[/*][*]
With this change, Jammer becomes comparable in strength to other status effects. «Jammer» is now an «antidote» to most drones. Popular drones like Defender and Booster are obviously weakened. Crisis loses its ability to enhance supplies and will instead function like Brutus. And drones such as «Blaster» and «Lifeguard» will not be able to perform their functions if they are disabled by the Jammer effect.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Added «Jammer Immunity» augments to the Garage for purchase.
[/*][*]
Added «Jammer Immunity» augments to containers.
[/*][*]
Updated the «Freezing» status effect
[list][*]
In addition to slowing down enemy tanks, it now also disables Boosted Damage effects for the entire duration of the status effect.
[/*][*]
This status effect was the weakest one. Increasing the slowdown effect is not the solution to this problem. Instead, we strengthened this status effect by adding a mechanism similar to the Armor-Piercing status effect’s capabilities. Instead of disabling additional armor, it disables the effect of Boosted Damage. This change will increase the role of both Freezing augments and the Freeze turret itself, especially when used for defensive roles. Share your feedback about the new «Freezing» status effect!
[/*][/list][/*][*]
When taking a bonus box, a drone will activate only if it depends on the supply offered by the bonus box.
[list][*]
Activating a drone this way is similar to activating a drone by using supplies from your Garage. For example, if you have the Defender drone equipped, and you take a Boosted Armor bonus box, the drone will be activated.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Camper» drone
[list][*]
Now the drone increases damage by 60% and armor by 90% when your tank has full health. 
[/*][*]
Once you receive damage, the drone starts reloading and will keep on reloading until your tank has fully recharged its health points. 
[/*][*]
The drone also reduces Repair Kit cooldown when using supplies.
[/*][*]
The old version of the drone was not popular at all. Please note that the enhanced armor only protects the tank from the first oncoming damage received when «Camper» is activated. This makes the drone effective against other campers, but almost useless against turrets with rapid fire rates.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Engineer» drone
[list][*]
Now the drone repairs all tanks in a small radius around itself if any of these tanks picks up a bonus box.
[/*][*]
The previous version of «Engineer» on high ranks could spoil teammates’ tactics for using their drones.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Supplier» drone
[list][*]
Now the drone does not extend the duration of its own supplies.
[/*][*]
The duration of the supplies shared with allies is reduced. 
[/*][*]
Shared Boosted Armor and Boosted Damages will activate the effects of allied Defenders and Boosters respectively.
[/*][*]
The previous version of the «Supplier» drone had problems similar to that of the «Engineer» drone.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Hyperion» drone
[list][*]
Now the drone accelerates cooldown of supplies, including repair kits and mines.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Trickster» drone
[list][*]
Hull acceleration is reduced from +30% to +10%.
[/*][*]
Enhancement to Speed Boost remains unchanged.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Crisis» drone
[list][*]
Now taking bonus boxes does not change the supply boosted at the time.
[/*][*]
Hull acceleration is reduced from +30% to +10%.
[/*][*]
Enhancement to Speed Boost remains unchanged.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Firebird» turret
[list][*]
Maximum damage range is increased from 7 meters to 10 meters.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated Tesla’s «Jamming discharge» augment
[list][*]
The «Jammer» status effect duration is reduced from 15 seconds to 7 seconds.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated Twins’s «Stable plasma» augment
[list][*]
Projectile speed is increased by 20%.
[/*][*]
Impact force is increased by 20%.
[/*][*]
Price of augment is increased to 245,000 crystals.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated Ricochet’s «Plasma-torch» augment
[list][*]
Recoil is now reduced by 50% rather than 80%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Striker» turret
[list][*]
Vertical aim-assist is increased from 9 degrees to 45 degrees.
[/*][*]
This allows the turret to destroy flying targets.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Vulcan» turret 
[list][*]
Vertical aim-assist is increased from 9 degrees to 45 degrees.
[/*][*]
Impact force is increased from 0.5-1 to 1-2.
[/*][*]
This allows the turret to destroy flying targets.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Railgun» turret
[list][*]
Reloading time is increased from 3.3-2.6 seconds to 4.4-2.6 seconds;
[/*][*]
Updated the «Round destabilization» augment
[list][*]
Critical damage is increased by 26%.
[/*][*]
Standard damage is decreased by 50%.
[/*][*]
Impact force is no longer increased.
[/*][*]
The previous version of the settings dealt with the problem of the excessive efficiency of the augment but also raised many questions when used with the «Supercharge» status effect. To avoid confusion, the settings were changed to a version with lower damage spread.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Hyperspace rounds» augment
[list][*]
Regular damage damage bonus is increased from +40% to +45%.
[/*][*]
Impact force reduction is increased from -25% to -30%.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Wasp» hull
[list][*]
The duration of the «Jammer» status effect applied by its bomb is decreased from 30 seconds to 9 seconds.
[/*][*]
This is due to the updated effect of Jammer on drones.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Hopper» hull
[list][*]
Overdrive charge duration is decreased from 180 seconds to 150 seconds.
[/*][*]
Duration of the «Stun» status effect is increased from 1 second to 3 seconds.
[/*][*]
The maximum angle at which the hull remains controllable has been increased from 20 degrees to 180 degrees.
[/*][*]
Force of stabilizers is reduced from 10 to 6.
[/*][*]
Maximum angle of list is increased from 60 degrees to 360 degrees.
[/*][*]
Hopper's hull is no longer able to effectively stabilize itself during flight. Any hit by an enemy shot, takeoff from a rough surface, or hitting other objects while flying will significantly change Hopper's flight path. To compensate for these changes, its overdrive charging speed in battle has been increased. These changes are a response to feedback that a flying Hopper is almost impossible to stop.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the «Hunter» hull
[list][*]
Duration of the «Jammer» status effect applied by its overdrive is reduced from 18 seconds to 9 seconds.
[/*][*]
This is due to the updated effect of Jammer on drones.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Updated the maximum Gear Score for hulls, turrets, and drones to 2733 units each.
[/*][*]
Fixed the bug with battle interface glitches after changing equipment.
[/*][*]
Fixed the bug with the search bar of the «Friends» list.
[/*][/list]

notes.title: Ultra Weekend December 3rd - 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/5ae2d48c7ff996840b3be4040447047dbc5d989b.jpg[/img]

[list][*][u]Event: Ultra Weekend December 3rd – 5th[/u][/*][*][u]Duration: 3 days[/u][/*][*][u]Starts: Friday, December 3rd[/u][/*][*][u]Ends: Monday, December 6th[/u][/*][/list]
 

[u]Important note: Unless otherwise stated, all events and activities start and end with the server restart at 02:00 UTC.[/u]

 

Tankers!

 
[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the upcoming Friday, Saturday, and Sunday will be ULTRA![/b][/h2]
 

There will be a special mode, special missions, boosted funds and experience, coinboxes and Ultra Containers, 2 valuable special offers, and a themed design.

This Ultra Weekend will start on Friday, December 3rd, at 2:00 UTC, and will last until Monday, December 6th, at 2:00 UTC. 

 
[h3][b]Special Mode[/b][/h3]
 

Starting from Friday, December 3rd, at 2:00 UTC, until Monday, December 6th, at 2:00 UTC play in the legendary «Solo Juggernaut» mode on some of our trademark maps.

 
[list][*]Mode: Solo JGR[/*][*]Maps: Barda, Rio, Chernushka[/*][*]Increased gold drop rate[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Ultra Containers[/b][/h3]
 

Of course, you can’t forget about Ultra Containers, which you can earn for completing various special missions, as well as purchasing in the shop.

Here are some of the epic prizes you can get from these containers:

 
[list][*]Twins’ «Vaporizer» augment;[/*][*]The unique Paladin XT skin;[/*][*]Detailed Ultra skins for Striker and Hornet;[/*][*]Animated «Adversity» paint;[/*][*]Shot effect for Vulcan;[/*][*]Shot effect for Gauss;[/*][*]The famous «Crisis» drone and «Armadillo» module;[/*][*]Other prizes obtainable from common containers;[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Coinboxes[/b][/h3]
 

As usual, Coinboxes will be available for purchase in the Shop during the event. If you are lucky enough to get 100 000 Tankoins out of them, share a screenshot on the forum!

There are other cool rewards too; make sure to check them out on[url=https://en.tankiwiki.com/Containers#Coinboxes] the Wiki[/url].

 
[h3][b]Special missions[/b][/h3]
 

You can never have enough Ultra Containers. Complete the special missions to get them and earn some more bonus stars!

 
[list][*][b][u]Supermission: The best at everything![/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Task: Complete «Medallist», «Armageddon», «Aggressor», «Trooper» and «Spotter» missions.[/u][/b][/*][*][b][u]Reward: 7 Ultra Containers and 150 stars[/u][/b][/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Medallist[/*][*]Task: Get into the top 3 of the winning team 1 time.[/*][*]Reward: 1 container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Armageddon[/*][*]Task: Use overdrive 50 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Aggressor[/*][*]Task: Use boosted damage 330 times in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Trooper[/*][*]Task: Destroy 130 tanks using short-range turrets (Twins, Ricochet, Hammer) in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[list][*]Mission: Spotter[/*][*]Task: Destroy 130 tanks using medium-range turrets (Smoky, Striker, Vulcan, Thunder) in any matchmaking battles.[/*][*]Reward: 1 container and 50 stars[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]2 Special Bundles in the Shop[/b][/h3]
 

Got a keen eye for a great deal? Cool. We’ve created 2 special bundles that will set you ahead of the competition at a really affordable price.

These bundles will be exclusively available in the Shop for the duration of the festivities.

 

[b][u]Special «Full Ammunition» bundle[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]10 Ultra Containers[/*][*]1 unit of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]300 units of each of the «Repair Kit», «Boosted Armor», «Boosted Damage», «Speed Boost», and «Mine» supply[/*][/list]
 

[b][u]Special «Radioactive Lightning» bundle[/u][/b]

 
[list][*]250 Ultra Containers[/*][*]3 units of the «Nuclear Energy» supply[/*][*]Tesla XT skin[/*][*]Tesla Mk2[/*][*]Tesla’s «Jamming discharge» augment[/*][/list]
 
[h3][b]Boosted Funds and Experience[/b][/h3]
 

During the event, get boosted funds and experience for every matchmaking battle! It’s the perfect opportunity to rank up faster and get access to new items if you haven’t unlocked them all yet or to get more crystals to upgrade your Garage.

 
[h3][b]Themed Decorations[/b][/h3]
 

Throughout the 3 days of the event, we’ll have themed decorations in the game:
[list][*]A holiday-themed paint; [/*][*]Holiday-themed billboards on all maps; [/*][*]Special parachutes for drop boxes; [/*][*]Holiday-themed gold box skin and drop zone.[/*][/list]
 

So get ready to jump into the fray for three days of blazing combat starting with the server restart on Friday, December 3rd.

notes.title: Patch Update #669 - Released 19th November 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/4635e9a89184d7778f59fcd1fd713e6b3ab7e030.jpg[/img]

[list][*]
The Paladin hull is available for purchase in the garage with crystals.
[/*][*]
The Paladin XT skin is now available in the updated Ultra Containers.
[/*][*]
Gear Score distribution changed:
[list][*]
Turret/Hull Mk1 up to 350 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk2 up to 700 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk3 up to 1050 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk4 up to 1400 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk5 up to 1750 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk6 up to 2100 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull Mk7 up to 2700 GS
[/*][*]
Drone up to 2799 GS
[/*][*]
Turret/Hull augment 300 GS
[/*][*]
Now the Turret, Hull, and Drone have almost the same “weight” in GS points, which reflects the real situation with power level after making supplies power be upgradable by drones.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Tesla: 
[list][*]
«Jamming discharge» augment 
[list][*]
Duration of the «Jammer» status effect is increased to 15 seconds.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Hammer: 
[list][*]
«Jamming Shot» augment
[list][*]
The «Jammer» status effect is applied with every shot, not just the last.
[/*][*]
The «Jammer» status effect’s duration is reduced from 7 to 5 seconds.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Twins: 
[list][*]
«Heavy Plasmagun» augment
[list][*]
Projectile speed slows down by 45% instead of 35%.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Ricochet: 
[list][*]
«Plasma-torch» augment
[list][*]
Turret recoil is reduced by 80%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
This change not only simplifies the use of the augment on light hulls, but also significantly reduces the range of Hopper in combination with the «Lightweight Construction» augment.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Vulcan:
[list][*]
«Incendiary band» augment
[list][*]
Rate of fire is reduced by 25%; 
[/*][*]
Tank starts to overheat 75% faster.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
Thunder: 
[list][*]
Reload duration is increased from 3-2.2 to 3.2-2.3 seconds. 
[/*][*]
Critical damage radius is increased to 12 meters. 
[/*][*]
Critical hit chance is increased from 10% to 15%. 
[/*][*]
The maximum splash radius is increased to 2 meters.
[/*][*]
The percentage of medium damage is reduced to 25%. 
[/*][*]
The percentage of weak damage is reduced to 10%.
[/*][*]
Impact power is increased from 1.5-3.3 to 2-5. 
[/*][*]
«Small caliber charging machine» augment
[list][*]
Critical damage is reduced by 20%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«Subcaliber rounds» augment
[list][*]
Rate of fire is increased by 15% instead of 10%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«”Sledgehammer” rounds» augment
[list][*]
Critical chance is now 0%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Standard damage now requires more accurate shooting, because its explosion damage is quickly weakened. On the contrary, critical damage now acts in the entire radius of the explosion. According to our idea, such a Thunder should become less effective when shooting thoughtlessly and more effective when the player clearly understands when to shoot accurately, and when to hit the walls and wait for a critical shot.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Railgun: 
[list][*]
«Electromagnetic accelerator "Scout"» augment
[list][*]
Impact force is reduced by 40%.
[/*][*]
Rate of fire is increased by 20% instead of 30%.
[/*][*]
Shot warmup time is 30% faster instead of 25%. 
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«Large caliber rounds» augment
[list][*]
Recharge time is increased by 90% instead of 60%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
«Round destabilization» augment 
[list][*]
Maximum critical chance is reduced from 70% to 50%. 
[/*][*]
Critical damage is reduced to fixed 50 units. 
[/*][*]
Standard damage is increased by 180%.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
All these augments are weakened in different ways due to their high efficiency. The most interesting changes came with the «Round destabilization» augment. Now the main damage dealt is of the standard type, instead of critical. This means that this augment can no longer ignore Railgun protection in battle, as it was before critical damage was introduced.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Hopper: 
[list][*]
Overdrive charging time is increased from 180 to 210 seconds.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Hunter:
[list][*]
Overdrive radius is increased from 25 to 30 meters.
[/*][*]
The «Stun» status effect’s duration is increased from 3 to 4 seconds.
[/*][*]
The «EMP» status effect’s duration time is increased from 5 to 6 seconds.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
Crusader: 
[list][*]
Armor Piercing Icicle damage is increased from 1000-2000 to 1500-3000.
[list][*]
Reverts the previous damage settings for the Crusader overdrive. They are more justified for slow charging.
[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*]
«Booster» drone:
[list][*]
Supply boost is reduced from 20-40% to 15-30%.
[/*][*]
The performance of this drone is still superior to all other drones.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
TDM game mode is now limited to 150 eliminations in Matchmaking.
[/*][*]
The volume of enabling and disabling supplies has been standardized.
[list][*]
The sounds of the «Boosted armor» supply will no longer be so loud.
[/*][/list][/*][*]
The «Chernushka» map is available in Matchmaking and Pro battles in TDM, CP, CTF, RGB, ASL, and TJR modes
[/*][*]
Added the option to disable the «Nuclear energy» supply in PRO Battle settings.
[/*][*]
When creating a battle in the «Parkour» format, the option to disable gold boxes is now available.
[/*][*]
Improved notification system for invitations to battles if the game tab is inactive.
[/*][*]

Tankers!

 
[h2][b]We are happy to announce that the upcoming Friday, Saturday, and Sunday will be ULTRA![/b][/h2]
 

This Ultra Weekend will include the special DM mode, special missions, boosted funds and experience, coinboxes and Ultra Containers, 3 valuable special offers and a themed design.

This Ultra Weekend will start on Friday, November 19th, at 2:00 UTC, and will last until Monday, November 22nd, at 2:00 UTC.

Play in the special DM mode on the legendary maps this weekend!

			[/*]		[/list]	[/*]	[*]		
			Shaft:		
		[list]			[*]				
					Energy per arcade shot (eng) has been decreased from 250 to 0 eng;

notes.title: Sandbox Remastered
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/bb38d1ebe89a4339c7bc8a2434f99893d2c8cf26.jpg[/img]

Hello, tankers!

	[h2][b][u][u]We are happy to introduce «Sandbox Remastered» — the first HD map in Tanki Online![/u][/u][/b][/h2]

	After introducing remastered HD versions of the turrets, we embarked on a journey to add in improved versions of the maps, starting with a fan favorite, «Sandbox».

	After we officially moved to HTML5 Client, our developers have turned to new things such as turning your requests into reality.

	 

	[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/fa09d0ecb9d597c4e0d439f8654ac6b49cc4943d.jpg[/img]

	 

	Sandbox Remastered — this is not a recreating of the map, but rather its development. Here, we blend the experiences of the past with the technologies of the future to bring you a clean remake of this classic map. The battle area of the map has been updated as carefully as possible. And let’s not forget the attention to detail.

	 

	For this map, we have developed new models of game objects in a single style. Every flower, tree, and tile is all handmade. We talked about this in detail in the V-LOG - [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nEbSxmMuMxQ]Episode 316[/url]

	 

	[h3][u][b][u]Large-scale testing[/u][/b][/u][/h3]

	 

	And the main question is: how can you play on the new map?

	Here is the answer: 

	In this weekend, on Friday, Saturday and Sunday, as part of the «Tanki Reloaded» event, with the server restart, from October 15th at 2:00 UTC until October 18th at 2:00 UTC, you will be able to play in the new HD Sandbox map in a special mode!

	 

	[h3][u][u][b]PAY ATTENTION![/b][/u][/u][/h3]

	 

	The map is still under development and has not been optimized, so you may encounter FPS drops. We understand this and still ask you to play this mode as actively as possible and invite your friends.

	 

	[b][u]The map is only available in the PC version of the game. We still need to optimize the map to let mobile players enjoy playing on it.[/u][/b]

	 

	This will help us collect the statistics we need, so we can identify any bugs and optimize the map for the best playing experience possible. 

	 

	From Monday on, the map will be removed from the game and undergo changes with respect to the public tests this weekend. We will keep you updated with the news.

	 

	[b][u]Don’t miss it! In the upcoming weekend, a new era of «Tanki»![/u][/b]

	[b][u]Enter the game, play, and don’t forget to share your feedback in the comments and in the forum![/u][/b]

notes.title: New «Paladin» hull. Early access
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27519363/11cbc2aa1cbd8ca61d4def8d530b8aa35c0d3864.jpg[/img]

Hello, tankers!

[h2]We have great news for you: a novelty will appear in Ultra Containers tomorrow![/h2]
 
Please welcome the new «Paladin» hull. Its release will finish the collection of hovering hulls.

[h3]Key features[/h3]
 
[list]
[*] Medium hovering tank that is especially useful for teamplay
[*] Overdrive lasts for a long time and has a large radius of effect. Tanks that are affected by Paladin’s Overdrive are connected with “lines” to the tank that activated it.
[*] Paladin’s teammates around it get minor healing, immunity from all status effects, and 90% protection from critical damage.
[*] Enemy tanks in the range of Paladin Overdrive’s area of effect receive the «Armor-piercing» and «Jammer» status effects.
[*] Critical damage protection essentially protects a tank from the Overdrives of Hornet and Dictator
[*] Applying Jammer status effect lets you prevent nearby enemy tanks from using their Overdrive, protecting your tank from Hunter’s and Wasp’s ODs
[*] As long as a tank is in the effect range of the aura polarizer, all of the Overdrive effects are applied, but as soon as a tank leaves they will all be deactivated instantly. 
[/list]
 
Our developers intend Paladin to primarily be a “supporting” tank; going on the offensive with this hull is not the best tactic. Combining Paladin with Titan and Hornet can present a fearsome trio and fully realize this hull’s potential.

 
[h3]Early access[/h3]
 
Do you want to own these new items and be the first to test their capabilities in battle?During the early access period, both the «Paladin» hull and the «Jammer Immunity» augment for it will only be available to obtain from Ultra Containers. You can get your hands on these new Ultra Containers by completing the special missions or you can buy them from the shop.

 
To all our happy Paladin owners, we would love to see you share your screenshots in the comments!

notes.content:

Hello, tankers!

After battling for weeks through the qualifying tournaments and the group stage, Team Pointers, Bulls, Stepbrothers, and Merciful proceeded to the finals.

Now, just a few matches remain before we find out who will become the champion of the prestigious TankiSport 2021 Season III tournament and earn the prized Acid paint together with the unique protection module with 20% resistance from all turrets and mines.

To gather support for this tournament, we have prepared something interesting for you. In addition to the tournament, we will be holding not one, but two events with even more amazing prizes. Take part in the Tanki Fund and vote for the best teams!


[b]Tanki Fund[/b]

«Tanki Fund» is a fund of tankoins. Every themed special offer purchased will contribute towards the size of this fund. After the end of the event, we will be giving away this fund among the participants*.

There will be two stages of the Tanki fund from 2 AM UTC September 11 till 3 PM UTC September 26. Let’s take a closer look:

First Stage — from 2 AM UTC September 11 till 2 AM UTC September 21. During this stage, there will be 4 special offers available in the Shop, each containing a fan paint of one of the top teams.

You may purchase as many special offers as you want. The more you buy, the more chances you have to get a share of the Tanki fund!

[b]Tanki Fund Prizes[/b]

Every offer purchased adds 1000 tankoins to the fund. With every 8000 tankoins in the fund, the number of participants of the giveaway is increased by 1.

Participants* of the giveaway will receive equal shares of the fund, and some of you will be able to become a real Tankoin tycoon in an instant.

* participants of the giveaway are players randomly chosen among those who bought the themed special offers. We will choose participants live on a stream, which will happen at 2 PM UTC on September 29. The number of participants depends on the number of special offers purchased.

You can track the number of participants and the number of tankoins in the fund on the special website. The number of tankoins will be updated as soon as the first purchase is made; right now it shows 0 tankoins.


[b]Tanki Fund Bonus[/b]

In case a clan wins, and you have bought the special offer containing the paint of the clan, you will get a bonus of 3 days of Premium Pass. In case you buy all the special offers, you are guaranteed to receive the bonus of 3 days of Premium Pass.

[b]
Prizes for voting[/b]

That’s not all. Got a favorite team for a specific match? You can not only cheer for it during livestreams, but also vote on the match results!
Starting from 21st to 26th of September, earn stars in matchmaking and vote on the match results every day and get prizes!
 
Enter the special website on the day of each match and vote for one of two teams starting from 2 AM UTC till 5 PM UTC. There will be 6 tough matches, one per day.

[*] In 4 out of 6 matches, a team you vote for wins – 4 containers

[*]

[b]Requirements to vote. You have:[/b]

[/list]

[b]Important: [/b]Players who use Google, Facebook, or other social media handles to enter the game will only be able to take part in the event after receiving a password via help@tankionline.com. 

[b]How to vote:[/b]

[list]
[*] Choose a clan by clicking on its logo in the “Vote” section on the special website.
[*] Confirm your choice.
[/list]

Important: After you clicked on the “Confirm” button, your choice is saved and cannot be changed.

notes.title: Tanker’s Day
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/3yWjcBi.jpeg[/img]

Hello, tankers!

[h1]Tanker’s Day is a special day for all of us, it’s our professional holiday. Let’s celebrate it in a fun and active way![/h1]

Starting from September 3rd 2 AM UTC till September 20th 2 AM UTC the following features will be available in the game: special «Arms race» mode and other cool special modes, double funds and experience, coinboxes, ultra containers with VERY special items, discounts, valuable special offers, special missions and festive piggy bank for mobile players.

[h3]Updated Ultra Containers[/h3]

Of course, you can't forget about Ultra Containers, which you can earn by completing various special missions, as well as purchasing in the shop.

This time we have decided to change the ultra containers content the way your chances to get «Exotic» items will be increased as these Exotic skins are special! During the celebrations you will be able to get the following items from the updated ultra containers:

[list]
[*] «Steampunk»-styled Twins skin;
[*] «Steampunk»-styled Mammoth skin;
[*] Animated «Bronze armor» paint
[*] «Crisis» drone;
[*] «Armadillo» module.
[/list]

Read more about «Steampunk»-styled set of skins [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/562010/view/2958290486946703543]here.[/url]

The updated ultra containers will also have items you get from common containers inside.

[h3]Discounts[/h3]

The best time for each tanker to make your tank even more powerful is during discounts. This time enjoy items available at 50% discount.

[/list]

[/list]

From 2 AM UTC September 7, until 02 UTC September 8:

[/list]

[/list]

[b]Special «Steampunk» offer:
[/b][list]
[*] 300 ultra containers
[/list]

Do not miss your chance to get items cheaper than usual!

[h3]Special «Arms race» mode[/h3]

Starting from 2 AM UTC September 10, until 02 UTC September 13, the special «Arms race» mode is coming back! The unique event where you need to earn points while your equipment is continuously changing.

How it works:

[list]
[*] Hull — always Viking;
[*] Equipment modification — Mk7;
[*] Maps: Dusseldorf, Lost Temple, Berlin;
[*] Battle duration — 30 minutes, but...
[/list]

Let’s take a deeper look at how it works and why you will rarely be playing for 30 minutes.

All players start with the same equipment — the Viking hull and Smoky turret.

After destroying some number of tanks (you will see the number in the game interface), you get another turret. The order of turrets is the same as the order in which they were released. You will start with the first ever turret - Smoky, and work your way up to the newest — the legendary «Tesla» turret. Yes, it means that everyone will have a chance to check out the new turret and decide whether to buy it or not!

[*] Firebird
[*] Twins
[*] Railgun
[*] Isida
[*] Thunder
[*] Ricochet
[*] Freeze

notes.title: HTML5 on Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vgj5PoR.jpeg[/img]

Tankers!

[h1]This time we want to share with you something really important for us — the Tanki Online Steam client has been updated to the HTML5 version![/h1]

It has taken a lot of our time to make this transition happen but now we can finally say that it’s done, and that the Flash version of the game is finally no longer supported.

Some of you may see this as bad news, but let us remind you that - in addition to the fact that the game is no longer dependent on the Flash technology, which is unsafe and has been discontinued by its developers - there are some other advantages. H[b]enceforth, it will take much less time for us to create new updates for you as we can now concentrate all our efforts on the HTML5 version of the game. Thus, this transition opens new possibilities for you and us! Not only will it let us start to update the game’s interface soon, but also from now on it will take less time for us to release new content, create new maps and add many interesting features![/b]

Moreover, that’s not all for our plans regarding the Steam platform, more is coming soon. One of our ideas is to add support for gamepads.

[b]We are looking forward to your feedback in the comments of this post. [/b]

Let’s make Tanki on Steam great together!

notes.title: Balance changes for Turrets, Alterations and Overdrives.
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/11/update_en_de-630x413.jpg]

Tankers!

Tomorrow, May 24, we’ll be rolling out some balance changes for Turrets, Alterations and Overdrives.

Here are the details:

[h1]Vulcan[/h1]

Turret damage increased by 5% for all modifications .

[h1]Railgun[/h1]

Cooldown time is decreased by 0.3 seconds in a fully upgraded M3, and incrementally less on lower modifications.

[h1]Shaft[/h1]

Reduced sniper shot reload time by 1 second in a fully upgraded M3, and incrementally less for lower modifications.

[h1]Smoky[/h1]

Reduced reload time by 0.1 seconds in a fully upgraded M3, and incrementally less for lower modifications.

[h1]Hammer’s “Duplet” Alteration[/h1]

Clip reload time increased by 10%. This means that reloading after a double shot will take longer.

[h1]Hammer’s “Dragon's Breath” Alteration[/h1]

Now this alteration increases the vertical scatter angle by 50% and the horizontal angle by 100%.

[h1]Magnum[/h1]

Cooldown time is decreased by 1 second for a fully upgraded M3, and incrementally less for lower modifications.

[h1]Magnum’s “Automated gunpowder loading mechanism” Alteration[/h1]

Now additionally increases cooldown time by 20%.

[h1]Magnum’s “Mortar” Alteration[/h1]

Direct hit damage penalty reduced from -25% to -15%.

[h1]Magnum’s “Reinforced Gun Carriage” Alteration[/h1]

The fixed barrel angle is now 3° instead of 5°.

[h1]Dictator Overdrive[/h1]

This Overdrive now has another distinctive feature. It freezes all enemy tanks within its area of effect.
Overdrive range reduced to 15 meters.

[h1]Hornet Overdrive[/h1]

Overdrive duration is reduced by 10 seconds.
Deleted the penalty on the cooldown of Overdrive from points gained in battle. This means that now, when you activate the Overdrive, your battle points will immediately charge the ability.

[h1]Wasp Overdrive[/h1]

The Overdrive now discharges immediately after use. This means that it will be impossible to place a second bomb after respawn.
Deleted the penalty on the cooldown of Overdrive from points gained in battle.

Enter the game tomorrow and give us your feedback!

notes.title: Juggernaut Mission - War of Super Powers
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/626x412_EN.jpg]

Tankers!

The War of Super Powers is in full swing and we’ve got some great news for you.

You see, when we created the missions, we overlooked the fact that Juggernaut mode is not available in the mobile version yet, which means mobile players wouldn’t be able to earn the Thankos’ Armor paint.

That’s not fair. So we’re fixing it.

Now, the Juggernaut mission is no longer necessary to get the animated paint. Just complete the other five missions and the cool paint will be yours. Of course, you can still complete the Juggernaut mission to get the reward of 3 containers.

So, get ready to bring your special powers to the battlefield and earn yourself some cool paints, as well as other rewards including containers, supplies, crystals and golds. And if you haven’t joined the WAR yet, you can join anytime and still reap the benefits of your actions since the beginning of the month.

But don’t delay. This WAR ends on May 29th — that’s less than 2 weeks away!

notes.title: Masters of Parkour 2019 has launched!
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/MoP_2019_626_EN_DE.jpg]

Tankers!

You’ve waited a long time, but the “Masters of Parkour” competition is finally here. For this edition, we’ve made a few small changes to the rules, and added cool, real-life prizes from our partners. Read carefully and to the very end!

The contest consists of two phases—the qualifying round and the finals.

In the qualifying stage, participants need to form a team of up to 4 members, and shoot a spectacular parkour video. The video needs to be uploaded to Youtube, and the link must be submitted through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfRyFKFLh15JAcHkTaVUt_1HGpKLWMeY-TzFmrA1KJYVnYnjg/viewform]this special form[/url]. After the qualification stage, the jury will pick the Top eight teams to move on to the finals.

The finals will be broadcast live on the [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCmr0_TWs3mtO0qp64hu2y_g]Tanki Online International Youtube channel[/url].
 
A couple of days before the broadcast, we will announce a selection of maps and houses. Each team will have to pick one house per map and prepare a stunt to get on that house. The finalists need to perform the tricks to get on the selected houses during the live broadcast. The finals will be single elimination, half of the teams will pass on to the next round until only one remains.

The jury will judge 1st stage videos based on the following criteria,
- Respect for the contest rules
- Difficulty of tricks
- Recording and editing quality

[h1]And now, some details about the qualification stage:[/h1]

- Teams are not allowed to participate in both the international and the Russian Masters of Parkour
- Stunts must be shot on standard gravity settings. Videos made in Space mode will not be considered.
- All team members must have a minimum rank of Warrant Officer 1.
- The parkour team must not have more than 4 tankers. The team can decide whether the video is to be shot by a team member or an independent cameraperson (either a spectator or a normal player)
- Players must not equip skins.
- The video must be exclusively shot for this contest. All members of your team must be equipped with the “Master of Parkour 2019” paint.

IMPORTANT: Due to logistical reasons, the paint is going to be removed from the game on May 6th. That’s one week before the form closes and the qualification stage ends. Make sure to shoot all tricks before that day and take the extra time to edit your video.

[img=https://tankionline.com/de/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/colors_preview-1.png]

- Entries must be uploaded to Youtube. Video links are to be submitted via this special form. When posting your video, make sure you post the nicknames of all the team members (not more than 4 members). If the team wins, only the specified players will get the reward.
- Your video must not be longer than 60 seconds. Videos longer than 60 seconds will be automatically disqualified.
- The nicknames of the participants in a team must be clearly readable on the video.
- A participant can only be part of one team.
- The video must not contain any violation of the Game Rules.
- The rights of using contest videos are described in point 7.4 of the EULA.

[h1]Interesting facts![/h1]
 
There are two versions—the International one (EN/DE/PL/BR/ES), and the Russian one. That means there will be two groups of winners, 2 finals live streams and 2 contests.

[h1]Prizes (per team member)[/h1]

- All the finalists will receive the unique paint “Master of Parkour 2019”, which will remain in their garages forever.
- 1st place: 100 000 crystals, 200 units of each supply, 50 containers, headset Canyon Star Raider and gaming keyboard Genius Scorpion K6.
- 2nd place: 60 000 crystals, 120 units of each supply, 30 containers and gaming keyboard Genius Scorpion K6.
- 3rd place: 40 000 crystals, 80 units of each supply, 20 containers and headset Canyon Corax.
- The remaining finalists will receive 20 000 crystals and 10 containers each.
 
To be eligible to receive the prizes, players must participate in both stages — the video stage and the finals.

[h1]Dates:[/h1]
 
- The paint will be removed on May 6th at an unspecified time
- Entries are accepted until 20:00 UTC on May 13th
- We will announce the names of the eight finalists of the contest on May 19th
- The Finals will take place on May 24th. Time to be disclosed at a later date.

Good luck, parkourists!

Tankers,

We are currently experiencing technical difficulties with our servers, resulting in severe lag in the game and our official platforms.

While we work on solving these issues, we are forced to temporarily disable PRO Battles. Unfortunately, at this time we are unable to give an exact date for when this feature will be back online.

Additionally, our investigations show that these issues are mainly due to the actions of a group of players, who are trying to take an unfair advantage of the game by attacking our servers.

notes.title: Changes in matchmaking and account authentication
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2018/08/update-news.jpg]

Tankers!

With the server restart at 02:00 UTC tomorrow, March 15, a new update will be released in the game. The changes include Google authorization for your Tanki browser version account, and fixes to how groups work in matchmaking.

[h1]Groups[/h1]

Recently, we’ve been observing frequent cases of sabotage using groups. As you know, a group always fights against another group. But unscrupulous tankers began to exploit this mechanism, deliberately seeking a situation where a group of inactive tankers fell on the opposing team.

In this update, we're going to make matchmaking changes that should prevent this exploit from being used.

[h1]Authorization Changes[/h1]

Many players have been unhappy about the fact that accounts registered through the Google service on Android cannot log into the browser version of the game.

Now we have the solution! Authorization via Google is now available in the browser version of the game.

Click on the G + icon when entering the game, select the desired Google account and continue playing.

You can also register via Google in the browser version, and then continue to play on your Android device from the same game account.

Important: After you log in to the browser version of the game through your Google account, go to the settings on the Account tab and set the password. The password is still required for authorization on the forum, help portal and the “Gender Wars” website.

Enter the game tomorrow, try all the updates and be sure you [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=379870]share your opinion in the forum[/url].

notes.title: March 2019: Gender WAR
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/gender_war_march_2019_626x412_EN_DE.jpg]

TL;DR: Support one of two factions —Women or Men— and fight to win one of nine cool animated paints! Details below.



[h1]Details[/h1]

Event: Themed Challenge — Gender WAR
Duration: 27 days
Starts: 02:00 UTC on March 2
Ends: 02:00 UTC on March 29
Rewards: Choose one of nine animated paints



Tankers!

March 2019 brings with it the first ever themed-Challenge — The Gender WAR.

The WAR will be between two factions — Women and Men. Pick which side to fight on and help carry it to victory.

The prize is your choice of one of nine cool animated paints:
Spinner, Tic_tac-toe, Siberian tiger, Pastila, Ginga, Magnolia, Runes, Mount Fuji, Beholder.

[img=https://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/paints_voina_polov.png]

[h1]How to participate in the Gender WAR[/h1]

The Gender WAR is tied to the monthly Challenge.

Participation in the Gender WAR is optional. If you choose to join, the Stars you earn from battles will count for your Challenge AND for the Gender WAR.

To participate, you need to buy one of two themed paints in the garage:

Lady — Support the Women’s faction
Gentlemen — Support the Men’s faction

[img=https://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/voina_polov_price.png]

You’ll be able to purchase either of these paints from your Garage starting from February 20.

Once the WAR kicks off, any Stars you earn in the March Challenge will also count towards your faction’s score.

IMPORTANT information about the Paints

You may only purchase ONE of the two paints.

As soon as you purchase one paint, the other will become unavailable for you to purchase. Choose carefully, because your choice CANNOT be changed.

These paints are temporary. They will only be in the game only for the duration of the event. 
With the morning restart at 02:00 UTC on March 2, they will disappear from sale.

At the end of the Gender WAR at 02:00 UTC on March 29, the Lady and Gentleman paints will be removed from all garages.

[h1]How the Gender WAR works[/h1]

So, how will the outcome of the WAR be decided?

In the interest of fairness, we’ll be comparing the average number of stars per player in each faction, not the total.

Let’s say only 5 people buy the Gentleman paint, and they collect 100, 200, 300, 400 and 500 stars respectively. So:

100 stars + 200 stars + 300 stars + 400 stars + 500 stars = 1500 stars

1500 stars divided by 5 players = 300

This gives us an average of 300 stars for the Men’s faction.

[img=https://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/example1_626.jpg]

The winning faction will be the one with the highest average number of Stars.

You’ll be able to follow the score for both factions on a special website starting from March 2.

[h1]Prizes[/h1]

There are nine animated paints to choose from.

While the Gender WAR is ongoing, you’ll be able to log into the special Gender WAR site by using your ingame nickname and password, and choose which paint you would like to receive if your faction wins.

However, only players who have scored equal to or more than their faction’s average will get the paint. So make sure you don’t fall behind! Fight hard, carry your faction to victory and claim your chosen animated paint.

[img=https://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2019/02/example2_626.jpg]

IMPORTANT: The paint will be awarded to the account that you use to sign into the special site. Rewards cannot be transferred.

Once again, here are the nine animated paints that will be available for you to choose from:
Spinner, Tic_tac-toe, Siberian tiger, Pastila, Ginga, Magnolia, Runes, Mount Fuji, Beholder.

notes.title: Changes in battles & Massacre map
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/work_in_progress.jpg]
 
Tankers!
 
Update #541 will be released in the game with the next server restart at 02:00 UTC tomorrow, February 1. Details below:
 
[b]Matchmaking[/b]
 
Battle time reduced to 7 minutes. Battles end faster, which means you can play more battles in the same amount of time and get more rewards for them, including the stars!
 
[b]Equipment changes in battles[/b]
 
Due to the reduced battle length, the minimum wait time of 5mins between equipment changes in battle is also being revised. The time is being reduced to 3 minutes.
 
The change applies to all battles including PRO.
 
[b]Changes in winning conditions for MM battles[/b]
 
Following the reduction in battle length, the winning conditions (frags, flags, points, etc.) for matchmaking battles are also being changed:
[LIST]
[*]TDM: 70 frags instead of 100;[/*]
[*]JGR: 50 frags instead of 100;[/*]
[*]ASL: 70 points instead of 100;[/*]
[*]DM: 30 frags instead of 50;[/*]
[*]CP: 30 points instead of 50;[/*]
[*]CTF: 5 flags instead of 7;[/*]
[*]RGB: 5 goals instead of 7.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
Destroy opponents, deliver flags, score goals and move on to the next battle faster!
 
[b]"Massacre” map[/b]
 
Following player feedback, we’ve removed the craters from the map, which weren’t very helpful for hiding from enemies, and instead added buildings on both bases and between the Central hills. These should serve as better cover.
 
We’re aware that sometimes tanks can “fall through” the map, but unfortunately this issue cannot be fixed at the present time.
 
Additionally, you can now play CTF and RGM matchmaking battles on Massacre once again.
 
Log into the game tomorrow and check out [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=379332]all of the changes in this update[/url]!

Duration: 4 weeks
Starts: 02:00 UTC on February 1st
Ends: 02:00 UTC on March 1st

Tankers!
 
The new Challenge starts tomorrow (February 1st).
 
Soe great rewards await you, including thousands of crystals, loads of supplies, batteries, paints (both animated and regular), gold boxes, containers, shot effects and other goodies.
 
But that’s not all!
 
If you’re persistent enough to complete the final stage of the Challenge (2000 Stars), you will earn yourself a Hornet XT Skin (Silver Tier) and the brand new Railgun Legacy Skin (Gold Tier — Requires a Battle Pass).
  
[b]Hornet XT[/b]
 
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/hornet_XT_360x220.png]
 
[b]Legacy Railgun[/b]
 
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/railgun_Legacy_360x220.png]
 
By the way, for fans of the XP format, the March Challenge will be featuring a brand new Hornet Legacy skin to pair with your Legacy Railgun skin. That’s a combo worth fighting for.
 
[b]New Bundle: Battle Pass and Premium Account[/b]
 
As in the previous Challenge, playing for free rewards you with prizes from the Silver Tier. But if you want even bigger rewards, you can unlock the Gold Tier by purchasing a Battle Pass from the Shop.

But what if you’re really busy this exams, studying or work this month, and you really, REALLY want to get those precious skins?
 
Don’t worry! A Premium Account can help you finish your Challenge Stages twice as fast by earning double stars for every battle you finish!

Here’s a look at some of the cool rewards that await you in this new Challenge:

Desc: This peculiar paint is obtained by taking gaseous particles obtained from the Earth's atmosphere and bombarding them with charged particles released from the sun's atmosphere. The result is reminiscent of the Aurora Borealis, also known as "Northern Lights".
 
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/8qDtnge3k0nony3Uol/giphy.gif]

Cyberpunk Animated Paint
 
Desc: Shiny technology meets gritty metal in a paint dedicated to those who love to roam in cities of neon and chrome.
 
[img=https://media.giphy.com/media/L14trjf5e4xEX1GUc5/giphy.gif]
 
[b]New Regular Paints[/b]

Singapore
 
Desc: Named after the exciting and constantly-evolving country of Singapore, this paint is the perfect match for tankers who love to stay ahead of the competition by reinventing themselves with new equipment combinations and tactics.

[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/paint_normal_Singapore.png]
 
Blue Marmalade
 
Desc: This texture was created by a group of people obsessed with healthy eating. Their reasoning: "You can own it but you can't eat it, so it can't make you fat."

[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/paint_normal_BlueMarmalade.png]

Timber Camo
 
Desc: High-tech wood-based camouflage for forest and jungle operations. Just keep it away from the barbecues.

[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/paint_normal_TimberCamo.png]

Red Marmalade
 
Desc: This texture was created by a group of people obsessed with healthy eating. Their reasoning: "You can own it but you can't eat it, so it can't make you fat."

[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/paint_normal_RedMarmalade.png]

So, log into the game tomorrow and start collecting those Stars. The first stage only needs 10 Stars and will bring you the cool Storm paint, or the brand new Singapore paint if you have a Battle Pass.
 
Get ready for the February Challenge!

notes.title: Important changes to the game
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/news_forum_vk_fb.jpg]
 
[b]TL;DR: The latest update in Tanki Online brings about changes to Magnum, Shaft, Hammer, Striker, Isida and Thunder, as well as other balance fixes! Details below.[/b]
 
Tankers!
 
With the server restart at 02:00 UTC on January 25th (tomorrow), we’ll be implementing an important update that will include changes in the characteristics of some turrets and alterations, as well as some other balance fixes.
 
Here’s the full list of changes.
 
[b]Magnum[/b]
 
Slight decrease in reload time for all modifications except M0. Example: A fully-upgraded M3 will take 3 seconds to recharge instead of 3.5 seconds.
 
[b]Shaft[/b]
 
Reload time after sniper shots is 1 second faster for all modifications.
 
[b]Hammer[/b]
 
This turret remains unchanged. Changes were only made to the Duplet alteration. Now it will not give a bonus to the recharge rate. The rapid double shot, however, remains unchanged.
 
[b]Striker[/b]
 
The "Uranium" alteration was found to be too strong. So now, when equipping this alteration, Striker reloads 10% slower. No other changes.
 
[b]Isida[/b]
 
This turret has undergone several changes, not only in its standard parameters:
 
[LIST]
[*]The amount of hit points repaired has been reduced almost by half on all modifications;[/*]
[*]The "Support Nanobots" alteration now increases repairing by 100% instead of 25%;[/*]
[*]The energy gauge when repairing other tanks now gives you an additional 2.5 seconds of action;[/*]
[*]The energy gauge for attacking now gives you an additional 1 second of action;[/*]
[*]The amount of points earned when repairing allies has been increased from 10 points to 15 points.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
This has shifted the focus of Isida to make it more attack-focused, while the support function has become a secondary feature. However, repairing allies is still a viable option for earning points in battle.
 
The “Support Nanobots” alteration makes Isida more support-based for those who wish to play in this role.
 
[b]Thunder[/b]
 
Slight changes to the recently-popularized Sledgehammer Shells alteration. Maximum damage range penalty has been increased from 90% to 95%. This means you need to be even closer to the enemy to deal more damage.
 
[b]Drones[/b]
 
Following multiple reports about a mismatch between in-game and wiki details about drones, this update will be correcting any erroneous information. The price and time for upgrades is now uniform across all drones. The total costs and times for fully-upgrading drones remain unchanged.
 
[b]Weekly missions[/b]
 
Change in the distribution of weekly mission rewards. Previously, completing all 3 tasks awarded 6 regular containers and 3 weekly ones. This has now been reversed — 6 weekly containers and 3 regular ones.
 
[b]Highway Map (Matchmaking)[/b]
 
Reduced the length of the map to make it more balanced for mid-range players.
 
All the changes will be documented in detail on the Wiki in the coming days.
 
Make sure you enter the game tomorrow and check out all the changes for yourself. And don’t forget to [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=379235]give us your feedback[/url]!

notes.title: THE GAME - NY2019 Edition
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/THE_GAME_NY_2019_626_Q_mark.jpg]

Tankers!

Welcome to the New Year edition of THE GAME, our traditional quest where you can win containers, supplies, drones, a «Dream Tank» and even a tablet from our partners Prestigio.

For those who are not familiar with our quests, THE GAME is a series of riddles and puzzles spanning 5 days. Each quest day kicks off at 09:00 UTC with a special video that will provide you with your first clue/s. From there, you’ll need to solve all the riddles, guess the word of the day and submit it by putting together a puzzle.

IMPORTANT: The final word will not be considered valid if the puzzle is not assembled.

[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/THE_GAME_NY_2019_12345.png]

The quest will take place from 3rd to 8th January.

To participate, you need to register on THE GAME website using your TO account username and password here: [url=https://game.tankionline.com/en/]https://game.tankionline.com/en/[/url]

Completing the quest gives you game points, and the amount of points you get will determine your reward. You will only have one shot at submitting the correct keyword for the day.

The first participant who submits the correct answer, gets 100 points, the second 99, the third 98 and so on. From the ninetieth place onwards, players will receive 10 points each.

If you enter the wrong word, you’ll be able to correct the mistake on the final (fifth) day of THE GAME. Doing so, will grant you 5 points for every correct answer.

Participants will be given their personal result immediately after entering all the keywords on January 8.

DISCLAIMER: Some of the riddles cannot be translated into multiple languages, since the hints depend on a specific sequence of words. For this reason, there will only be two language versions of THE GAME — Russian and English.

Prizes:
[list]
[*]First place: The player with the most points will receive 500 units of each supply*, 100 gold boxes, 50 containers, a drone** and Dream Tank*** of their choice, and a tablet from our partner Prestigio.
[*]Second place: 400 units of each supply*, 80 gold boxes, 40 containers, and a drone** of the player’s choice.
[*]Third place: 300 units of each supply*, 60 gold boxes, 30 containers, a drone** of the player’s choice.
[*]Places 4-10 places: 200 units of each supply*, 20 gold boxes, 10 containers and a drone** of the player’s choice.
[*] Places 11-100 places: 50 units of each supply*, 10 gold boxes and 5 containers.
[*] Anyone who is NOT in the TOP 100 but has scored 30 or more points will receive 20 of each supply*.
[*] Tankers who have scored 25 points will receive 10 of each supply*.
[/list]

Those who do not submit all five keywords will receive no prize.

Calendar:

[list]
[*] Registration starts: January 3, 09:00 UTC - [url=https://game.tankionline.com/en/]https://game.tankionline.com/en/[/url]
[*] THE GAME begins: January 4, 09:00 UTC.
[*] Registration ends: January 7, 20:59 UTC.
[*] The final (fifth) day of the GAME starts: January 8, 09:00 UTC.
[*] Deadline for submitting keywords: January 8, 20:59 UTC.
[*] Winners announced and prizes awarded: January 9 (during the day).
[/list]

Ask questions and discuss the progress of THE GAME in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=378913]Official Forum Thread[/url].

Good luck to you, tankers!

* double damage, double armor, speed up, mine, battery, repair kits
** fully upgraded
*** "Dream Tank" consists of a fully upgraded turret, hull and protective module of the player’s choice, available at their rank

Tankers!

As a part of the [url=https://tankionline.com/en/2018/12/win-prizes-ny-marathon/]New Year Marathon[/url], we are launching the “Winter Crossword” competition.

Your task is to help Santa Claus solve a crossword puzzle and find out the password to the strongbox where he has stored the special gifts.

notes.title: Win prizes with the NY Marathon
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2018/12/ny_marathon_2018-2019_626x412_calendar.jpg]

TL;DR: Participate in a mini contest and collect points! If you can collect enough points to make it into the top 100, you’ll receive some great prizes! Details below.

Tankers!

This month, we’re celebrating the new year with a bunch of cool discounts and fun in-game features. And on top of all the exciting things happening in the game, we’re also organizing a special New Year Marathon.

Every day from the 25th to the 31st of December, you’ll be able to participate in a mini contest and collect points! If you can collect enough points to make it into the top 100, you’ll receive some great prizes.

	* 1st place: 1 alteration of your choice, 1 shot effect of your choice, 250 000 crystals, 25 containers and "Prestigio" paint.
	* 2nd place: 1 shot effect of your choice, 200 000 crystals, 20 containers and "Hero Canyon" paint.
	* 3rd place: 1 alteration of your choice, 150 000 crystals, 15 containers and "Hero Canyon" paint.
	* 4th place: 120 000 crystals, 10 containers and any animated paint of your choice.
	* 5th place: 110 000 crystals, 9 containers and any animated paint of your choice.
	* 6th place: 100 000 crystals, 8 containers and any animated paint of your choice.
	* 7th place: 90,000 crystals, 7 containers and any paint of your choice from the Shop.
	* 8th place: 80 000 crystals, 7 containers and any paint of your choice from the Shop.
	* 9th place: 70,000 crystals, 7 containers and any paint of your choice from the Shop.
	* 10th place: 60 000 crystals, 7 containers and any paint of your choice from the Shop.
	* 11th-20th place: 40 000 crystals, 5 containers and 7 days of premium account.
	* 21st-50th place: 30 000 crystals, 3 containers and 5 days of premium account.
	* 50th-100th place: 20 000 crystals, 1 container and 3 days of premium account.

Other participants who earn more than 9 points but do not make it into the TOP 100 will receive 10 000 crystals each.

The opening of each contest will be advertised in-game, on the homepage and in social media. Stay tuned!

Track your results and the current rating of the TOP 100 in [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1BWZnKW7ltZV7lhcfBHCP5_lelsOJMGs62iX7w0xx3zs/edit#gid=0]this special table[/url].

The more puzzles you attempt and the faster you finish them, the higher your position in the ranking will be.

In case of a tie, the player with the faster time will be given priority in the ranking.

The results of each contest will be summed up and published according to the dates specified in its respective terms and conditions.

The final results of the New year marathon will be published on Thursday, January 11, 2019.

Prizes for the marathon will be awarded within 48 hours after the final results are announced.

You can check the Holiday Marathon Calendar [url=https://event.tankionline.com/marathon_calendar_en/]here[/url].

Good luck!

notes.title: Free day of Premium to make up for downtime!
notes.content:
[img=https://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/voskl.png]

Yesterday, December 20th, our data servers caught a nasty case of digital flu. Because of this, the game was unstable (and often offline) multiple times between 02:00 UTC and 16:30 UTC, causing frustration among players and programmers alike.

So, in the spirit of the New Year’s celebrations, anyone who was logged into the game at any point yesterday (20th Dec) between 02:00 UTC and 16:30 UTC, will be getting one free day of premium.

The free day of Premium has already been added.

Once again, thank you for your patience and understanding.

Enjoy the holiday celebrations!
