notes.title: The War Ends!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
The first “War” event in the history of Tanki Online has ended, and the English community has won! The event was the most discussed topic on the Forum since January 2017 and the victory was achieved full 12 days after the start.
 
We congratulate all players of the EN faction, who fought tirelessly for the common triumph of the faction, ran undercover operations behind the enemy lines and coordinated the whole community in the EN Headquarters. Victory is rightfully yours!
 
We also thank all participants of the “War” for feedback on the event and suggestions how to improve it in the future. Already, event designers are collecting ideas for the next “War” and you can help architect the next War by posting in a special topic [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=369838]>>here<<[/url].
 
The next “War” will start in several months and will have the rules designed by the community: administration will work on the new event together with tankers!
 
With the winners announced, we would also like to share the numbers behind the “War”:
 
The total number of participants in the event was 258 155, and it’s split between:
[LIST]
[*]135 735 for Team RU[/*]
[*]61 998 for Team EN[/*]
[*]35 339 for Team DE[/*]
[*]25 083 for Team PL[/*]
[/LIST]
147 258 participants in total have completed at least 1 turn in the War -- by voting on the event site, destroying 200 enemy tanks in Strategy phase, and by entering the game in Battle phase to destroy or be destroyed at least once.
 
During the full event, the total number of tanks destroyed was 54 451 672!
 
The main War topic on the Forum has 72 pages of debates, but true victory was achieved in the War Room.
 
With the end of the War, players will get more than 1 007 238 containers.
 
[LIST]
[*]The prizes for the event will be sent to all participants later this week.[/*]
[*]The Dream Tank giveaway will happen on a secret Friday stream.[/*]
[*]Animated paint for the winners will be revealed later this week.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
--
 
Thank you for playing and congratulations to Team EN -- [b]YOU WON THE WAR![/b]

notes.title: Battle Indicators, PRO Rugby
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/2ab04b1bb53e2707be102d7493fc6766e0385787.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
Tomorrow, February 23rd after morning restart a new update will be released and it will finally bring new battle indicators! Here’s what’s coming:
 
[LIST]
[*]New indicators for flags and bases in CTF and ASL;[/*]
[*]Position of the enemy flag carrier can be seen from far away, but the indicator will disappear once the distance to the flag carrier becomes short;[/*]
[*]Notifications about the flag, the ball and control points being captured or dropped now have icons instead of text like “player has captured the flag” in the battle log.[/*]
[*]Other notifications in battle log -- “player joined”, “player changed equipment” and more -- will also be changed to icons;[/*]
[*]Icons for turrets in the battle log were also updated, now all kills will have a new set of icons, which was done to bring the battle interface into a common, modern style.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
[h1]Rugby on Stadium[/h1]
 
When update goes live 02:00 UTC February 23rd, you will be able to create PRO battles on the Stadium map in Rugby mode. 
 
Make your own competitions or even parkour with the ball in space -- the sky is the limit!
 
[h1]Kungur Changes[/h1]
 
As we continue to work on updating the maps, one of the oldest maps in the game has received a few changes, and it’s Kungur. Several houses on the Blue base, which were often used by flag carriers for hiding, have been moved. Now, it’s no longer possible to just camp in them. We think this change is fair, and makes team play on Kungur more balanced, since the Red team doesn’t have such tactical hiding spots.
 
[h1]Chat Channel “War”[/h1]
 
Also for the duration of the global event “War” a new chat channel with the same name was added to the game, so it’s easier for factions to coordinate their actions.
 
[h1]Flag Respawn Bugfix[/h1]
 
We have also fixed the bug, where a player with the flag could be destroyed and then would spawn with the flag or the ball still in possession.
 
--
 
These are the changes that will go live on Friday, February 23rd with server restart at 02:00 UTC. We look forward to your feedback on the new indicators and later today we have one more event!

notes.title: The War Begins
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers! 
 
Faction paints are already in the Garage, and this means the War is almost here!
 
Purchase one of the faction paints, log into the after server restart on February 22nd and jump into battles!
 
[b]NOTE:[/b] the War site will go live tomorrow, 02:00 UTC February 22nd, and you will find it [url=https://war.tankionline.com/]>>here<<[/url].
 
Here’s a quick recap how to participate in the event: 
 
[LIST=1]
	[*]Purchase a faction paint in the Garage.[/*]
	[*]Log into the event site. You can use the login and password from your account in Tanki Online or using your Facebook account, if your game account is attached to it.[/*]
	[*]Vote for 2 territories to attack and for 1 territory to defend on the site for the War.[/*]
	[*]Make 200 kills or more in standard, non-PRO battles within 24 hours on any map, in any mode, using any equipment.[/*]
	[*]On the next day play in standard, non-PRO battles, destroy as many enemy tanks as possible and avoid destruction.[/*]
	[*]Repeat steps 3, 4 and 5 until the War is over.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
We remind you, that the War is a global event in which 4 regions of the game -- the English, the German, the Polish and the Russian communities -- battle for supremacy on the map of a fictional world and collect resources to launch a Nuclear Rocket, located at the center of the map. Playing the War will earn you lots of containers, and if your faction wins -- a unique animated paint, which will remain in Garages of all participants of the winning faction that made 5 turns or more until the next War.
 
The War is played in a turn-based format, where each turn lasts for 48 hours and consists of 2 phases - Strategy phase and Battle phase. To participate in the War, you need to buy a faction paint in the Garage for 100 crystals. The event will take place part on the special site for the War, which will be launched February 22nd, and to log into the site you can use your TO login and password.
 
Strategy phase:
 
[LIST]
[*]Lasts for the first 24 hours of the turn;[/*]
[*]During Strategy phase, you need to vote for 2 territories to attack and for 1 territory to defend on the event site;[/*]
[*]You need to confirm your vote by making 200 kills or more in the game in standard, non-PRO battles (either before or after voting, but only during the Strategy phase);[/*]
[*]If you don’t make 200 kills during Strategy phase, your vote and K/D will not be counted in the Battle phase of that turn.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
Battle phase:
 
[LIST]
[*]Lasts for the second part of the turn -- also 24 hours;[/*]
[*]During the Battle phase factions compete over territories that were voted by the players during the Strategy phase;[/*]
[*]Depending on the choice your faction made, you will need to make enough kills together as a faction and/or maintain a high K/D, so you can capture a new territory or defend your own against invasion.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
There are special territories with Survey Data Centers and Rocket Fuel Factories. If you capture such territories, they will begin to earn your faction respective resources -- Survey Data and Rocket Fuel. Also, each turn all factions earn 1 point of both resources from their Capitals. The income from the identical regions is summarized.
 
To win the War, you need to complete ALL 3 goals:
 
[LIST]
[*]Collect 10 points of each resource;[/*]
[*]Capture the central region with the Nuclear Rocket;[/*]
[*]Hold the territory with the Rocket for 1 full turn.[/*]
[/LIST]

notes.title: St. Valentine's Day
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/efa2708daefed4c55a1c3c7415c67511ab3e9c35.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
Spring is drawing near, Sun is shining brighter, and you have more occasions to give each other a gift of smiles and happiness! And the perfect mood starts with the most romantic holiday of the year — St. Valentine’s Day! Don’t miss your chance to celebrate the holiday together with a special tanker and holiday gifts, discounts and festive decorations!
 
[h1]Holiday decorations[/h1]
 
Share your true feelings or give a thoughtful note to a special tanker by sending holiday themed gifts, and in battles special festive Gold Boxes, drop zones, parachutes and billboards full of hearts will keep the mood light — especially if you wear holiday paint!
 
 
[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/valentine_2018-1.png]
 
 
For the most romantic tankers we’ve also prepared something special: St. Valentine’s themed animated paint!
 
 
[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/giphy.gif]
 
 
You can find this special paint only in the holiday bundle in the Shop, and you can scroll down to see the full list of items in the bundle below.
 
After St. Valentine’s celebrations end, the paint will also be added to containers.
 
[h1]Gold Boxes[/h1]
 
During the whole holiday event, [b]from 02:00 UTC February 14th till 02:00 UTC February 18th[/b], love will be falling from the sky for all tankers as Gold Boxes will drop 3 times more often in all regular, non-PRO battles. 
 
[h1]Special offers[/h1]
 
2 special holiday offers will appear in the Shop after server restart [b]02:00 UTC on February 14th[/b] and will be available for purchase until 02:00 UTC on February 18th. One of the offers has a whole set of in-game bonuses, and the other -- new animated paint and 10 containers!
 
[u]Special offer 1:[/u]
[LIST]
[*]New animated paint “Beating Hearts”;[/*]
[*]10 containers;[/*]
[*]25,000 crystals.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
[u]Special offer 2:[/u]
[LIST]
[*]5 days of Premium;[/*]
[*]5 Gold Boxes;[/*]
[*]100 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes);[/*]
[*]100,000 crystals.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
[h1]Discounts[/h1]
 
Every tanker knows and waits for the best part of the holidays — the discounts. Only during St. Valentine’s  celebrations (from [b]02:00 UTC February 14th until 02:00 UTC February 15th[/b]) don’t miss big discounts in the Shop and in the Garage!
 
Items in the Shop will have a [b]20% discount[/b], excluding containers and the smallest packs of crystals, Premium and Gold Boxes.
 
Items in the Garage will have a [b]30% discount[/b], excluding kits and PRO battle passes.
 
Also, only on February 14th, upgrade your equipment with a [b]25% discount[/b] on MicroUpgrades and [b]50% discount[/b] on SpeedUps!
 
[b]NOTE:[/b] discounts do not apply to purchases and upgrades of XT-equipment, clan license, Rename Pass and special offers in the Shop.
 
--
 
 
Play the game on February 14th and celebrate St. Valentine’s Day with Tanki!

notes.title: War Herald, Issue #3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
This issue of the War Herald is the last before the event starts, as the launch of a special site, faction paints and the War itself will come to the game very soon!
 
In the last issue we will share details about prizes and answer more questions about the rules of the War.
 
[h1]The War Spoils[/h1]
 
In the previous issue we’ve answered some of the questions about how to win prizes in the War, let’s recap the main points:
[LIST]
[*]All players who participate in the War will earn rewards;[/*]
[*]The more turns you complete in the event, the bigger is your final prize;[/*]
[*]On the global map there are special territories with one-time bonuses for the first faction that captured the territory;[/*]
[*]Among prizes are containers and unique animated paint for the winners;[/*]
[*]All prizes will be delivered when the War ends.[/*]
[/LIST]
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] to receive prizes you need to confirm your vote during the Strategy phase and contribute to the overall faction kills during the Battle phase.
 
[b]Completed turn[/b] is a turn, where you’ve made 200 kills or more in regular, non-PRO battles during 24 hours of the Strategy phase and voted for 2 territories to be attacked, 1 territory to be defended. Don’t forget, without confirming your vote by making 200 kills or more in Strategy phase, your contribution to faction progress during the Battle phase will not be counted and at the end of that turn your final prize will not increase.
 
Now, let’s get down to the real important topic — how big are the prizes.
 
Each player, regardless of faction or who wins in the War, at the end of the event will receive 3 containers for each completed turn.
 
Successful attack on a territory with one-time bonus will earn the attackers 10 containers, and attacking a territory with a big one-time bonus will earn the attackers 20 containers. The crucial part to receive the containers is that you need to confirm your vote during the Strategy phase of that day by making 200 kills or more and voting on the site. You will always see the size of the bonus on the global map on the event site.
 
Players of the winning faction in the War will receive a special, unique animated paint and 3 additional containers for each completed turn, meaning 6 per turn in total, but not exceeding the overall number of 100 container at the end of the event. And the best part — all tankers of the winning faction will enter a giveaway for a Dream Tank*!
 
*to be eligible for the Dream Tank giveaway you need to complete 5 turns or more
 
Start devising wartime strategies, choose faction leaders and pick first targets for the attack — the War is almost here!
 
And to help you gather the War officers and recruits in one place, we will soon open a new, limited-time Forum section for all discussions about the War.
 
Stay tuned.
 
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 
[i]Why only the EN, DE, PL and RU regions are participating in the War? Why not add all regions and all countries to the event? [/i]
In the European battle cluster of Tanki Online there are only 4 regions — the English, the German, the Polish and the Russian communities, meaning only these 4 regions are playing on the same servers. The global faction lines are drawn and transferred to the event without any political meaning, for the event to work right now we can run it only in 1 battle cluster and among already existing localisations.
 
[i]Do I need to make kills and maintain high K/D on some specific maps in Tanki? [/i]
No. For your kills to count, you can play on any map in regular, non-PRO battles. The regions on the global map are named after maps only for convenience, you DON’T need to play on Kungur to vote for it.
 
[i]Can it happen, that a faction will lose all of its territories, including the Capital?[/i]
Yes, it might happen, and the faction will be excluded from the rest of the War.
 
[i]Do we have to defend our Capitals like regular territories?[/i]
Yes, you need to protect your Capital the same way as any conquered territory.
 
[i]When the phases of each turn begin and end in real life?[/i]
Each phase lasts for 24 hours and begins with the server restart of that day at 02:00 UTC. 
 
[i]Are there breaks or pauses between the turns?[/i]
There are no breaks in War.
 
[i]Which in-game stats will be counted towards completing objectives during the Battle phase? [/i]
Kills and deaths made in regular, non-PRO battles during the 24-hours period of the Battle phase (second part of the turn) will be counted.

notes.title: War Herald, Issue #3
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
This issue of the War Herald is the last before the event starts, as the launch of a special site, faction paints and the War itself will come to the game very soon!
 
In the last issue we will share details about prizes and answer more questions about the rules of the War.
 
[h1]The War Spoils[/h1]
 
In the previous issue we’ve answered some of the questions about how to win prizes in the War, let’s recap the main points:
[LIST]
[*]All players who participate in the War will earn rewards;[/*]
[*]The more turns you complete in the event, the bigger is your final prize;[/*]
[*]On the global map there are special territories with one-time bonuses for the first faction that captured the territory;[/*]
[*]Among prizes are containers and unique animated paint for the winners;[/*]
[*]All prizes will be delivered when the War ends.[/*]
[/LIST]
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] to receive prizes you need to confirm your vote during the Strategy phase and contribute to the overall faction kills during the Battle phase.
 
[b]Completed turn[/b] is a turn, where you’ve made 200 kills or more in regular, non-PRO battles during 24 hours of the Strategy phase and voted for 2 territories to be attacked, 1 territory to be defended. Don’t forget, without confirming your vote by making 200 kills or more in Strategy phase, your contribution to faction progress during the Battle phase will not be counted and at the end of that turn your final prize will not increase.
 
Now, let’s get down to the real important topic — how big are the prizes.
 
Each player, regardless of faction or who wins in the War, at the end of the event will receive 3 containers for each completed turn.
 
Successful attack on a territory with one-time bonus will earn the attackers 10 containers, and attacking a territory with a big one-time bonus will earn the attackers 20 containers. The crucial part to receive the containers is that you need to confirm your vote during the Strategy phase of that day by making 200 kills or more and voting on the site. You will always see the size of the bonus on the global map on the event site.
 
Players of the winning faction in the War will receive a special, unique animated paint and 3 additional containers for each completed turn, meaning 6 per turn in total, but not exceeding the overall number of 100 container at the end of the event. And the best part — all tankers of the winning faction will enter a giveaway for a Dream Tank*!
 
*to be eligible for the Dream Tank giveaway you need to complete 5 turns or more
 
Start devising wartime strategies, choose faction leaders and pick first targets for the attack — the War is almost here!
 
And to help you gather the War officers and recruits in one place, we will soon open a new, limited-time Forum section for all discussions about the War.
 
Stay tuned.
 
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 
[i]Why only the EN, DE, PL and RU regions are participating in the War? Why not add all regions and all countries to the event? [/i]
In the European battle cluster of Tanki Online there are only 4 regions — the English, the German, the Polish and the Russian communities, meaning only these 4 regions are playing on the same servers. The global faction lines are drawn and transferred to the event without any political meaning, for the event to work right now we can run it only in 1 battle cluster and among already existing localisations.
 
[i]Do I need to make kills and maintain high K/D on some specific maps in Tanki? [/i]
No. For your kills to count, you can play on any map in regular, non-PRO battles. The regions on the global map are named after maps only for convenience, you DON’T need to play on Kungur to vote for it.
 
[i]Can it happen, that a faction will lose all of its territories, including the Capital?[/i]
Yes, it might happen, and the faction will be excluded from the rest of the War.
 
[i]Do we have to defend our Capitals like regular territories?[/i]
Yes, you need to protect your Capital the same way as any conquered territory.
 
[i]When the phases of each turn begin and end in real life?[/i]
Each phase lasts for 24 hours and begins with the server restart of that day at 02:00 UTC. 
 
[i]Are there breaks or pauses between the turns?[/i]
There are no breaks in War.
 
[i]Which in-game stats will be counted towards completing objectives during the Battle phase? [/i]
Kills and deaths made in regular, non-PRO battles during the 24-hours period of the Battle phase (second part of the turn) will be counted.
 
[i]How does it look? The brand-new animated paint made specially and only for the winners of the new global event the War?[/i]
Our artists are still working on the paint, and it takes so long to finish that we hope you will be very pleased with the final result, which we will share as soon as it's ready.

notes.title: War Herald, Issue #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
We see a lot of excitement around the event, and even more questions about how it works. This is the first time we are making such a massive event, and today we will share with you how the War will be played, answer questions about the Battle phase, rewards and more.
 
To remind you, the War is played in a turn-based format, where each turn lasts for 48 hours and consists of 2 phases — Strategy phase, and Battle phase.
 

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Capitals_48_hours-768x432.jpg]
 
 
Let’s recap the Strategy phase and its key moments:
 
[LIST]
[*]Strategy phase is on for 24 hours;[/*]
[*]During this phase, you need to vote for 2 territories to be attacked, and for 1 territory to be defended on a special site for the event;[/*]
[*]You confirm your vote by destroying 200 enemy tanks or more during the Strategy phase (within 24 hours after the turn starts);[/*]
[*]Important! If you don’t confirm your vote by making 200 kills, both your vote and the kills you make during the next phase will NOT be counted.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
[b]NOTE: [/b]You can play and destroy enemy tanks while wearing [b]any[/b] paint, but you need to buy the faction paint once to be counted among the ranks of that faction.
 
After the Strategy phase comes time for action — the Battle phase!
 
[h1]Battle phase. The Rules[/h1]
 
When Strategy phase ends and your faction has chosen which territories to attack and what territory to defend, players will receive battle missions. There are 2 kinds of battle missions:
 
The «Breach» scenario is applied when:
[LIST]
[*]You need to capture neutral, unclaimed territories[/*]
[*]You need to capture undefended territories of the enemy[/*]
[/LIST]
 
In this scenario you need to make a certain number of kills together, as a faction. The specific number of required kills is calculated based on what region is the target, and how active your faction was during the Strategy phase. If you complete the missions, that territory will belong to you now.
 
The «Destruction» scenario is applied when:
[LIST]
[*]You need to attack a defended enemy territory [/*]
[*]You need to attack the same enemy territory with several factions[/*]
[/LIST]
 
In this scenario one or more factions attack the same territory, or several factions battle for the territory that is defended by another faction. Among the attacking factions one will be chosen based on the highest average K/D, and that faction will capture the region.
 
 
[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/K_D-768x432.jpg]
 
 
K/D for the faction is calculated from the overall number of kills and deaths of all players for that faction, who completed and voted in Strategy phase and played during the 24 hours of the Battle phase.
 
[h1]Resources. The Rules[/h1]
 
In the first issue of the War Herald we’ve shared that you need to collect resources to win. Each turn factions will get 1 point of each resource from their Capitals.
 

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/resources_from_capital-768x432.jpg]
 
 
On the global map you will find regions with Survey Data Centers and Rocket Fuel Factories, capturing them will earn you one of the resources every turn. The income from the regions of the same type will be summarized. For example, a Capital, 2 Rocket Fuel Factories and 1 Survey Data Center will earn you 3 points of Rocket Fuel, and 2 points of Survey Data. To earn the resource you need to capture that type of region and hold it for 1 full turn.
 

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/resouces_2_3-1024x576.jpg]
 
 
Capitals can also be captured. If you lose your Capital, it will begin to earn resources for your enemies. 
 

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/Capitals-1024x576.jpg]
 
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 
[i]When will the War begin?[/i]
The start of the War is planned for February, closer to the end of the month. Follow the news on the Forum and we’ll share the dates soon!
 
[i]When can I buy faction paints and when will the special site be up? [/i]
Right before the War starts — closer to the end of February.
 
[i]Where can buy a faction paint? How much will it cost? [/i]
Faction paints will cost 100 crystals and appear in the Garage.
 
[i]Which rank do I need to have to participate in the War and buy the paints?[/i]
Master-Sergeant or higher.
 
[i]Can I buy factions paints that are not my region?[/i]
Yes, you can.
 
[i]Do I need to join the War event from the start or can I join after it has begun?[/i]
You can buy faction paints and participate at any point while the event is live.
 
[i]Do I have to participate in each turn of the War?[/i]
Not necessarily. Players can complete any number of turns, and you can skip turns, but remember that the size of your prize depends on the number of completed turns.
 
[i]Can I buy all or several faction paints at the same time?[/i]
No. After purchasing 1 faction paint, the rest will be removed from the Garage.
 
[i]Will the faction paints remain after the War ends?[/i]
No. The winning faction will receive a unique paint, and it will remain until the next War, which we will talk about later.
 
[i]How long will the War go on?[/i]
It will depend on how fast the factions will collect resources and how fast they reach the Nuclear Rocket, and it’s not possible to give a specific duration. We predict the event will be active for close to 3 weeks.
 
[i]What are the rewards?[/i]
Among the rewards are containers for each turn you complete and a special, unique animated paint for the winners of the War. The paint will be rewarded to all participants of the winning faction until the next War. The final list of prizes will be announced in the next issue of the War Herald.
 
[i]Does the size of rewards depend on your contribution to the faction?[/i]
The more turns you complete the bigger will be the final prize.
 
[i]Will there be rewards for players of the factions that lost in the War?[/i]
Each player will receive the prizes for each special territories that was captured and also for each completed turn.
 
[i]What are these special territories? Which rewards will be given for capturing them? When will I receive them? [/i]
Some territories on the global map have a one-time bonus for the faction that captures it first. What rewards are given for capturing them we will announce in the next issue of the War Herald. The rewards will be given out after the War has ended.
 
[i]Can I participate in the War from multiple accounts?[/i]
Yes.
 
[i]How to log in to the special site for the War, if I don’t have the password for my account (for example, I play on Facebook or on Steam)?[/i]
If you’re playing Tanki on Facebook, you will be able to log in using Facebook, and for Steam and other partner services please contact the support to attach email and set password.
 
[i]Do we have to make the kills on some special maps?[/i]
No, it can be any map and in any mode, using any weapons and any paint. The only requirements are: you need to purchase any faction paint first, and play in non-PRO.
 
[i]How to know if I completed the kills goal?[/i]
On the special site there won’t be a specific number of kills counter, like X/200, but you will be able to check if you have made enough kills or not. During Battle phase, the global goal for kills is given to the whole faction, and you will see a special indicator on the site.
 
[i]Where do the factions start on the global map?[/i]
Each faction starts from the location, where its Capital is based.
 
[i]What happens to the faction that loses its Capital?[/i]
It will continue to play in the War, but the resources from the Capital will now go to the enemy faction that captured it.
 
[i]What happens if I buy a faction paint, but don’t vote and make no kills?[/i]
You won’t contribute nor harm your faction, and what happens to prizes if your faction wins we will share in the next issue of the War Herald.
 
[i]What happens, if you vote during the Strategy phase, but don’t make 200 kills in the same day?[/i]
Your vote and battle results will not be counted in the Battle phase.
 
[i]Do I need to make 200 kills before or after the voting?[/i]
Doesn’t matter, as long as 200 kills are made same day until the Strategy phase ends.
 
[i]Will tank kills count if they are not in faction paints?[/i]
Yes, your own gear and the gear of your enemy do not affect the kills.
 
[i]What will happen, if I destroy tanks of my own faction?[/i]
Both your kills and the deaths of your teammates will be counted in the overall statistics in both phases, canceling each other out.

notes.title: War Herald, Issue #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3bc1972934be6382a04352e3df7343f01890aca5.jpg[/img]
 
Tankers!
 
We’ve already [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=368489]written[/url] about the new global event in Tanki where 4 game regions — the English, the German, the Polish and the Russian communities — will battle for supremacy on a world map of a fictional world (this is NOT a map inside Tanki Online).
 
The battle will take place on a special website, which will be launched before the start of the event. Your goal is to choose a side and lead it to victory, and it will require not only the skills in the game, but also the ability to make the right tactical decision, and everyone can contribute to the success of their team!
 
[h1]How to participate[/h1]
 
[LIST]
[*]Buy one of the 4 faction paints for 100 crystals in the Garage[/*]
[/LIST]

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/War_event_paints.png]
[LIST]
[*]Log into the special site by entering your nickname and password for an account in Tanki Online. [b]IMPORTANT![/b] Make sure you came to the right website and only from the official sources, and NOT, for example, from a link in the chat.[/*]
[*]Be ready to wage war together with your friends![/*]
[/LIST]
 
[h1]Battle operations[/h1]
 
The «War» is played in a turn-based format, where each turn lasts for 48 hours and consists of 2 phases:
 
[LIST]
[*][b]Strategy phase[/b][/*]
[/LIST]
 
Participants will plan ahead their actions: you need to choose 2 regions for attack (targeted regions must be connected to the territory already belonging to your faction) and 1 region of your own faction for defense against enemy forces. The vote will happen on the special site for the War. On the same site you will be able to track progress of all 4 factions in the War.
 
This phase will end after 24 hours.
 
At the end of the Strategy phase each army will attack 2 regions, which received the most votes on the site during that day. What region to defend is chosen the same way.
 
[b]To confirm the vote[/b], you need to make 200 kills or more while wearing the faction paint*.
 
*your vote will be counted ONLY if you make 200 kills or more in the faction paint
 
[LIST]
[*][b]Battle phase[/b][/*]
[/LIST]
 
On the second day of each turn the goal of all participants is to play most effectively, maintaining a high K/D ratio to support your faction, and also to make the kill quota by working together — this means both the pros and the beginners can help factions to win!
 
[h1]How to win[/h1]
 
The global goal for each faction is to collect resources (Survey Data and Rocket Fuel), and to capture and defend for 1 full turn the central region of the map with the Nuclear Rocket. Capturing the Nuclear Rocket IS possible before you collect enough resources to win, but your faction will need to hold it for 1 more turn after your collect the necessary resources.

[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/res.png]
Every turn all factions will earn 1 point of both resources from their Capital cities. There are special regions on the map with Survey Data Centers and Rocket Fuel Factories, which will earn you 1 point of both resources every turn.
 
 
[img=http://tankionline.com/ru/wp-content/uploads/2018/02/piece_of_the_map.jpg]
 
 
Additionally, there are several regions with a one-time bonus, and after you capture one of these regions, all players who contributed to its capture by participating in the Strategy and Battle phases will earn in-game prizes!
 
To win the War, you need to complete ALL 3 conditions:
 
[LIST]
[*]Collect 10 points of each resource; [/*]
[*]Capture the central region with the rocket;[/*]
[*]Hold the region with the rocket for 1 full turn.[/*]
[/LIST]
 
The winners will get containers, crystals, rare paints and will reign over the world!
 
That’s all details for today. Who will you fight for in the War? And if you have any questions about the event — post them here, we will answer them in the next issue of the War Herald!
 
When will the War start will be announced closer to the launch of the event.
 
[b]IMPORTANT:[/b] «War» — is a team battle, and to win all tankers of the same faction need to coordinate their efforts. You can do it using any available option: in the Chat, on the Forum, on the official Facebook page and in Twitter replies. For each region a new section of the Forum will be added just for this purpose, using the official language of the region, and you will be able to post strategies, choose territories for capture and coordinate battles together.
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
 
[i]When will the War begin?[/i]
The start of the event is planned for the middle of February, and we’ll announce dates later. 
 
[i]Which paints will I need to buy?[/i]
Specially for the event we’ve made 4 unique paints, which symbolize one of the factions of the European regions of Tanki Online.
 
[i]When will the paints be available for purchase? How much will they cost?[/i]
All 4 regional paints will appear in the Garage a few days before the War begins. They will cost 100 crystals each.
 
[i]Which modes will count for the War?[/i]
You can play any mode to count the kills for the War, but only in regular, non-PRO battles and while wearing the faction paint. 
 
[i]Is there a rank restriction for participating in the War? [/i]
Only players who reached the rank of Master Sergeant and above can participate. 
 
[i]On which map do I need to play for the event?[/i]
You will need to make kills in Tanki Online, but to make turns and capture territories you will need to go to the special site with a map of a fictional world. 
 
[i]Where can I find the special site for the event? [/i]
We will post the link in the news about the start of the event.
 
[i]Will the team with the most players win?[/i]
No. To win in the War, you need to maintain a high K/D ratio and strategically choose which territories to capture and defend, and not only make enough kills, so the chances are equal.

notes.title: Rugby Mode coming January 27th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/3782db6563b259283d3497f22dc54c880cb96f9e.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
With the server restart tomorrow, [b]02:00 UTC January 27th[/b] Rugby mode will be finally released!
 
[h1]What is Rugby[/h1]
 
In Rugby battles each map has two bases — Red and Blue — and several drop zones for the ball. The ball will be dropped in one of these zones, chosen randomly, and it will have a parachute, similar to supply drops. The goal for each team is to pick up the ball and bring it to enemy base.
 
The coolest feature of the mode is the ability to pass the ball to another player. If you press the F key (or the key you bind to dropping the flag), the ball will shoot in the direction your turret is currently facing, and it will bounce from any obstacles. This way, you can pass the ball over a low obstacle or an enemy tank.
 
If you see an enemy running away with the ball, you absolutely should destroy them, as you will be able to pick up the ball and begin your own attack.
 
Rugby mode will be available only in regular, non-PRO battles. A new button will be added to the Lobby, which will join you to a new Rugby match, and Battle List will also receive a new filter button for Rugby mode. Battles in Rugby mode will have a short name RGB. In PRO battles the new mode will appear at a later date — after we add the new updated maps to PRO battles.
 
[h1]New RGB\ASL missions
Super missions disabled[/h1]
 
With the release of Rugby mode new missions will be added to the pool of daily missions, and new missions will have the same goal “Earn experience” or “Earn crystals” as missions for other modes, but now they will include Assault and Rugby.
 
Also, as previously announced new super missions “Destroy 9999 enemies” and “Earn 99999 experience in battles” will be disabled with the release of Rugby mode on January 27th.
 
[b]NOTE:[/b] Remember, if you already have a super mission, it will stay on your account until XT-skins are released. Only new super missions will be disabled 02:00 UTC January 27th.
 
***
 
Play Rugby mode, share your take on the new mode and good luck on the field, tankers! :)
 
 
[h1]Rugby FAQ[/h1]
 
[b][i]Is it possible to catch the ball while it’s in the air?[/i][/b]
Yes.
 
[b][i]What happens to the ball, if the player who has it gets destroyed?[/i][/b]
The ball will drop on the ground in the same place.
 
[b][i]What happens to the ball, if nobody is picking it up?[/i][/b]
If it arrived on a parachute to a drop zone and nobody has picked it up yet, it will remain in place indefinitely. If it was dropped by a player or from a pass, after a time it will disappear.
 
[b][i]Why is the ball exploding?[/i][/b]
It is the effect for when the ball disappears. The explosion doesn’t apply damage to anyone, it’s only a visual effect.
 
[b][i]What happens when the ball is stuck in a place nobody can reach?[/i][/b]
After some time, it will disappear and respawn at a drop zone.
 
[b][i]Can I score a goal by passing the ball through the capture point at the enemy base?[/i][/b]
No, you need to deliver the ball as a tank, like flag in CTF.
 
[b][i]The ball flew straight through the wall! :o[/i][/b]
Do not panic, this is a bug, please make a screenshot where it happened.
 
[b][i]Can the indicators for the ball drop zones on the map be disabled?[/i][/b]
No, and “Show Gold Drop Zones” option in settings will not apply to Rugby battles. 
 
[b][i]Can I change the key for passing the ball in control settings?[/i][/b]
Yes, you can, and remember, passing the ball in RGB is the same button (F by default) as dropping flags in ASL and CTF.

notes.title: New Year in Tanki Online
New Year in Tanki Online
Tanki Awards 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/84ae2dcba4e1c65fdfbfce6218a95b95fb94085a.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
The holiday celebrations start very soon, but the main event begins now!
 
Until the end of December, choose Best Tankers of the Year and enter a special giveaway!
 
[h1]The Rules[/h1]
 
To vote for Best Tankers of the Year you need to use a special form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSc77m2U-4sViFTEJeEL3UTuja-tMf5DALlUW-SYOdz3mErZNA/viewform
 
You can only vote once, so make sure your voice helps the right person!
 
All votes will be split among 6 categories:
[list] 
[*]Best eSports Clan
[*]Best Parkour Club
[*]Best Artist
[*]Best Writer
[*]Best Video Maker 
[*]Best Tanki Player
[/list] 
Each category, except Best Player, has a list of names picked by the judges from the most active, prominent and positive players in the English community of Tanki Online in 2017.
 
And for the Best Tanki Player, we give you the ultimate choice — type in any nickname. It can be you, it can be your friend, or it can be the player you truly want to win the title. 
 
Tanki Awards 2017 Voting will be closed on December 29th, and on December 30th the players with the most votes in each category will win!*
 
*Player of the Year is a stellar example of the best qualities of Tanki Online community, and if the voted player has any bans in the past 6 months, or shows rude behaviour in the game, the vote for that person will not be counted and the next player will win.
 
[h1]The Prizes[/h1]
 
Now, the best part — the prizes and a special giveaway! 
 
Top 3 votes in each category* will receive:
 
1st place: 30.000 crystals, 3 containers and 3 days of Premium
2nd place: 20.000 crystals, 2 containers and 2 days of Premium
3rd place: 10.000 crystals, 1 container and 1 day of Premium
 
*if the category is Best Clan or Best Club, all members of the official clan that are in the clan list on December 29th will be eligible.
 
[h1]The Giveaway[/h1]
 
And if you are not in the list for any category, you have a chance to win just by voting!
 
From all who submit their votes by December 29th, we will randomly pick 20 lucky tankers who will receive an additional, bonus prize - 1 container and 1 day of Premium each!
 
[h1]The Results[/h1]
 
Tanki Awards 2017 Voting closes on December 29th, 18:00 UTC.
 
The Results will be posted in this topic on December 30th, 18:00 UTC.
 
The Prizes will be delivered to all winners by January 4th, 18:00 UTC.
 
---
 
Happy Holidays and the coming New Year!
 
Good luck :)

notes.title: Assault Mode arrives December 13th
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/4788b90fad23a6668d3dd09281c164baba7b57dd.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
Earlier we announced a new mode — Assault — that will be added to the game soon. 
 
Good news! After server restart on Wednesday, 02:00 UTC December 13th, Assault mode will be released — just in time for the holidays!
 
To remind you, the new mode will be available only on the new maps, meaning you will be able to access Assault by pressing “Play!” on the game mode button in the Lobby.
 
In Assault mode the blue team defends, and the red team — attacks. Defence needs to protect a point where the attackers want to plant a flag. It’s very simple, but super fun! In PRO-battles the mode will appear only after new maps are added to PRO-battles.
 
After analyzing data from the most recent update, we’ve also made a few changes to the new maps, to improve team balance in time for the release of Assault.
 
Join the new battles tomorrow and tell us what you think about the new mode!

notes.title: «15 Seconds to New Year» contest launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/890854cfe72467838fd881487fa6ba3476295952.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

The holidays are a couple of weeks away, and this means it’s time to kick off our winter contest with well wishes to fellow tankers — «15 Seconds to New Year»! Enter and win crystals, Gold Boxes, Premium and even containers! So what are you waiting for? 

Right, the rules!

[b]To participate you need to:[/b]
[list]
[*]Carefully read all of the following rules, at least once;
[*]Record a video, wishing Happy New Year to all tankers;
[*]Upload the video to YouTube;
[*]Send us the link via the special [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQPXGqipbNS2EIzCnBfqzoXaqm72HF-WD9xubF7KjOMWLEMQ/viewform]contest form[/url].
[/list]
[b]Video requirements:[/b]
[list]
[*]You must appear in the video, meaning YOU in real life, not your tank in the game;
[*]The video must be no longer than 15 seconds*;
[*]The video must be recorded specifically for the contest;
[*]Your contest entry must not break any of the Game Rules and international law;
[*]All of the rights to the video are transferred to the contest organizer upon submitting the video through the special [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdQPXGqipbNS2EIzCnBfqzoXaqm72HF-WD9xubF7KjOMWLEMQ/viewform]contest form[/url]. The contest organizer does not hold any responsibility for injuries or damages caused by participant.
[/list]
*the maximum extra video length is 1 second, videos 17 second or longer will be disqualified.

[b]The winners will be chosen based on:[/b]
[list]
[*]Originality (idea behind the video);
[*]Humor (silly, cheerful, the good kind);
[*]Production (video quality, lightning, edits).
[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b]
[list]
[*]1st place: 100.000 crystals, 20 Gold Boxes, 10 containers and Tanki branded t-shirt and coffee mug;
[*]2nd place: 70.000 crystals, 15 Gold Boxes, 7 containers and Tanki branded t-shirt and coffee mug;
[*]3rd place: 50.000 crystals, 10 Gold Boxes, 5 containers and Tanki branded t-shirt and coffee mug;
[*]4th-10th place: 20.000 crystals, 5 Gold Boxes and 3 containers;
[/list]

[b]Dates:[/b]
[list]
[*]Contest entries are accepted until 21:00 UTC on December 25th.
[*]The winners will be announced on December 28th during the day.
[/list]
And here are examples of the videos from the past years:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=npQdpNwSMo4

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=USd2ASzM7FA

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ywx_BiFofkk

---

Good luck!

notes.title: Double Funds and Crazy Weekend
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/a8635f98601001ee5c7d14548084db942a9a8d41.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

The winter holidays are almost here, and to make the time fly we've prepared for you something special — Double Battle Funds, Triple Gold Drops and Crazy Weekend… with containers!

[h1]X2 Battle Funds and X3 Gold Drops[/h1]

Ready to jump into the weekend? [b]From 02:00 UTC on December 9th till 02:00 UTC on December 10th[/b] play Tanki and earn Double Battle Funds in all regular, non-PRO battles, and Gold Boxes will drop 3 times more often! That’s 100% extra funds for every battle!

[b]NOTE:[/b] Regular battles are all battles accessed by pressing game mode buttons in the Lobby and battles in the Battle List that don’t have a “star” or a “trophy” icon next to their name.

[h1]Crazy Weekend — with Containers[/h1]

But to make the weekend truly epic, we’re launching Crazy Weekend with new prizes!

[b]From 21:00 UTC on Friday, December 8th till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, December 10th[/b] you will need to destroy enough tanks in regular, non-PRO battles within 48 hours. 

For the first time the kills you make during the event will be shown on a special site here!

We listen, and from now on every Crazy Weekend will have special site where you can check the number of your kills and Top 10 players. Just type the name — get the kills.

[b]NOTE:[/b] The info on the site is updated [b]once every hour[/b]. If you check your progress right after battle, it will not be updated yet, so come back later!

Don’t forget, the more kills you make, the bigger are the prizes, and this time we have very special rewards for all Kill Tiers:
[list]
[*]Kill Tier 1: 400 - 799 kills - 3 Containers*
[*]Kill Tier 2: 800 - 1999 kills - 5 Containers + 3 days of Premium* + chance to win Dream Tank
[*]Kill Tier 3: 2000+ kills - 10 Containers + 5 days of Premium* + Lion T-D Protection Module + chance to win Dream Tank
[/list]
*Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest.

That’s right, destroy 400 tanks or more [b]from 21:00 UTC on Friday, December 8th till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, December 10th[/b] and you will get THE containers from Black Friday.

[b]NOTE:[/b] As always, kills are counted only in regular, NON-PRO battles.

Additionally, among all tankers who make more than 800 kills we’ll be randomly choosing 2 lucky players who will receive a Dream Tank (chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at their level, fully upgraded, including XT items).

The names of the lucky winners will be announced on Tuesday, December 12th.

Have a great weekend! :)

---

[h1]Terms and Conditions[/h1]
[list]
[*]Prizes cannot be exchanged for crystals or any other in-game items.
[*]Lion T-D protection modules will only be added to the players who reach the rank of Master-Sergeant rank at the moment the event ends, and if the players do not have the module.
[*]If your rank is lower than Master-Sergeant or you already have the module, there is no additional reward or compensation.
[*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Containers, 5 days of Premium and 1 module.
[*]Kills can be made in any combination of hull, turret and protection module.
[*]The kills for Crazy Weekend must be made in regular, non-PRO battles.
[*]Clarification: regular battles can be accessed by pressing game mode buttons in the Lobby or from the Battle List, if they do not have a "star" or a "trophy" icon.
[*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC on Friday, December 8th, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, December 10th (full duration of the event is 48 hours).
[*]The winners of the Dream Tanks will be drawn using a random number generator. 
[*]The names of the winners will be announced on Tuesday, December 12th.
[*]Dream Tank winners will be contacted after the giveaway so that they can choose their preferred combo.
[*]Prizes (Containers, Premium and Modules) will be handed out within 48 hours of the end of the giveaway.
[*]Premium Account time will be activated as soon as it is added to players’ accounts.
[*]All results will be announced on Tuesday, December 12th.

notes.title: Friends List Changes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/0535cf885a064bd2c9c8bbbf623caa38f383420a.png[/img]

Tankers!
 
We thank you for your feedback on the new maps and will continue to test and balance them in the future updates, but before they arrive, we’ve made a few improvements to the Friends List and how cheaters are handled in battles.
 
[h1]Friends List[/h1]
 
Let’s start with the Friends List, and how the new changes will help you avoid spam.
 
[b]After server restart at 02:00 UTC on Thursday, December 7th[/b], Friend Lists will have a maximum number of 300 active friends and 50 incoming friend requests.
 
This means that if you already have 50 requests in your inbox, and a player tries to send you a new friend request they will get an error saying your friend requests are full right now. At the same time, the list of all friend requests sent will be removed, to improve performance.
 
If you already have more than 300 friends, only friends that haven’t played for longer than 6 months will be removed from your Friends List, and if someone didn’t play for more than 1 year, their personal Friends List will be cleared automatically.
 
Friends List changes and 300 friends limit are coming to the game to reduce lag and improve server stability, since at the moment, all players in the game can look at the profile of another player and add extra work for the servers and impact ongoing battles, chat and Battle List.
 
We hope you will notice the improvement!
 
[b]NOTE[/b]: After server restart at 02:00 UTC December 7th all friend requests (both sent and received) will be cleared, but this will happen only once, after the restart.
 
[h1]Cheater Reports[/h1]
 
Right now we are also working on preventing most common hacks and to help stop the hackers we are changing how you can report these players.
 
[b]After the restart at 02:00 UTC on December 7th[/b] when a player is reported for cheating in any battle it will no longer create a message in the battle saying a moderator is coming.
 
The reports will work as usual, and Battle Mods will join the battle to see who is breaking the rules, but after the restart it will be much harder for cheaters to run away.
 
With the update we will also add protection against jump hacks to the anti-cheat system, which will help us stop the hackers from stealing Golds in the future.
 
---
 
Want to share your thoughts on the new update? Share them with us!

notes.title: Updated Maps and X3 Mission Chains
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/18a218ced08f0cbf75e32c11925b415563cb78a6.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
You certainly heard about our plans to update the battle maps created through the Lobby. 

Good news! Updated maps will appear in the game tomorrow, after the server restart at [b]02:00 UTC December 1st[/b].
 
Battles on the updated maps will allow for up to 20 players (10x10 for team modes). At the moment we think this number of players is optimal for regular battles. After the release we will monitor the situation and, possibly, change the player limit if necessary.
 
To make the new versions of the maps better for playing in 10x10 format, we made some changes to the landscape on some of them.
 
Updated maps will appear only in battles made through the Lobby by pressing “Play!” on the mode you choose. You won’t see the new maps in PRO-battles yet; we don’t want to overload the list with 24 additional maps most of which, probably, will be left unplayed. Instead, we encourage you to try out the new maps in regular battles and share your feedback with us, what you liked and what you didn’t like in the updated versions. After we analyze what maps are the most popular, we will include them in the PRO-battles.
 
This way, in PRO-battles you will see the previous versions of the maps with the previous setting, and, of course, all of the maps that were not changed by the update, and in the regular battles you will see only the new maps from the list below.
 
The list of 24 updated maps: 
[list]
[*]Aleksandrovsk — summer and winter (no visible changes)
[*]Barda — summer and winter (no visible changes)
[*]Brest — summer and winter (removed entrances behind the bases)
[*]Bridges — summer and winter (concrete blocks added in a few spots)
[*]Desert — summer only (no visible changes)
[*]Forest — summer and winter (removed the hole in the middle of the map)
[*]Future — summer only (no visible changes)
[*]Highland — summer and winter (both bases revamped, added new territories)
[*]Highways — summer and winter (the size of the bases slightly reduced)
[*]Industrial Zone — summer and winter (small changes to several parts of the map, removed the tunnel below the building with the destroyed roof)
[*]Iran — summer only (no visible changes)
[*]Kungur — summer and winter (no visible changes)
[*]Massacre — summer and winter (the map increased in length with the additional territories for both bases)
[*]Osa — summer and winter (added new ramp to the central platform)
[*]Polygon — summer and winter (many changes to the perimeter areas of the map)
[*]Red Alert — summer and winter (slightly increased the size of some pathways)
[*]Rio — summer only (increased the base territories, the Red flag moved down)
[*]Serpuhov — summer and winter (concrete blocks added in a few spots)
[*]Silence — summer only (extended the territory for both bases)
[*]Solikamsk — summer and winter (territory reduced with the removal of narrow pathways at the sides of the map)
[*]Tribute — summer and winter (concrete blocks added in a few spots, new building in the middle of the map, ramp added to the hill off the side of the long bridge, some pathways expanded)
[*]Wolfenstein — summer and winter (areas blocked to the side of the ramps to the castle walls)
[*]Year 2042 — summer and winter (territory narrowed on the right side of the map close to the Red flag)
[*]Yorkshire — summer and winter (brand new map)
[/list]

[h1]X3 rewards for completing mission chains[/h1]
 
In the last 6 months the rewards for completing daily mission chains were 3 times bigger than usual. If you completed at least 1 mission every day during this period, after a full week of completing missions you would get X3 rewards!
 
At first, we made this increase for summer only, and then extended the event until the end of autumn, and are now happy to share that X3 rewards will remain in the game until the end of the year! What will happen to them after the end of the year we will share later.
 
NOTE: increased rewards DO NOT affect the rewards for the missions themselves.
 
Jump into the game after the restart, check out the new maps and tell us what you think right here.

notes.title: Battle of the Social Networks
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/c98df6b5792598376ddc3e81023f196468821358.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

From 02:00 UTC November 16th until 02:00 UTC November 23rd an epic battle will rage between two social networks in Tanki Online. Join the side of VKontakte or Odnoklassniki and win cool prizes!

To participate in the battle you need to buy one of the two paints. After purchasing the paint play the most efficiently (kill more enemies and die as little as possible) and help your side win! The more kills you make the bigger is your prize. And if your social network wins the battle the prizes will be doubled.

[h1]Event Details[/h1]
 
The event will last exactly one week: from 02:00 UTC November 16th until 02:00 UTC November 23rd.
 
For the duration of the event you will find 2 new paints in the Garage — for all participants who support “VKontakte” and for all who support “Odnoklassniki”. Both paints will cost 1000 crystals. If you buy one paint, the other will become unavailable for purchase. When the event ends, all purchased paints will remain in the Garages of their owners forever.
 
[h1]Personal Race[/h1]
 
After purchasing the paint your task is to equip it in the Garage and defeat enemy tanks in any battles (regular and PRO-battles). The more kills you make in the 7 days of the event, the bigger will be your prize:

[list] 
[*]Prize for destroying 500-999 enemy tanks — 1000 crystals;
[*]Prize for destroying 1000-1499 enemy tanks — 2000 crystals, 20 of each supply (except Gold Boxes);
[*]Prize for destroying 1500-2499 enemy tanks — 3000 crystals, 30 of each supply (except Gold Boxes), 1 day of Premium;
[*]Prize for destroying 2500-6999 enemy tanks — 5000 crystals, 50 of each supply (except Gold Boxes), 2 day of Premium;
[*]Prize for destroying 7000+ enemy tanks — 10 Gold Boxes, 100 of each supply (except Gold Boxes) and 3 days of Premium.
[/list]
We’ll also give away 5 Dream Tanks among tankers who make more than 7000 kills and whose team will win the battle at the end of the event. Dream Tank is a fully upgraded tank with any turret, hull and protection module available at your rank in the Garage, including XT equipment.
 
[h1]Team Race[/h1]
 
But the race is on not only for you — it’s for the whole team! The game will count all kills for all tankers who purchase either VKontakte or Odnoklassniki paint and equip them during the event. The social network which scores the higher K/D (ratio of Kills/Deaths), will win — and double the rewards for all tankers on the team!
 
Check the progress of your team on a [url=http://tankionline.com/pages/battle]special website[/url]. There you will also see the rating of Top 10 most deadly tankers for each social network. Every tanker who makes the Top 10 at the end of the event will receive a month of Premium!** And those who take the 1st spot for each team will also get the animated paint “Flow”.

**double prizes for the winning team do not apply to this prize
 
Choose your side and win!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/4a500a4e778646bf090160940f5fe9ca39ec1a0d.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

Masters of Parkour 2017 is finally ready for its most anticipated stage and the Finals will be streamed live at 17:00 UTC November 4th on the official TO Youtube channel:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=XZl5uE9RiXE

After careful review of over 200 entries and heated debates among the judges we have picked 10 most skilled and creative parkour teams of 2017, let's welcome the Finalists!

[h1]Oye, Drowning, TT_r_O_f_E_s_S_i_O_n, O_o_00oo000_o_O[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L4-9fOx0Iqo

[h1]Flyer, I.Legend.I, My_Skills_To_Win, Mr.SkiIIZz[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QM41SQShblE

[h1]I.Fight, Olymp, Traffic, MOR4RL3[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2jIcGWR1NMo

[h1]williew,sterre933,SwiftSmoky,SkIlL-PaVlIToS[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eE8Ew6iQXOc

[h1]Intellect, Hate, Spirit, Jan[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Fzr16qcjxrc

[h1]Graphics, oOo.Anonymous.oOo, Boar, Average[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=81d3XIcKg_U

[h1]stanzhang, Govenier, emrakul, Sensei[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k9IcxhN-MxM

[h1]Adiela, Skull, QTr, Spy[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-XyELv1fyAY

[h1]Feelings, jox99, SKILL.NooB, O_White_O[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nvjXa0N4QLg

[h1]VVhy, 0ff, kvjdkrgsdk, Ms.Drakon[/h1]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qfxOaRr2CPk

Congratulations to the best 10 parkour teams of 2017!

Let’s remind what are the prizes for winning Masters of Parkour 2017:

[h1]Prizes (for each teammate):[/h1]
[list]
[*]All the finalists will receive the unique paint “Master of Parkour 2017”, which will remain in their garages forever.
[*]1st place: 50 000 crystals, 50 units of each supply, 20 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module + gaming keyboard.
[*]2nd place: 30 000 crystals, 30 units of each supply, 15 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module.
[*]3rd place: 20 000 crystals, 20 units of each supply, 10 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module.
[*]The remaining finalists will receive 10 000 crystals and 5 gold boxes each.
[/list]

Additionally, we wanted to award 5 teams, who also showed impressive skill this year:

Warm, Deception, W.I.H.U, Fractal
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=otE6jl6LQMU

GooD_6aMer, i.unstopable, ll_BOSS_ll, B-13
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jaTZwP8REeQ&feature=youtu.be

Member, Mike, Jumper, Virtuoos
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lWgofhTLwEE

Ghost_Animators, Wealthy, something22, Zod
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xNonOXvYl6I

xYONi, xAiKO, onno_20, FIREFOX_IT
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ArBEVSn2IZE

Consolation prizes will include “Master of Parkour 2017” paint, 5000 crystals and 5 Gold Boxes for all members of the runner up teams.

Thanks to all participants of the video stage and don’t miss the live Finals on our Youtube channel tomorrow at 17:00 UTC!

notes.title: Halloween 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/9f9f37ed48a3f13da47e57090c4f566697d38f91.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
It’s finally time for sales to rise from the dead and golden pumpkins to rain from the sky — it’s time for Halloween!
 
Halloween events will be in the game [b]until 02:00 UTC on November 6th[/b], and here’s what awaits you during the spooky holiday:
 
[h1]Holiday Decorations[/h1]
 
Thematic Gold Boxes and their dropzones, parachutes and billboards will stay in the game during all Halloween celebrations. Join the holiday madness — equip special holiday paint and spread the fear among the enemies! Don’t forget to send your friends Halloween candy.
 
During the celebration you can buy the holiday paint with crystals, and it will remain in your Garage.
 
[h1]Holiday Map and Missions[/h1]
 
[b]From 02:00 UTC on October 28th and until 02:00 UTC on November 6th[/b] play on the special holiday map, that looks like a chilling graveyard at night. And [b]from 02:00 UTC on October 31st[/b] you can get a special mission to earn experience on the holiday map, with increased difficulty and rewards. And the rewards for this mission will be Gold Boxes.
 
We’ll also add a special button in the Lobby, that will enter you into battles only on Halloween map.
 
 
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/2a6100b3d7b9228cbe9f092fa141c06c3b7a76d1.png[/img]
 
 
NOTE: Holiday mission and the special Halloween map will be removed at 02:00 UTC on November 6th, make sure you collect the rewards for the mission or they will be gone.
 
[h1]Discounts in the Shop[/h1]
 
[b]From 02:00 UTC October 28th until 02:00 UTC October 29th[/b] most of the items in the Shop will be on sale with 20% and 50% discounts.

Discounts include crystal packs, Premium (excluding 1 Day Premium), Gold Boxes (excluding 1 Gold Box), paints and kits, including the Supplies kit.

NOTE: discounts in the Shop do not include special offers, clan license and Rename Pass.
 
[h1]Discounts in the Garage[/h1]
 
[b]From 02:00 UTC October 29th until 02:00 UTC November 3rd[/b] turrets, hulls, protections modules, alterations and paints will be on sale with 50% off! Discount for each category of items will be active for 1 day. Gifts and supplies will be on sale with 50% off almost all of the holiday event  — from 02:00 UTC October 29th until 02:00 UTC November 6th. Oh and [b]on November 3rd[/b] you will get 50% off beginning MicroUpgrades and 70% on speed-ups!
 
Find the full Discounts calendar below.
 
NOTE: discounts in the Garage do not include the Supplies kit, and purchasing or upgrading XT-equipement.
 
[h1]Gold Boxes and Battle Funds[/h1]
 
[b]From 02:00 UTC October 31st until 02:00 UTC November 1st[/b] Gold Boxes in all battles, including PRO-battles and battles on the Halloween map, will drop 10 TIMES more often! The value of the Gold Boxes will remain standard — 1000 crystals.
 
And [b]from 02:00 UTC November 4th until 02:00 UTC November 5th[/b] all regular (non-PRO) battles will have TRIPLE battle funds!
 
Don’t miss your chance to score big!
 
[h1]Special offers[/h1]
 
[b]From 02:00 UTC October 29th until 02:00 UTC November 6th[/b] you will find 2 special offers at the same time in the Shop, and one of them will include the coolest animated paint — probably the most terrifying paint in Tanki history — «Nightmare»!
 
[img]http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/10/nightmare.gif[/img]
 
Special offer №1 — 59.90 USD:
[list]New animated paint;
[*]5 days of Premium;
[*]5 Gold Boxes;
[*]500 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes);
[*]25 000 crystals.
[/list] 
Special offer №2 — 15.99 USD:
[list][*]Halloween Holiday paint (also available for purchase with crystals in the Garage);
[*]3 days of Premium;
[*]3 Gold Boxes;
[*]100  of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes);
[*]100 000 crystals.
[/list]
Happy Halloween!

Check the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=364741]official Forum thread[/url] for the full Event and Discounts calendar.

notes.title: «HallowMINE» contest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/46f8f39353b2a31cc57f1171fe4ae15b5b4c376e.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
To celebrate the spookiest of holidays we’re launching a special contest — HallowMINE. You can win mines, Premium, Gold Boxes and the new animated paint «Nightmare»!
 
The mission is simple: lay out a cool Halloween picture using mines in Tanki Online.
 
To participate you need to make 2 screenshots of your mine art (from different angles), upload them to any image sharing service and send the link to the image using the special [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScFp6elbdcnAU4W9nIedUll5UNbippPM6Fnh8nBO4-NyaahUQ/viewform]Google form[/url]. Your nickname and your tank in the holiday paint must be clearly visible on the screenshots. The map or the format of the battle are up to you. You can enter the contest as a team of tankers, but the prize will be sent only to the player who submitted the entry.
 
How we will judge the entries:
[list]
[*]Clearly themed and made for Halloween in Tanki Online;
[*]Originality of the mine art;
[*]The preciseness and creativity of laying the mines.
[/list] 
Prizes:
[list] 
[*]1st Place: animated paint «Nightmare»* + 1000 mines + 30 Gold Boxes + 10 days of Premium.
[*]2nd Place: 500 mines + 20 Gold Boxes + 5 days of Premium.
[*]3rd Place: 300 mines + 10 Gold Boxes + 5 days of Premium.
[/list] 
We will also pick 10 additional winners who will receive 100 mines and 5 Gold Boxes each.
 
*in case the winner already has the paint, there is no exchange or other gift for the prize
 
Dates:
[list] 
[*]Submissions are open until: 17:00 UTC November 5th.
[*]The winners will be announced on: November 7th during the day.
[/list]
Good luck and spooky Halloween!
 
[url=https://en.tankiwiki.com/Screenshot]How to take a screenshot[/url]
[url=https://en.tankiwiki.com/Uploading_images_to_a_hosting_site]How to upload images to hosting sites[/url]

notes.title: Lobby and Rank Limits
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/807c8a3a94b7717c869ba1fa7709a17e5c41c2c1.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

notes.title: New Lobby Screen
notes.content:
[img]http://tankionline.com/de/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/work_in_progress.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

We continue to work on a faster way to join battles, and in the next release a new Lobby screen is coming to Tanki Online.
 
Get into battles with one click of a button, customize which battles you want to join and easily check your daily missions.
 
[h1]How Lobby Works[/h1]
 
After you open the game you will see a few buttons:
[list] 
[*]Quick Battle
[*]TDM Mode
[*]DM Mode
[*]CP Mode
[*]CTF Mode
[*]Battle List
[/list]
Each button has Rank requirements:
[list]
[*][b]Recruit[/b] for Quick Battle and TDM
[*][b]Private[/b] for DM
[*][b]Gefreiter[/b] for CP
[*][b]Corporal[/b] for CTF
[*][b]Master Corporal[/b] for Battle List
[/list]
Lobby buttons will help you quickly join the battle mode you want, and Quick Battle is every mode excluding DM, available at your current Rank.
 
Now the game will also remember what screen you left to join the battle, and after you return you will be back on the same screen — Lobby or Battle List.
 
[h1]Daily Missions[/h1]
 
Lobby will also have the Daily Missions button at the top, and the current Missions button will remain in the Menu.
 
[h1]Battle List[/h1]
 
Unified Battle List will also be improved. As we’re listening to your feedback and work on making sure nothing interrupts your play, Battle List will receive changes to current Rank limits for battles, making it more fair for low ranking players to face the veterans. 
 
Since update was released we’ve been working hard to fix main problems and we will continue to improve the new chat and battle list in the coming weeks.
 
After the next release comes out, the “Battle” button will now take you to the Lobby.
 
---
 
What do you think of the changes? We listen to your feedback and it helps make TO better, so share your thoughts in this topic and see you in the new Lobby!

notes.title: Masters of Parkour 2017 launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/4a500a4e778646bf090160940f5fe9ca39ec1a0d.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

It’s time to pull off some awesome tricks — the Masters of Parkour contest is here! If you’re enough of a daredevil, you can win crystals, supplies (including gold boxes), fully upgraded protection modules, and the Master of Parkour 2017 unique paint.

Interested? Keep reading!

[h1]The contest consists of two phases — the qualifying round and the final.[/h1]

The qualifying phase is open to any tanker ranked WO-1 and higher. Participants need to organize a team of up to 4 members, and shoot a cool parkour video. The video needs to be uploaded to Youtube, and the link submitted through [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSjQRKx1MGX3noOQ3H7HKVkDri8nd4vpAWm7_aJ06njiZt1w/viewform]this special form[/url]. After the first phase of the contest, the jury will pick the TOP-ten teams to be the finalists.
The final will take place online on the Tanki Online International Youtube channel. Finalists will need to perform parkour tricks in time-challenge mode. The fastest, and most precise will win.

[h1]The jury will judge based on the following criteria:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Respect for the contest rules
[*]Legitness and difficulty of tricks
[*]Recording and editing quality
[/list]

And now, some details about the contest:

[list]
[*]Contest entries must be shot on standard gravity settings. Videos made in [*]Space mode will not be counted for the contest.
[*]All team members must have a minimum rank of Warrant Officer 1 to take part in the contest. The Parkour Master paint is only available for the rank of Warrant Officer 1 or higher.
[*]The parkour team should consist of not more than 4 tankers. The team can decide whether the video is to be shot by a team member or an independent cameraperson.
[*]Contest entries must be uploaded to Youtube. Video links are to be submitted via [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSjQRKx1MGX3noOQ3H7HKVkDri8nd4vpAWm7_aJ06njiZt1w/viewform]this special form[/url]. When posting your video, make sure you post the nicknames of all the team members (not more than 4 members). If the team wins, only the specified players will get the reward.
[*]The video must be shot exclusively for this contest. Videos made earlier will not be accepted. To prove that your video is exclusive, all members of your team must be equipped with the “Master of Parkour 2017” paint. Once the qualifying round is over, the paint will be removed from all garages, except for those of the finalists. Winners will keep the paint forever.
[*]Your video must not be longer than 60 seconds. Videos longer than 60 seconds will be automatically disqualified.
[*]The nicknames of the participants in a team must be clearly readable on the video.
[*]The video cannot contain any violation to the [url=http://tankionline.com/en/rules/]Game Rules[/url].
[*]A participant can only be part of one team.
[*]The rights of using contest videos are described in point 7.4 of the [url=http://tankionline.com/en/eula/]EULA[/url].
[*]These rules are not a copy of Masters of Parkour 2016.
[/list]

[h1]Interesting facts![/h1]

[list]
[*]This time we’ll be adding a new Master of Parkour paint. The old one will remain in the garages of last year’s winners, and that’s how the mechanism will work in the future.
[*]There are three versions — the International one (EN/DE/PL), Latin America (BR/ES), and the Russian one. That means there will be three groups of winners, 3 finals live streams and 3 contests.
[/list]
 
[h1]Prizes (for each teammate)[/h1]

[list]
[*]All the finalists will receive the unique paint “Master of Parkour 2017”, which will remain in their garages  forever.
[*]1st place: 50 000 crystals, 50 units of each supply, 20 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module.
[*]2nd place: 30 000 crystals, 30 units of each supply, 15 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module.
[*]3rd place: 20 000 crystals, 20 units of each supply, 10 gold boxes, any* fully upgraded protection module.
[*]The remaining finalists will receive 10 000 crystals and 5 gold boxes each.
[*]Depending on the quality and number of entries, the number of nominations and prizes might change.
[/list]
 
*available for purchase

[h1]Dates:[/h1]

[list]
[*]Entries are accepted until 9:00AM UTC on October 30th
[*]We will announce the names of the finalists of the contest and remove the paints from the garages of all other players on November 3rd
[*]The Finals will take place on November 6th at 5:00PM UTC
[*]We’ll award all the winners on November 7th
[/list]
 
[b]Good luck, masters![/b]
