notes.title: Crazy Weekend and Double Battle Funds
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/a8635f98601001ee5c7d14548084db942a9a8d41.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

The fall is in full bloom, and this weekend will be perfect to spend it in the heat of battle!

Destroy enemy tanks in regular (non-PRO) battles and win Gold Boxes, days of Premium, the “Mint” paint from the Shop and one of the 2 Dream Tanks in a special giveaway! Dream Tanks are fully upgraded tanks with the best turret, hull, and protection module in the maximum available modification at your rank, even XT-gear.

To win more often, it’s not enough to play good, you’ll also need to upgrade your gear well! This weekend don’t miss the chance to earn a ton of crystals and upgrade your tank to the max, using the new discounts for Garage and Shop items, including a new special offer, and by claiming the double battle funds in all non-PRO battles!

[h1]Details and Prizes[/h1]

Kills for the crazy weekend will be counted from 21:00 UTC on Friday, October 13th, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, October 15th.

You will need to destroy enough tanks in regular, non-PRO battles within 48 hours. The more kills you make, the bigger are the prizes:

[list]
[*]Kill Tier 1: 400 - 799 kills - 3 Gold Boxes*
[*]Kill Tier 2: 800 - 1999 kills - 5 Gold Boxes + 3 days of Premium*
[*]Kill Tier 3: 2000+ kills - 10 Gold Boxes + 5 days of Premium* + the “Mint” paint from the Shop*
[/list]

Tankers who make enough kills during the event will be guaranteed** to receive the prizes for their kill tier, and among all tankers who make more than 800 kills we will run a special giveaway for 2 Dream Tanks! Read the full contest rules below.

*Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest.
**except gold boxes for players with a rank lower than Warrant Officer 1.

[h1]Two players will win a Dream Tank[/h1]

Additionally, we’ll be randomly choosing two tankers who have made more than 800 kills and who will receive a Dream Tank (chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at their level, fully upgraded, including XT items).

The nicknames of the lucky winners will be announced on Tuesday, October 17th.

[h1]Discounts in the Shop on Saturday[/h1]

From 02:00 UTC on Saturday, October 14th, till 02:00 UTC on Sunday, October 15th most of the items in the Shop will be on sale with 20%-50% discounts.

Discounts include Premium (except 1 day Premium), Gold Boxes (except 1 Gold Box), paints and kits, including the Supplies kit. Please be aware that there will be no sales on crystal packs this time.

NOTE: Discounts do not include special offers, Clan license and Rename Pass.

[h1]Discounts in the Garage on Sunday[/h1]

From 02:00 UTC on Sunday, October 15th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday, October 16th get turrets, hulls, protection modules, alterations, paints, supplies and gifts with a 30% discount, and upgrade your equipment with a 25% discount on start and 50% on speeding up.

NOTE: Discounts do not include supplies kit, and purchasing or upgrading XT-gear.

[h1]Special offer[/h1]

From 02:00 UTC on Saturday, October 14th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday, October 16th you will find a special offer in the Shop that will include:

[list]
[*]5 days of Premium
[*]5 Gold Boxes
[*]500 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes)
[*]50000 crystals
[/list]

[h1]Double Battle Funds for 48hrs[/h1]

And finally, the cherry on top. All throughout the weekend, from 02:00 UTC on Saturday, October 14th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday, October 16th, we’ll be having double battle funds in all non-PRO battles. That’s 100% extra funds for every battle you finish!

So, get ready to blow up tons of your enemies this weekend. Awesome prizes await!

[h1]Terms and Conditions[/h1]

[list]
[*]None of the prizes may be exchanged for crystals, other prizes or money
[*]Gold Boxes will only be awarded to players ranked Warrant Officer 1 or higher during the giveaway.
[*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Gold Boxes throughout the giveaway. The same applies to Premium days.
[*]The kills must be made in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list.
[*]Kills in PRO Battles will NOT count.
[*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC on Friday, October 13th, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, October 15th.
[*]The winners of the Dream Tanks will be drawn randomly using a random number generator on Tuesday, October 17th.
[*]Dream Tanks winners will be contacted after the giveaway so that they can choose their preferred combo.
[*]Regular Tier prizes (Golds, Premium and Modules) will be handed out within 48 hours of the end of the giveaway.
[*]Premium Account time will be activated as soon as it is added to players’ accounts.
[*]All results will be announced on Tuesday, October 17th.
[/list]

notes.title: Unified Battle List and Chat channels
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/78098f09db5cc43cbbb2f7a78c52bff6891b53ae.jpg[/img]

Tankers!
 
After server maintenance at 2:00 AM UTC on October 12th all game servers will receive a big update - Unified Battle List and Chat Channels. We’ll share what to expect from the new and important release below.
 
[h1]Unified Battle List[/h1]
 
From the beginning game servers in Tanki Online were isolated from each other. To find the battle you want, often you had to spend a lot of time switching between servers and scrolling the lists.
 
With Unified Battle List you will no longer need to manually switch between servers. All battles created along all servers, including regular and PRO-battles, now will be shown in the same list of active battles. Join the battle you like, and while the game is loading you will be automatically transferred to the correct server.
 
At the time of the update release the button to switch between servers will be removed from the interface, and the number of the server will be removed from the battle links.
 
[h1]Unified Chat and Chat channels[/h1]
 
With the introduction of the unified battle list there’s no need to have separated chats for each server, and to make chatting easier, in-game chat will be unified as well - all messages from all servers will be sent to the same chat.
 
Of course, when everyone speaks in the same place at the same time, chatting could be problematic. This is why we’re also introducing thematic chat channels.
 
Instead of the “Chat” button in the game lobby, you will now see the button to choose a chat channel. Pressing on the button will open a list of available channels, and each channel is a chat in itself. As always, you can access chat after the Master Sergeant rank and up. The chat rules and language selection remain the same as before, including public and private messages.

Q: How to use Chat channels in battle?

[h1]Unified Battle List[/h1]
 
From the beginning game servers in Tanki Online were isolated from each other. To find the battle you want, often you had to spend a lot of time switching between servers and scrolling the lists.
 
With Unified Battle List you will no longer need to manually switch between servers. All battles created along all servers, including regular and PRO-battles, now will be shown in the same list of active battles. Join the battle you like, and while the game is loading you will be automatically transferred to the correct server.

Instead of the “Chat” button in the game lobby, you will now see the button to choose a chat channel. notes.title: «Deja Vu» contest launched!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/644b550861310ffb3ccecbbb9da06cc482491839.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

Today, September 29th, we’re launching a new creative contest—«Deja Vu Tanki Online»!

Join the contest, take the most striking photo of Tanki in real life and win cool gaming gear from our partners at Genesis!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/47b5d2bd2bbf954c3e4a6214f95e742a87a337c5.png[/img]

[h1]How to Enter[/h1]

To participate in «Deja Vu» you need to:

[list][*]Take a real life photo that looks like a map, a building or a tank from «Tanki Online». Bonus points for clever and creative photos! And if you can’t find places or objects resembling TO around? Make them yourself!
[*]Publish the photo on [url=https://www.facebook.com]your Facebook page[/url], add the hashtag #DejavuTO and include your nickname in the description in the description.[/list]

[b]NOTE:[/b] The hashtag is very important—without it we won’t be able to find your photo! Make sure that the photo can be seen by everyone on Facebook, not only you and your friends.

[h1]When to Enter[/h1]

Dates:

[list][*]Contest starts: September 29th.
[*]Contest ends: 20:00 UTC October 15th.
[*]Winners announced: before 11:59 UTC on October 17th.[/list]


[h1]The Prizes[/h1]

The winners of the contest will receive the prizes from our partners at Genesis:

[b]1st place:[/b] gaming keyboard Rhod 400 RGB and gaming mouse Krypton 700 RGB.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/80316828fedfcba18fb925c6d60b49472eba932a.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/29ae70f034f44d443f8e253f657fdf336dba6525.png[/img]

[b]2nd place:[/b] gaming keyboard Rhod 400.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/dd03bc10a15b66983ad195a3a3685d3bd17c65df.png[/img]

[b]3rd place:[/b] gaming mouse Xenon 200.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/0c7537429a4eb0aab2b12904cb25b4febf8c1959.png[/img]

[b]NOTE: Of course, don't forget our traditional requirement for real life contests[/b]—in the photo there must be your real name, nickname or any official branding of Tanki Online! 

Please make sure you are not taking a random picture from the internet.

Good luck, tankers!

notes.title: Rename Pass is coming!

Tankers!
 
From September 28 changing your nickname will be much easier!
 
[h1]Faster Name Change[/h1]
 
Beginning 02:00 UTC September 28 you can go to the «Others» tab in the Shop and purchase a Rename Pass. After the purchase, your pass will be in the Garage in the «Special» tab, and can be redeemed at any point to quickly change your nickname.
 
NOTE: Rename Pass can be used once per purchase and will be consumed after the name change. There is no expiration date for the pass and you won’t need to contact the support.
 
[h1]Crystal Name Change[/h1]
 
If you’d like to use the current crystals option, please make sure you send the request to our support team before 02:00 UTC on October 9. After the server maintenance on October 9 you will no longer be able to change your nickname using crystals.
 
[h1]Pricing[/h1]
 
Rename Pass is available for purchase in the Shop for 18.00 USD.
 
For local pricing please check the Shop in the game.

notes.title: The «Tanki in Moscow» pack on sale September 2nd
notes.content:
[img]http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/mazda.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

You’ve probably heard about the new pack «Tanki in Moscow» in the latest V-LOG, and if not, we’ll tell you right now. 
 
This pack was made for tankers who can’t come to the meetup in Moscow, but want to add an exclusive paint to their garage, available only for attendees. The full pack includes:

[list] 
[*][b]Exclusive paint «Tanki in Moscow»[/b]
[*][b]7 gold boxes[/b]
[*][b]20 days of premium[/b]
[*][b]1500  of each supply (except gold boxes)[/b]
[/list]
 
From 14:00 UTC on September 2nd until 14:00 UTC on September 11th the «Tanki in Moscow» pack will be available in the Shop under the «Special offer» category for 15.99USD.
 
After purchasing the pack you will immediately receive all items, except the exclusive paint. The «Tanki in Moscow» paint will be added to your garage after it has been removed from the Shop on September 11th. Everyone who will purchase the pack is guaranteed to receive the paint, but attendees of the meetup will have an early access.
 
And that’s not all!
 
We’ve created a special crystal prize pool, which increases by 20.000 crystals with every purchase of the «Tanki in Moscow» pack or ticket to the «Tanki in the City» meetup. The final prize pool will be enormous!
 
 
On 15:00 UTC September 11th we will run a live giveaway and everyone who purchased a ticket to the meetup or a «Tanki in Moscow» pack in the Shop will enter the giveaway. The number of winners will depend on the size of the final prize pool—more crystals mean more winners!
 
Check the size of the prize pool and the number of winners [url=http://tankionline.com/pages/compendium/en/]>> live on this site <<[/url]
 
You can already see how big it is, even before the «Tanki in Moscow» pack was available for sale, thanks to the tickets purchased to the «Tanki in the City» meetup. 
 
Don’t miss your chance to buy a ticket or a pack and become one of the crystallionaires!

notes.title: Weekend Giveaway with hot prizes and Double Funds!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/news_forum.jpg]

Tankers!

There’s a new crazy weekend giveaway coming today, and the prizes are cooler than ever. Destroy enemy tanks to win Gold Boxes, days of Premium, Griffon T-G protection modules and Dream Tanks—fully upgraded tanks with the best turret, hull, and protection module in the maximum available modification at your rank, even XT-gear.

And to make the weekend even more fun, all NON-PRO battles will have double funds!

Ready to win? Here’s how:

 
[h1]Giveaway Kill Tiers and Prizes[/h1]
 
The giveaway will be held over 48 hours, starting from 21:00 UTC on Friday, September 1st, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, September 3rd.

Just like in the last giveaway, you will have 48 HOURS to make the kill quota.

As usual, the different kill tiers will give you different rewards.
[list]
 	[*][b]Kill Tier 1[/b]: 400 - 799 kills - 3 Gold Boxes*[/*]
 	[*][b]Kill Tier 2[/b]: 800 - 1999 kills - 5 Gold Boxes + 3 days of Premium* + chance to win one of two Dream Tanks*[/*]
 	[*][b]Kill Tier 3[/b]: 2000+ kills - 10 Gold Boxes + 5 days of Premium* + the Griffon T-G protection module* + chance to win one of two Dream Tanks[/*]
[/list]
Players who meet the kill quota for the respective tier during the giveaway will be guaranteed** to receive the prizes listed above (gold boxes, premium and protection modules). Also, everyone who kills more than 800 tanks during the weekend will enter the giveaway to win one of the two Dream Tanks.

*Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest.

**except gold boxes for players with a rank lower than Warrant Officer 1 and protection modules Griffon T-G for player with a rank lower than First Sergeant.

[h1]Two players will win a Dream Tank[/h1]

Additionally, we’ll be randomly choosing two tankers who have made more than 800 kills and who will receive a Dream Tank (chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at their level, fully upgraded, including XT items).

The nicknames of the lucky winners will be announced on Tuesday, September 5th.

[h1]Double Battle Funds for 48hrs[/h1]

And finally, the cherry on the cake. All throughout the weekend, from 21:00 UTC on Friday, September 1st, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, September 3rd, we’ll be having double battle funds in all non-PRO battles. That’s 100% extra funds for every battle you finish!

So, get ready to blow up tons of your enemies this weekend. Awesome prizes await!

[b]Terms and Conditions[/b]
[list]
 	[*]None of the prizes may be exchanged for crystals, other prizes or money[/*]
 	[*]Gold Boxes will only be awarded to players ranked Warrant Officer 1 or higher during the giveaway.[/*]
 	[*]Modules will only be awarded to players ranked First Sergeant or higher during the giveaway.[/*]
 	[*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Gold Boxes throughout the giveaway. The same applies to Premium days.[/*]
 	[*]The kills must be made in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list.[/*]
 	[*]Kills in PRO Battles will NOT count.[/*]
 	[*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC on Friday, September 1st, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday, September 3rd.[/*]
 	[*]The winners of the Dream Tanks will be drawn randomly using a random number generator on Tuesday, September 5th.[/*]
 	[*]Dream Tanks winners will be contacted after the giveaway so that they can choose their preferred combo.[/*]
 	[*]Regular Tier prizes (Golds, Premium and Modules) will be handed out within 48 hours of the end of the giveaway.[/*]
 	[*]Premium Account time will be activated as soon as it is added to players’ accounts.[/*]
 	[*]All results will be announced on Tuesday, September 5th.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Goodbye Summer 2017 event
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/goodbye_summer_2017_news_forum.jpg]

Tankers!

It doesn’t matter whether you’re more of a fan of the beach and sea, or skis and snow. What matters is that the change of season is here, and it’s the perfect opportunity for us to have a celebration.

So, here’s what you can expect this weekend, from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 26th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday 28th.

[h1]Discounts on Shop and Garage items[/h1]

There’s no such thing as a celebration without discounts, and of course we’ve got you covered for both days!

On Saturday, we’ll be having 20 to 50 percent discounts on Shop items. Remember, if you have a bonus card for crystals, Premium (excluding 1 day package), or Gold Boxes (excluding 1 Gold Box package), it WILL stack up with the discount, so you’ll be getting an awesome deal.

On Sunday, it’s garage discounts.

Prices on turrets, hulls, modules and alterations, will be slashed by 30%. Micro-upgrades will get 25% off, while speed-ups will get 50% off.

notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/news_forum_vk_fb1.jpg]

Tankers!

Our traditional contest «Mister and Miss Tanki Online» is back. As always, the coolest among you will be rewarded with tons of crystals, Goldbox supplies, and dream tanks!

[h1]What you need to do to take part[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Read contest rules carefully[/*]
 	[*]Shoot a contest video with the theme “How I spent this summer in Tanki Online”[/*]
 	[*]Upload your video to Youtube[/*]
 	[*]Send us the link to your video via one of the special forms below
[list]
 	[*]For Mister (for the guys): [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdRVLkPaq1qRO783dfl543f0mstMzsBmLenSoQ-6DcQzbPlQ/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdRVLkPaq1qRO783dfl543f0mstMzsBmLenSoQ-6DcQzbPlQ/viewform[/url][/*]

[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
 
[h1]Contest Details[/h1]

This year, there will be three localizations for the contest:
 
[list]
 	[*]Russian Community[/*]
 	[*]English Community (this one)[/*]
 	[*]Rest of the World (for the German, Polish, Brazilian and Spanish communities)[/*]
[/list]
 
For each localization, there will be a first place, second place, and third place for both «Mister TO» and «Miss TO»

[h1]Contest Rules[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]The video must feature YOU in person, not your tank. Gameplay videos will be disqualified.[/*]
 	[*]The length of the video must be 30 seconds or less. Any videos that exceed the 30 second mark will be disqualified.[/*]
 	[*]It must be perfectly clear that your video was made for this contest. You can do this by mentioning or displaying «Mister and Miss Tanki Online» in the video in some way.[/*]
 	[*]When submitting the video link via the special form, you must include your nickname and a valid email address. The email address is important because we’ll use it to send you confirmation about whether your video has been accepted or not. If your video is rejected, we’ll tell you why.[/*]
 	[*]Your video cannot break any of the game rules and regulations.[/*]
 	[*]By submitting your work for this contest, you grant Tanki Online exclusive rights to use the video as and when required.[/*]
 	[*]Tanki Online is not responsible for any injury or inconvenience suffered as a result of participating in this contest[/*]
 	[*]Make sure you submit your video link to the correct form:
[list]
 	[*]Guys in the English Community should use this link: [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdRVLkPaq1qRO783dfl543f0mstMzsBmLenSoQ-6DcQzbPlQ/viewform]https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScdRVLkPaq1qRO783dfl543f0mstMzsBmLenSoQ-6DcQzbPlQ/viewform[/url][/*]

 	[*]If you’re not part of the English community, please find the announcement for your respective contest[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Criteria for Judging[/h1]

Judges will use the following criteria when judging entries:

 
[list]
 	[*]How well the video fits with the theme[/*]
 	[*]Originality[/*]
 	[*]Humor[/*]
 	[*]Overall quality[/*]
[/list]
 
[h1]Prizes[/h1]

The prizes are the same for both Mister TO and Miss TO:

[list]
 	[*]1st place for the English Group: 100,000 crystals, 100 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes), 50 Gold Boxes, a Dream tank (consisting of any turret, hull, and protection module, fully micro-upgraded, available at the player’s rank), a Tanki Online branded T-shirt, mug, and USB pen drive.[/*]
 	[*]2nd place in the English Group: 70,000 crystals, 70 each supply (excluding Gold Boxes), 30 Gold Boxes, and a Dream tank (consisting of any turret, hull, and protection module, fully micro-upgraded, available at the player’s rank).[/*]
 	[*]3rd place the in English Group: 50,000 crystals, 50 each supply (excluding Gold Boxes), 20 Gold Boxes, and a Dream tank (consisting of any turret, hull, and protection module, fully micro-upgraded, available at the player’s rank).[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Dates[/h1]
[list]
 	[*]Entries are accepted till 9:00 am UTC on September 12th.[/*]
 	[*]Winners will be announced on September 15th.[/*]
[/list]

If you’d like to get an idea of what kind of entries our judges enjoy, check out some of the winners from [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=333396]last year’s edition[/url].

Good luck to all of you!

notes.title: Testing of Matchmaking System on EU servers
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/news_forum.jpg]


Tankers!

With tomorrow’s server restart, we’ll be implementing a test version of the Matchmaking System on all EU servers.

The test is intended to run for 48 hours, till 02:00 UTC on Thursday 10th. However, developers might decide to end the test earlier if it causes any kind of undesirable effect on the game.

The reason the test is being run on the main EU servers instead of just the test server, is that we would like to see how it performs with a real server load and player distribution, rather than in the controlled environment of a test server.

Watch the video below to learn more about the test:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I13t1RjWUGA

Don’t forget to share your feedback in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=361372]forum[/url]!

notes.title: Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/08/news_forum_vk_fb.jpg]


Tankers!

Has the summer heat gone up to your head yet? Well, it’s about to get A LOT hotter this weekend with our special Summer Sale.

Here’s what you can expect:

[h1]Discounts on Shop items on Saturday[/h1]

Starting from Saturday’s server restart at 02:00 UTC, Shop items will be discounted between 20% and 50% for 24 hours.

That includes Crystals, Premium (excluding the 1 Day package), Gold Boxes (excluding the 1 Gold Box package), Shop Paints, Shop Kits, and the “Supplies 1500” pack in the Shop.

[h1]Discounts on Garage items on Sunday[/h1]

Then on Sunday, from 02:00 UTC, we’ll be slashing 40% off turrets, hulls, protection modules, and alterations. Additionally, Micro-Upgrades will be at 25% off, while Speed-Ups will be at half price.

These discounts will also last 24 hours, and will end on Monday 7th August at 02:00 UTC.

[h1]More discounts, plus decorations and special missions for 48 hours[/h1]

Throughout Saturday and Sunday, garage paints, supplies (does not apply to Garage Supplies kits) and gifts will be discounted during both days. Plus, we’ll be having themed decorations, paints and gifts.

Additionally, Gold Boxes will be dropping 5 times more often!

We’ll also be having special daily missions that will be tougher to complete, but that will bring you bigger rewards. As always, these Daily Missions can only be completed in non-Pro battles, and their rewards must be collected before 02:00 UTC on Monday 7th August 2017.

[h1]Special Bundle[/h1]

And to complete these celebrations in style, we’ll also have a special, Shop-exclusive bundle packed with great value. The bundle will be available for 48 hours, from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 5th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday 7th, and will contain the following:

[list]
 	[*]A special Premium paint (available exclusively in this bundle)[/*]
 	[*]5 days of Premium account[/*]
 	[*]5 Gold Boxes[/*]
 	[*]150 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes)[/*]
 	[*]130 000 crystals[/*]
[/list]

If you were to buy the 130 000 crystals separately, they would cost more than THREE TIMES the price of the whole bundle, so this is one you don’t want to miss.

So, make sure you log in early this Saturday, August 5th to check out all the cool in-game goodies and sales that we’ve prepared especially for you.

Have fun!

IMPORTANT: Sales DO NOT apply to Clan licenses, XT items, and the Summer sale bundle.

The discounts calendar can be found in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=361263]official forum thread[/url].

notes.title: Patch Update #469 - Released 12th July 2017
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/news_forum3.jpg]

Tankers!

With tomorrow’s server restart at 02:00 UTC, we’ll finally be rolling out the first Overdrive as a permanent feature of the game, and making some changes to the active and cooldown times of supplies, as well as some fixes under the hood.

Here are the details.

[h1]Overdrive[/h1]

You might remember the Overdrive feature (originally called “ZERO Supply”) that we first tested during the May 2017 holidays. By popular demand, Overdrive will now be coming back as a permanent feature of the game.

Just as in past events, before you can use Overdrive, you need to charge it up by performing actions (kills, flag captures etc) that will aid your team. Once your Overdrive is charged, unleashing it will activate all 5 supplies (except gold boxes) for you and any of your teammates nearby. The default key for Overdrive is «Shift», however, you’ll be able to change this in the Settings page.

Of course, PRO Battles will give you the option to enable or disable Overdrive, and in format battles (except Parkour), Overdrive will be disabled by default.

[h1]Changes to supplies and Repair Kits[/h1]

Tomorrow’s update will bring changes to the Repair Kit and other supplies. Here’s how that will work.

When activated, the Repair Kit will immediately restore 1000 HP for your tank, as well as reduce any burning and freezing effects. After that, the Repair Kit will continue to restore an additional 3000 HP over 3 secs. However, this recovery-over-time will be interrupted if your tank suffers any damage whatsoever. Additionally, once your tank’s HP have been fully restored, the Repair Kit will stop trying to repair it.

The other supplies will also be undergoing changes to their active and cooldown durations. These changes are intended to balance out the effect of having Overdrive in the game, and will be based on the settings we tested during Tanki’s 8th birthday celebrations. You can check out the details in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=360073]official Patch Notes[/url].

[h1]New Sound Effects and Interface for Supplies Panel[/h1]

From tomorrow, the supplies panel will be sporting a redesigned look, and supplies will have brand new sound effects.

With this new interface, whenever any of your supplies have reloaded after a cooldown, you will be notified with a very prominent visual cue.

Also, every time you activate a supply, you will hear a sound effect. However, you won’t be the only one hearing it — players around you will ALSO hear it. Obviously, you’ll also be able to hear when other players activate their supplies, which means you’ll be able to use this as a strategic element.

Additionally, when your supply runs out, you’ll also be notified with a sound effect. However, this sound effect will only be audible to you, and not to other players.

The idea behind these sound effects, is to give you an auditory signal that will allow you to monitor your use of supplies, without having to look at the supplies bar all the time.

So, log in early tomorrow and start having fun with Overdrive, the new supplies interface, and all the other features that will be implemented in this update.

Of course, don’t forget to check out the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=360073]official Patch Notes[/url], and tell us what you think of this update in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=360075]forum[/url].

notes.title: The first animated paint in Tanki Online!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/new_animated_paint_flow_news_forum.jpg]

Tankers!

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve just released the very first animated paint in Tanki Online. The paint is called «Flow» due to the wavelike, swaying effect of its textures.

To celebrate this exciting new release, we’re running a special event all weekend, starting from 02:00 UTC on July 8th, till 02:00 UTC on July 10th. Here’s what you can expect during those 48 hours.

[h1]Special Animated Paint Bundle in the Shop[/h1]

Besides being heavily discounted, this bundle includes the very first ANIMATED Tanki Online paint, which will make you the envy of every tanker in the arena (yes, this will also make them want to kill you more, but hey, that’s the price for being cooler than anyone else).

This special bundle will include the following:

[list]
 	[*]The very first animated paint in Tanki Online[/*]
 	[*]5 Gold Boxes[/*]
 	[*]5 Days of Premium[/*]
 	[*]500 of each supply[/*]
 	[*]150 000 crystals[/*]
[/list]
 
[h1]Discounts[/h1]

Of course, any good celebration calls for discounts, and we’re not going to disappoint you. Whether you like buying from our Shop, or from your Garage with your hard-earned crystals, we’ve got a discount to make you happy this weekend.

The full list with discounts and dates is on the forum.

So, have a great time playing Tanki Online this weekend and keep an eye out for fellow tankers wearing the new «Flow» animated paint — the very first of its kind in Tanki Online!

notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/new_animated_paint_flow_news_forum.jpg]

Tankers!

We’re thrilled to announce that we’ve just released the very first animated paint in Tanki Online. The paint is called «Flow» due to the wavelike, swaying effect of its textures.

To celebrate this exciting new release, we’re running a special event all weekend, starting from 02:00 UTC on July 8th, till 02:00 UTC on July 10th. Here’s what you can expect during those 48 hours.

[h1]Special Animated Paint Bundle in the Shop[/h1]

Besides being heavily discounted, this bundle includes the very first ANIMATED Tanki Online paint, which will make you the envy of every tanker in the arena (yes, this will also make them want to kill you more, but hey, that’s the price for being cooler than anyone else).

This special bundle will include the following:

[list]
 	[*]The very first animated paint in Tanki Online[/*]
 	[*]5 Gold Boxes[/*]
 	[*]5 Days of Premium[/*]
 	[*]500 of each supply[/*]
 	[*]150 000 crystals[/*]
[/list]
 
[h1]Discounts[/h1]

Of course, any good celebration calls for discounts, and we’re not going to disappoint you. Whether you like buying from our Shop, or from your Garage with your hard-earned crystals, we’ve got a discount to make you happy this weekend.

The full list with discounts and dates is on the forum.

So, have a great time playing Tanki Online this weekend and keep an eye out for fellow tankers wearing the new «Flow» animated paint — the very first of its kind in Tanki Online!

By the way, don’t forget to visit the forum and tell us what you think of the new animated paint. Does it look cool? Would you like us to create more animated paints? Tell us in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=359888]official forum thread[/url].

notes.title: Patch Update #467 - Released 6th July 2017
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/work_in_progress.jpg]

Tankers!

Tomorrow’s server restart at 02:00 UTC brings the following changes to the game.

[b]Promo Codes[/b]

From tomorrow, you’ll be able to use promo codes to claim special rewards and prizes. You’ll be able to get these promo codes from representatives or partners of the game as part of official events.

Once you’ve received a promo code, you will be able to insert it in a special area in the Shop, and redeem your gift.

We’re planning on lots of cool ways to use these promo codes, so make sure you stay on the lookout!

[b]Other bug fixes and tweaks[/b]

We’ll also be implementing a few bug fixes connected to critical errors, as well as making a few tweaks to the system, which should allow us to roll out a couple of cool new features in the near future. But you’ll find out more about that at a later date.

In the meantime, don’t forget to check out all the changes that tomorrow’s restart will bring, and let us know your thoughts in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=359783]forum[/url]!

The official patch notes may be found [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=359782]here[/url].

notes.title: Premium, Golds, Dream Tanks and Steak Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/news_forum_vk_fb1.jpg]
 
Tankers!
 
It’s time for another weekend of crazy action in the Tanki Online battlefield, where you can blast your opponents to bits in return for juicy prizes (and steak… but more about that later), and enjoy 1.5X battlefunds (regular, non-PRO battles only)!
 
Take part in our weekend giveaway and you can get Gold Boxes, days of Premium, the «Steak» paint, and even enter into the chance to win one of three Dream Tanks consisting of your chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at your rank, all upgraded. And yes, XT items are included.
 
By the way, we’re also throwing in some cool sales to spice it up some more.
 
[h1]Giveaway Kill Tiers and Prizes[/h1]
 
The giveaway will be held over 48 hours, starting from 21:00 UTC on Friday 23rd June, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday 25th June.
 
Unlike in past giveaways, this time you have THE FULL 48 HOURS to make the quota.
 
As usual, the different kill tiers will give you different rewards.
 
[list]
    [*]Kill Tier 1: 400 - 899 kills - 3 Gold Boxes*[/*]
    [*]Kill Tier 2: 900 - 1999 kills - 5 Gold Boxes + 3 days of Premium*[/*]
    [*]Kill Tier 3: 2000+ kills - 10  Gold Boxes + 5 days of Premium + the Shop Paint «Steak» + chance to win one of three Dream Tanks*[/*]
[/list]
 
 
* Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest
 
[h1]Three players will win a Dream Tank[/h1]
 
Additionally, we’ll be randomly choosing three tankers who have made more than 2000 kills. These three lucky players will receive a Dream Tank (chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at their level, and fully upgraded). Of course, that includes XT items.
 
The nicknames of the lucky winners will be announced on Monday 26th. We’ll also be announcing the number of tankers who have hit each reward tier.
 
[h1]1.5X Increased Battlefunds[/h1]
 
During the whole weekend, from 02:00 UTC on Saturday, June 24th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday, June 26th, all regular, non-PRO battles will give you 1.5X battlefunds!
 
That means you’ll be getting lots more crystals for every battle you finish. And that’s a good thing, since we’re also having 48 hours of...
 
[h1]Discounts[/h1]
 
That’s right! For 48 hours, starting from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 24th June, we’ve got some cool Garage and Shop discounts for you. You can check out the details [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=359196]here[/url].
 
So, get ready to poke some holes into the hulls of your enemies this weekend. Gold Boxes, Dream Tanks, Premium Accounts and juicy Steaks await!
 
[h1]Terms and Conditions[/h1]
 
[list]
    [*]The 1.5X funds are available in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list. PRO Battles will NOT give increased funds.[/*]
    [*]The 1.5X funds will start at 02:00 UTC on Saturday, June 24th, and end at 02:00 UTC on Monday, June 26th.[/*]
    [*]Discounts will start at 02:00 UTC on Saturday, June 24th, and end at 02:00 UTC on Monday, June 26th.[/*]
    [*]The paint awarded for making 2000 kills is not exchangeable for other paints.[/*]
    [*]None of the prizes may be exchanged for crystals or other prizes.[/*]
    [*]Gold Boxes will only be awarded to players ranked Warrant Officer 1 or higher during the giveaway.[/*]
    [*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Gold Boxes throughout the giveaway. The same applies to Premium days.[/*]
    [*]The kills must be made in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list. Kills in PRO Battles will NOT count.[/*]
    [*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC on Friday 23rd June, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday 25th June.[/*]
    [*]The randomly-picked winners will be given their chosen dream tank on Tuesday 27th June.[/*]
    [*]Tier prizes (Golds, Premium and Paints) will be handed out within 48 hours of the end of the giveaway.[/*]
    [*]Premium Account time will be activated as soon as it is added to players’ accounts.[/*]
    [*]The daily winners will be drawn randomly from the previous day’s qualifying players, using a random number generator.[/*]
    [*]All results will be announced on Monday 26th June.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: THE GAME - Registrations are OPEN!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/news_forum_vk_fb_vopros_EN.jpg]

Hey tankers!

Every year for Tanki’s Birthday, we organize THE GAME, our traditional quest where everyone with the rank of Sergeant and higher can win rare paints, fully upgraded equipment, and also a “Dream tank”*

The quest will be held from the 5rd to the 9th of June.

For those of you who don’t know what it is, THE GAME is a great event with riddles and puzzles spread over 5 days. Every day at 9:00am UTC, we’ll be posting a special video with the first step of the day. Your task is to navigate through all the puzzles and find the keyword of the day.

To take part, you need to register at the special GAME [url=http://game.tankionline.com/en/]website[/url]. Only players with a rank of Sergeant or higher, and with an email address linked to their account, can participate.

[list]
	[*]Attention! Registration on "THE GAME" website does NOT require your account password. Instead, the website will send a unique code to your email address. This will allow you to register and login on the website (make sure you check your SPAM folder just in case).[/*]
[/list]

As you progress through the quest, you will earn special points that will affect the size of your prize. Every participant will only have one chance per day to enter the keyword.

The first participant to enter the correct keyword will receive 100 points, the second will receive 99, the third will receive 98 and so on. The 90th competitor and the ones after him, will all get 10 points each. If you entered the wrong keyword the first time, you will have a second opportunity to enter it on the fifth (last) day of THE GAME. However, you will only get 5 points for that.

The personal score of each competitor will be announced immediately after entering all 5 keywords.

[b]Prizes[/b]
[list]
	[*]The player with the maximum number of points, will receive 1000 units of each supply**, 100 Gold Boxes, any paint from the Shop and a Dream Tank*[/*]
	[*]Players who place 2nd to 10th will receive 500 units of each supply**, 20 Gold Boxes, any paint from the Shop, and any alteration of the winner’s choice.[/*]
	[*]Players who place 11th to 100th will get 100 units of each supply** and 10 Gold Boxes[/*]
	[*]Players who don’t make it to the TOP-100, but have 30 points or more, will get 20 units of each supply**.[/*]
	[*]Players who score exactly 25 points will receive 10 of each supply**.[/*]
	[*]Players who do not guess all five keywords will not receive any prizes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Calendar[/b]
[list]
	[*]2nd June, 15:00 UTC — Registrations for THE GAME open on the [url=http://game.tankionline.com/]special website[/url].[/*]
	[*]5th June, 9:00 UTC — THE GAME starts[/*]
	[*]8th June, 19:00 UTC — Registrations close[/*]
	[*]9th June, 9:00 UTC — The fifth (last) day of "THE GAME"[/*]
	[*]9th June, 19:00 UTC — Keyword submissions close.[/*]
	[*]13th June, during the day — Winners are announced and rewarded.[/*]
[/list]

Any questions or discussions about "THE GAME" can be conducted on the following forum topic.

Good luck, tankers!

* The “Dream Tank” consists of the player’s preferred turret, hull and module, fully upgraded, available at the player's rank. The choice may also include XT equipment.
** excluding gold boxes

notes.title: Let’s celebrate Tanki’s 8th birthday!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/news_forum_vk_fb.jpg]

Tankers!

Tanki’s 8th Birthday celebrations are at the doorstep, so between 02:00 UTC on June 2nd, and 02:00 UTC on June 7th, we’ve got a ton of cool stuff coming!

We’ll be having 20% to 50% discounts on most items including garage equipment, MUs & SUs, Paints, Supplies, Gifts and Shop items. Whatever’s on your wishlist, there’s a good chance you’re gonna get a good deal on it!

Of course, we’ll also have themed decorations including billboards, parachutes, flags, Gold Box skins and drop zones, garage decorations, special holiday paints, and also special daily missions (regular, non-PRO battles only) with bigger rewards.

More importantly, Gold Boxes will be dropping twice as often!

If you’re looking for a super sweet Shop deal, there will be two special holiday bundles in the Shop, both of which will contain Premium Account time, Gold Boxes, Supplies and Crystals. One of them will even contain a cool Premium paint.

Additionally, for the duration of the festivities, we’ll be bringing back the ZERO Supply mode we tested some time ago, along with a few tweaks and changes to make it better.

ATTENTION: Make sure you log into the game on Tanki’s Birthday on June 4th for an extra special reward that includes 24 hours of Premium account, 2922 crystals and 8 of each supply (excluding Gold Boxes)!

For the full details on discounts, timeframes, ZERO Supply mode, as well as terms and conditions, check out the full announcement on the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=358067]forum[/url]!

notes.title: Bonus & Discount Cards are in the game!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/work_in_progress.jpg]

Tankers!

If you’ve been watching the V-LOG, you’ll know that we’ve been working on a new set of bonus and discount cards that will give you special deals in the Shop.

Great news! These new bonus and discount cards will be launched in the game with today’s server restart at 11:00 UTC!

There will be 8 discount cards in all.

[b]Discount Cards[/b]

[list]
	[*]Kits Discount Card[/*]
	[*]Paints Discount Card[/*]
	[*]Gold Boxes Discount Card[/*]
	[*]Premium Account Discount Card[/*]
	[*]Crystals Discount Card[/*]
[/list]

[b]Bonus Cards[/b]

[list]
	[*]Gold Boxes Bonus Card[/*]
	[*]Premium Account Bonus Card[/*]
	[*]Crystals Bonus Card[/*]
[/list]

[b]How they will work[/b]

Discount cards will make a bundle cheaper, whereas bonus cards will give you more of the item you’re buying, but for the same price.

If the item you’re buying is already discounted, and you have a discount card for that same item, the system will automatically pick the better discount. However, if you’re buying an item at a discount, and you happen to have a bonus card for that same item, both the discount AND the bonus will be applied, giving you a great deal.

Discounts and bonuses will vary between cards. For example, the discount card for paints, cuts the price by 50%! And the bonus for the crystal card, is still double.

The mechanism by which cards will be handed out to players, is the same as for Double Crystal Card (which has now been renamed to Bonus Crystal Card).

So, make sure you log into the game later today and check your account to see whether any of these new cards have landed in your Shop.

For details on the release, please see the official [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=357828]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Sales on Shop paints, servers merged, new paints, and more
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/news_forum_vk_fb.jpg]

Tankers!

Tomorrow’s server restart at 02:00 UTC, brings with it several bug fixes and an interesting change in the way servers are organized. Additionally, we’ll be having sales on Shop paints for three full days, and releasing nine brand new paints to choose from for your tank!

[b]Servers Merging[/b]

With this patch update, we will be merging the Russian, English, German and Polish servers. The system will no longer force you to play exclusively with players from your same localization. Instead, you will be able to play with tankers from all language versions, which means that there will be even more battles on every server for you to play in.

This is the first important step towards the Matchmaking system.

[b]New Paints[/b]

The update also brings with it nine new paints to add to your tank’s colorful wardrobe.

If you’re curious about what these new paints are going to look like, we can tell you their names and leave the rest up to your imagination:

Glitch, Scandinavia, Barber Shop, Vanadium, Strawberry, Rust, Lunar Soil, Pajamas, and Steak.

[b]Sales on Shop paints[/b]

Additionally, if there are any of the current Shop paints that you’ve been wanting to add to your collection, we’re slashing their prices for three full days. Here’s how that’s going to work:

[b]Details[/b]
[list]
	[*]Discount: 50% off Shop paints[/*]
	[*]Duration: 24hrs[/*]
	[*]Starts: 02:00 UTC on Thursday 18th May[/*]
	[*]Ends: 02:00 UTC on Friday 19th May[/*]
[/list]
[list]
	[*]Discount: 40% off Shop paints[/*]
	[*]Duration: 24hrs[/*]
	[*]Starts: 02:00 UTC on Friday 19th May[/*]
	[*]Ends: 02:00 UTC on Saturday 20th May[/*]
[/list]
[list]
	[*]Discount: 30% off Shop paints[/*]
	[*]Duration: 24hrs[/*]
	[*]Starts: 02:00 UTC on Saturday 20th May[/*]
	[*]Ends: 02:00 UTC on Sunday 21st May[/*]
[/list]
[b]ATTENTION:[/b] The discounts are only valid on Shop paints, and do NOT include the nine new paints that will be introduced tomorrow.

So, log in tomorrow to check out all that the new update has brought to the game, and make sure you visit the Shop during the 3 days of discounts!

For more details about tomorrow’s release, please check the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=357366]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Premium, Golds, Liquid Metal, and Dream Tanks Giveaway
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/contest_EN.jpg]

Tankers!

This weekend, from 21:00 UTC on Friday 12th May, till 20:59 UTC on Sunday 14th May, we’re having another crazy weekend giveaway where you can get Gold Boxes, days of Premium, the Liquid Metal paint, and even enter into the chance to win one of two dream tanks consisting of your chosen Turret, Hull and Protection Module available at your rank, all upgraded. And yes, XT items are included.

Here’s how that will work.

The giveaway will be held over two days:

Day 1 — 21:00 UTC on Friday 12th May till 20:59 UTC on Saturday 13th May
Day 2 — 21:00 UTC on Saturday 13th May till 20:59 UTC on Sunday 14th May

Just like in past giveaways, you’ll need to make a quota of kills on either one of those days. Different kill tiers will give you different rewards.
[list]
	[*]Kill Tier 1: 250+ kills - 3 Gold Boxes*[/*]
	[*]Kill Tier 2: 500+ kills - 4 Gold Boxes*[/*]
	[*]Kill Tier 3: 700+ kills - 5  Gold Boxes + 1 day of Premium*[/*]
	[*]Kill Tier 4: 1000+ kills - 7 Gold Boxes + 3 day of Premium*[/*]
	[*]Kill Tier 5: 1200+ kills - 10 Gold Boxes + 3 day of Premium + Paint Liquid Metal*[/*]
[/list]
* Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest.

Additionally, we’ll be randomly choosing two tankers, one from Saturday and one from Sunday, who made more than 700 kills. These two lucky players will receive a dream tank (chosen turret, hull and protection module available at their level, and fully upgraded). Of course, that includes XT items.

The nicknames of the lucky winners will be announced on Monday 15th. We’ll also be announcing the number of tankers who have hit each reward tier.

So, get ready for a weekend of frantic action, and cool prizes! And remember to tell us what you think in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=357135]forum[/url].

[b]Terms and Conditions[/b] - READ CAREFULLY
[list]
	[*]The paint awarded for making 1200 kills is not exchangeable for other paints.[/*]
	[*]None of the prizes may be exchanged for crystals.[/*]
	[*]Gold Boxes will only be awarded to players ranked Warrant Officer 1 or higher during the giveaway.[/*]
	[*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Gold Boxes throughout the giveaway. The same applies to Premium days.[/*]
	[*]You can only receive the reward for each tier once during the 2 days. Hitting the same tier on multiple days will not bring you additional tier rewards BUT will increase your chances of winning a dream tank if you’re making more than 700 kills.[/*]
	[*]The kills must be made in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list. Kills in PRO Battles will NOT count.[/*]
	[*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC till 20:59 UTC the next day.[/*]
	[*]The randomly-picked winners will be given their chosen dream tank on Tuesday 16th May.[/*]
	[*]Tier prizes (Golds, Premium and Paints) will be handed out within 48 hours of the end of the giveaway.[/*]
	[*]The daily winners will be drawn randomly from the previous day’s qualifying players, using a random number generator.[/*]
	[*]The player who is picked in the first day of the giveaway, will be not be eligible to be picked again for the second day of the event.[/*]
	[*]All results will be announced on Monday 15th May.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: May Holidays, Sales and Goodies Coming!
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/news_forum_vk_fb_EN.jpg]

Tankers!

The change of weather brings with it one of the most highly-anticipated festivities in Tanki Online — the May Holidays. And this year, we’re treating you to 11 days of discounts, themed decorations and goodies, increased Battlefunds, special missions, and something EXTRA special — a cool new feature to spice up your battles (more on that later in the announcement).

Here’s that you’ll be enjoying from 02:00 UTC on April 29th, till 02:00 UTC on May 10th.

[b]Discounts[/b]

First of all, in-game gifts, garage paints, and garage supplies will be at 30% off throughout the celebrations.

Additionally, we’re kicking off AND ending our celebrations with 30% off Micro-Upgrades and Speed-Ups for 24 hours. We’ve split these up so that even if you don’t want to use Speed-Ups, you can still get at least two Micro-Upgrade slots on the cheap.

Of course, we also have 30% discounts on Shop items, Hulls, Modules, Turrets and Alterations for 24 hours on separate days. As always, discounts do not apply to Premium, XT Turrets, XT Hulls, XT MUs, Clan Licenses, Garage Supplies Kits, and the Holiday Bundle.

To make sure you don’t miss any of the sales, please check out the complete calendar of discounts at the end of this announcement.

[b]Increased Battle Funds[/b]

Starting from 02:00 UTC on May 1st, we’ll be having increased Battlefunds in the game as follows:

[list]
	[*]1.25X Battle Funds for 72hrs, from 02:00 UTC on May 01 till 02:00 UTC on May 04[/*]

notes.title: Patch Update 456
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/news_forum_vk_fb.jpg]

Tankers!

This morning’s server restart at 02:00 UTC brought lots of cool and interesting changes to the game.

To start off, we’ve made a number of balance changes for turrets and alterations. We won’t go into the details here, but you can find out all about the changes and why they happened in this special video by Lead Game Designer Semyon Strizhak aka Hazel-Rah.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=64ytcUzm6dA

P.S. Make sure you turn on subtitles.

Additionally, we have some great news for Premium users, who will now be receiving a daily bonus of 2500 crystals, 3 Repair kits, and 10 of each of the other supplies (with the exception of gold boxes). This bonus is constant and is not connected to rank. Of course, to get the maximum benefit out of your Daily Bonus, you will need to log in and claim it every day.

The update also brings a new type of Daily Mission where you have to earn crystals in battle. Some missions will require you to do so in a specific game mode such as CTF, while others will allow you to do so in whichever mode you wish.

Additionally, following your feedback, the Communicator Panel now remembers the last tab you were using, so you no longer have to switch from News to Chat every time. Of course, we still don’t want you to miss any important news, so if any new alerts come up while you’re away, the Communicator Panel will automatically show you the News window next time you log in.

NOTE: The News panel will automatically be displayed as long as there are unread alerts. To mark an alert as «read», simply click on it.

And finally, among the smaller changes, we’ve got a newly designed flag for CTF and a bunch of small fixes. As always, you can find the full details in the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=356028]Patch Notes[/url].

So, don’t forget to check out the changes in the game, and tell us what you think in the forum!

notes.title: Golds, Modules and Equipment Giveaway plus X2 Funds
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/news_forum_vk_fb2.jpg]

[h1]Winners[/h1]
 
[b]Day 1 winners[/b]
 
Day 1 of our giveaway is over. The complete list of players who made the kill tiers, can be found [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1N6EOS4XtgfilJwg_1qF9d9ycxGSclPMrg7PaARZYrJA/edit#gid=399550011]here[/url].

Stats:
[LIST]
[*]Kill Tier 1 (players who made 250 kills and receive 3 Gold Boxes*): 1237[/*]
[*]Kill Tier 2 (players who made 700 kills and receive 5 Gold Boxes*): 1370[/*]
[*]Kill Tier 3 (players who made 1200 kills and receive 10 Gold Boxes + any protection module of your choice*): 14584[/*]
[/LIST]
Additionally, we’ve randomly picked a tanker from those who made more than 700 kills. This player will receive his/her chosen turret, hull or protection module available at his/her level, and fully upgraded*.
 
*See terms and conditions about prizes.

The lucky winner is [member=TIEPBOE_CJIOBO].

You can see the results of the random number generator in the spoiler below:
 
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Day-1.png]

Well done everyone!

=============================

[b]UPDATE[/b]

Hi all,

By mistake, instead of picking a random winners for players who made 700+ kills, we picked the winner from players who made 1200+ kills. To remedy this, we've picked a second winner. This means that TWO players will get their equipment of choice from Day 1, instead of just ONE player.

Sorry for the inconvenience.

Congratulations to [b]vitos1lol[/b] for winning the second prize.

The screenshot from the random number generator can be seen in the spoiler below.

[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Day-1-Winner-2.png]

=============================

[h1]Original Announcement[/h1]

Tankers!

Scrap all your plans for this weekend, because you’re in for a fun couple of days in Tanki Online.

First of all, from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 15th, till 02:00 UTC on Monday 17th, all non-PRO battles will give you DOUBLE BATTLE FUNDS. That’s twice as many crystals for every battle you finish.

If that’s not enough to get you excited about blowing your enemies to bits, we’ve got more! Your kills can get you Gold Boxes and Protection Modules, as well as a chance to win your preferred piece of equipment.

Here’s how that will work.

The giveaway will be held over two days:

Day 1 — 21:00 UTC on Friday 14th April till 20:59 UTC on Saturday 15th April

Day 2 — 21:00 UTC on Saturday 15th April till 20:59 UTC on Sunday 16th April

Just like the Striker and Magnum giveaways, you’ll need to make a quota of kills on either one of those days. Different kill tiers will give you different rewards.

[list]
    [*]Kill Tier 1: 250 kills - 3 Gold Boxes*[/*]
    [*]Kill Tier 2: 700 kills - 5 Gold Boxes*[/*]
    [*]Kill Tier 3: 1200 kills - 10 Gold Boxes + any protection module of your choice (available for purchase)[/*]
[/list]

* Please make sure you read the terms and conditions as they contain very important information about the contest

Additionally, we’ll be randomly choosing two tankers, one from Saturday and one from Sunday, who made more than 700 kills. These two lucky players will receive their chosen turret, hull or protection module available at their level, and fully upgraded. And yes, that includes XT items.

The nicknames of the lucky winners will be announced daily. We’ll also be announcing the number of tankers who have hit each reward tier.

So, make sure you log in early tomorrow and get ready for a weekend of frantic action, big funds, and cool prizes!

[b]Terms and Conditions[/b]

[list]
    [*]Protection Modules awarded for 1200 kills will be non-upgraded stock versions from the selection of modules available for purchase in the garage.[/*]
    [*]None of the prizes may be exchanged for crystals[/*]
    [*]Gold Boxes will only be awarded to players ranked Warrant Officer 1 or higher during the giveaway.[/*]
    [*]The rewards for each tier do not add up. Therefore, players will be able to get a maximum of 10 Gold Boxes throughout the giveaway.[/*]
    [*]You can only receive the reward for each tier once during the 2 days. Hitting the same tier on multiple days will not bring you additional tier rewards BUT will increase your chances of being chosen and receiving your chosen piece of equipment if you’re making more than 700 kills.[/*]
    [*]The kills must be made in regular, non-PRO battles joined by pressing the «Battle» button, or in non-PRO battles picked from the battle list. Kills in PRO Battles will NOT count.[/*]
    [*]Kills will be counted from 21:00 UTC till 20:59 UTC the next day.[/*]
    [*]The randomly-picked winners will be given their chosen equipment on the next day.[/*]

notes.title: New Communicator Panel
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/work_in_progress.jpg]

Tankers!

Tomorrow’s server restart at 02:00 UTC, brings a cool new feature that we’ve been wanting to implement for some time — the «Communicator» panel.

This panel will allow you to switch between News, Chat, and Clan chat, giving you an easy and centralized way to access all three features. More importantly, the News section will allow you to view all current and past in-game alerts. This means that there’s no longer the risk of accidentally closing an important in-game alert, such as an announcement about sales. Now, you’ll be able to go to the News section and look it up there.

So, don’t forget to log into the game tomorrow after 02:00 UTC to check out the new «Communicator» panel. And make sure you let us know what you think in our forums!

For full details on the update, please check out the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=355533]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: «Space» mode will stay in the game
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/news_forum_vk_fb1.jpg]

Tankers! 
 
Are you having a good time with the new «Space» low gravity map mode we implemented especially for Cosmonautics Day? 
 
If you are, then we've got some great news for you. «Space» mode is going to remain in the game, even after the Cosmonautics Day celebrations end!
 
You might remember that the Moon Silence map, which featured low gravity, had been removed a few years ago because of all the cheating that use to happen on it. However, we’ve just updated our anti-cheat system, which means we can now bring this feature back into the game.
 
Additionally, «Space» mode can only be activated in PRO-battles, so even if cheaters manage to find loopholes in the system, the consequences won’t be as serious as before, and you will be able to avoid them by staying out of such battles.

So, keep having fun with the new «Space» map mode, and if you manage to come up with something crazy, don’t forget to make a video and share it!

notes.title: Cosmonautics Day Sales and In-Game Goodies
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/news_forum_vk_fb1.jpg]

Tankers!

Today, the world celebrates Cosmonautics Day to commemorate the first manned space flight in the history of humanity.

We’d like to invite you to celebrate this event with us in Tanki Online, so starting from today, April 12th, at 02:00 UTC, for 24 hours, we’ve prepared some cool stuff for you. Here’s what’s coming your way:

[b]Very Special Maps & Daily Missions[/b]

If you’ve been around long enough, you might remember the Moon Silence map that was removed a few years ago. This map was a huge favorite because it featured reduced gravity, which made it a ton of fun to play.

The great news is that for the durations of these celebrations, [b]we’ll be bringing back the Moon Silence map[/b].

Additionally, in PRO Battles, you will be able to activate “Moon Silence mode” for any map. This mode will change the gravity of your chosen map, as well as add some really cool features.

Additionally, as per our tradition, we’ll be having a number of extra challenging Daily Missions with special rewards.

[b]NOTE[/b]: We’ll also be making an important change to the Madness map. From today, the bottom floor of this map will be [b]permanently[/b] removed to avoid long and boring falls. This was done with with the approval of the map’s original designers.

[b]Double Battle Funds[/b]

To make this celebration extra special, we’re also having 24 hours of Double Battle Funds. This means that you’ll be getting double the amount of crystals for every battle that you finish!

[b]NOTE[/b]: Double Battle Funds will be available in both standard and PRO battles, so get ready to rake in some serious crystals!

[b]Sales[/b]

We’ll be having a 25% discount on all micro-upgrades and speed-ups (not applicable to XT items) for 24 hours. More importantly, if you’ve seen the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=355354]recent announcement[/url], you’ll know that from today, M3 upgrades and speed-up prices will go down by 50%. The great news is that the 25% discount will apply to the new prices, so you’re getting a discount on top of a discount!

[b]Themed Decorations and Gifts[/b]

And of course, to get you into the mood for space travel, there will also be a free holiday paint (also available to purchase if you wish to keep it forever), as well as themed billboards, parachutes, flags, and gold box skin and drop zone. Plus, we’ve also prepared special themed gifts to share with your friends.

So, make sure that today you take full advantage of the Double Battle Funds, enjoy all the decorations and special low-gravity maps, and check out the discounted prices for upgrades and speed-ups.

Remember, the celebration ends at 02:00 UTC on Thursday 13th!

notes.title: Prices and time for M3 upgrades slashed by 50%
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/news_forum_vk_fb-1.jpg]

Tankers!

Over the past two weeks, we’ve been closely following the discussion about M3 equipment upgrades on our forums and chat. 

We’ve also had an in-depth look at our analytics, to assess the impact of pricing for M3 equipment on the game’s economy. We took into consideration crystal acquisition and spending trends in the game and how the two balance out.

Our observations have shown us that we are now in a position to make some significant changes to high level equipment upgrades. This was a very delicate decision to make, because while we want the game’s milestones to be achievable, we don’t want them to be too easy, nor too hard.

Therefore, we have decided to make some additional revisions to M3 equipment prices for upgrades and speed-ups, as well as upgrade time. Here’s what you can expect when you log into the game today:

All upgrade steps for M3 equipment will be 50% cheaper
All upgrade steps for M3 equipment will be completed in half the time
All speed-ups for M3 equipment will be 50% cheaper

To clarify, these are not one-off promotional settings. These are the new, revised prices and parameters for M3 equipment. If you’ve been wanting to push your tank up to M4, from today, you can do it twice as fast, and at half the price!

So, make sure you log into the game today and check out the new slashed prices on M3 upgrades and speed-ups. And don’t forget to share the awesome news with all your friends!

Don’t forget to tell us what you think on our [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=355354]forum[/url].

notes.title: Patch Update 453
notes.content:
[img=http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/work_in_progress.jpg]

Tankers!

The new update brings some interesting changes to the game.

To start off, the prices for Product Kits in the Shop have been decreased.

Next, we’ve made additional changes to the Daily Missions mechanism. Rewards for missions have increased by another 10% compared to the rewards before Patch Update #451, which was released on March 29th. The price for changing a Daily Mission has been increased proportionately. Additionally, the probability of getting crystals as a reward for a Daily Mission, has been decreased to 37%.

We’ve also made additionally changes to the rank limits for battle creation. The default rank bracket for Legends has been decreased to Fieldmarshal - Legend, and the bracket for Generalissimos has been decreased to Brigadier - Generalissimo. The brackets for other ranks have been slightly expanded.

For more detail about the update, please check out the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=354768]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Patch Update #451
notes.content:
[img]http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/news_forum_vk_fb-1.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

This week’s update comes a bit earlier and holds quite a few interesting features. Here’s what you can expect to see in the game after tomorrow’s (Wednesday 29th) server restart at 02:00 UTC:

[b]Upgrade steps for M2 and M3 reduced[/b]

Upgrades step for M2s will be reduced from 50 to 10, while those for M3s will be reduced from 50 to 20. As with M0s and M1s, this was done so that you can get a more significant change with every MU step. Additionally, as with the MUs on M0 and M1 modifications, the total price for upgrading your M2 will now be equal to buying the stock version of an M3.

Please note that these changes apply to all turrets, hulls and modules (module MU steps will remain the same but prices will work differently).

[b]Bigger rank brackets when creating battles[/b]

The rank brackets when creating battles will be increased. This means you’ll be able to create battles for a larger number of ranks.

[b]Daily Missions[/b]

Rewards for Daily Missions will be increased by 10%. However, after the update, Daily Mission objectives will only be achievable in non-PRO battles.

[b]Fixes for Magnum[/b]

As with any new feature, the first week with Magnum has uncovered a number of bugs. With this update, we’ll be squashing a number of them.

[b]Critical Errors disabled[/b]

Up until now, when the Tanki Online client received a “strange” instruction, it would spit out a Critical Error and throw you out of the game. With this update, we’ll be disabling the Critical Error.

Be advised that this will uncover a number of bugs in the game. However, this is intentional, and will help us discover more of the circumstances that trigger Critical Errors, so we can eliminate them.

Additionally, while the bugs will undoubtably be an annoyance, none of them are as bad as being thrown out of the game and losing your battle fund.

Of course, we’ll be working as quickly as possible to eliminate bugs as they come up. In the meantime, if you have any bugs to report, you may do so in [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=353759]this special thread[/url] on the forum.

For more details about this release, please check the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=353761]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.content:
[img]http://tankionline.com/en/wp-content/uploads/2016/02/news_forum_vk_fb-1.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

This week’s update comes a bit earlier and holds quite a few interesting features. Here’s what you can expect to see in the game after tomorrow’s (Wednesday 29th) server restart at 02:00 UTC:

[b]Upgrade steps for M2 and M3 reduced[/b]

Upgrades step for M2s will be reduced from 50 to 10, while those for M3s will be reduced from 50 to 20. As with M0s and M1s, this was done so that you can get a more significant change with every MU step. Additionally, as with the MUs on M0 and M1 modifications, the total price for upgrading your M2 will now be equal to buying the stock version of an M3.

Please note that these changes apply to all turrets, hulls and modules (module MU steps will remain the same but prices will work differently).

[b]Bigger rank brackets when creating battles[/b]

The rank brackets when creating battles will be increased. This means you’ll be able to create battles for a larger number of ranks.

[b]Daily Missions[/b]

Rewards for Daily Missions will be increased by 10%. However, after the update, Daily Mission objectives will only be achievable in non-PRO battles.

[b]Fixes for Magnum[/b]

As with any new feature, the first week with Magnum has uncovered a number of bugs. With this update, we’ll be squashing a number of them.

[b]Critical Errors disabled[/b]

Up until now, when the Tanki Online client received a “strange” instruction, it would spit out a Critical Error and throw you out of the game. With this update, we’ll be disabling the Critical Error.

Be advised that this will uncover a number of bugs in the game. However, this is intentional, and will help us discover more of the circumstances that trigger Critical Errors, so we can eliminate them.

Additionally, while the bugs will undoubtably be an annoyance, none of them are as bad as being thrown out of the game and losing your battle fund.

Of course, we’ll be working as quickly as possible to eliminate bugs as they come up. In the meantime, if you have any bugs to report, you may do so in [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=353759]this special thread[/url] on the forum.

For more details about this release, please check the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=353761]Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Magnum Turret Released + Giveaway!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/7787c930fca3791880d4ebab7177b3096c322d95.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

You’ve been waiting for it for a while, but now it’s just moments away. The new artillery turret codenamed «Magnum» will be officially released in the game tomorrow.

Magnum boasts out-of-control damage, and a range that will allow you to nail down and blast to bits every single one of your cowardly enemies, even if they’re hiding behind a building on the other side of a huge map.

There’s no escaping Magnum.

Of course, with great power, comes a pretty tough learning curve. You’ll need to learn how to calculate shot angle and speed, using only the parameters from your previous shot as reference. Additionally, the turret does not rotate horizontally, so you will need to use your hull to aim left and right.

But the hard times are worth enduring, because no other turret will give you a feeling of omnipotence like Magnum.

So make sure you check out the new Magnum artillery turret tomorrow, right after the server restart!

By the way. To celebrate Magnum’s release, we’re running a cool giveaway. For full details, check out the [url=http://tankionline.com/en/2017/03/contest-7-magnums-to-give-away-and-lots-of-prizes/]official announcement [b](now updated with daily winners)[/b][/url].

Also, please note that, instead of the regular restart at 02:00 UTC, we’ll be performing scheduled server maintenance, between 03:00 UTC and 05:00 UTC. We apologize for the inconvenience.

For full details on tomorrow’s release, please check out the [url=http://en.tankiforum.com/index.php?showtopic=353279] Patch Notes[/url].

notes.title: Patch Update #449 - Released 16th March 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/4ab5823f5e865fedd85a48abd054400f8c96108a.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

Today’s server restart has brought a significant amount of changes in the game. Here’s what you can expect to see when you log in.

[b]Changes in M0 equipment[/b] 

All M0 equipment have now become available from the rank or Recruit. Additionally, prices and parameters have been changed slightly.

Changes in M0, M1, M2 and M3 hulls and turrets
All M0, M1, M2 and M3 hulls and turrets have received an increasing in damage and protection. However, all M3+ equipment remains unchanged.

[b]Changes in micro-upgrade steps for all M1 hulls and turrets[/b]

Following the changes in micro-upgrade steps for M0 equipment, we’ve applied the same changes to all M1 turrets and hulls, decreasing the number of upgrade steps from 50 to 10.

As a result of these changes, the total price for fully micro-upgrading an M1 turret or hull has become half of what it used to be, and is now equal to the stock price of the M2 version. Speeding up a micro-upgrade step now costs twice the price of that step.

However, the aggregate value of steps and speed ups remains the same.

These changes apply only to M1 modifications of all hulls and turrets, and all existing and completed M1 micro-upgrades have been converted to the new system and rounded up.

For now, these changes will only apply M0 and M1 equipment. We still have not decided whether these changes will also be extended to M2 and M3 modifications.

[b]Rental of Alterations[/b]

Rental of Alterations is no longer for real money. Instead, you can rent Alterations for 24 hours for the price of 5000 crystals.

[b]Other changes[/b]

Bulk discounts for buying items of the same type have been removed, and discounts no longer apply to product kits. Additionally, bonus supplies have been removed from garage kits.

So, make sure you log into the game and check out the changes for yourself. Don’t forget to tell us what you think in the forum!

notes.title: Supplies experiment #2 this weekend
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/d86296e09f56ff0fd1d55141f32a53a9c2c09c26.jpg[/img]

Tankers!

In our continuous quest to find the right formula for the mechanics of supplies, we’ll be running another experiment this weekend. As we’ve already explained, test servers are too small to give accurate data for these experiments, which is why we’ll be running this experiment on the live servers.

The experimental settings will be in the game from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 11th March, till 02:00 UTC on Monday 13th March.

Below, you can see how the parameters will be changed:

[b] NOTE: These modified parameters will only apply to regular battles, not PRO Battles.[/b] 

[b] Repair Kit [/b] 
Duration: Unchanged
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Smart Cooldowns: Reduced by 50%

[b] Double Armor[/b] 
Duration: 30 seconds
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Smart Cooldowns: Reduced by 50%

[b] Double Damage[/b] 
Duration: 30 seconds
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Smart Cooldowns: Reduced by 50%

[b] Speed Boost[/b] 
Duration: 30 seconds
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Smart Cooldowns: Reduced by 50%

[b] Mine[/b] 
Damage: Unchanged
Cooldown: 45 seconds
Smart Cooldowns: Reduced by 50%

[b] Cooldown changes[/b] 
Cooldown doesn't end automatically after respawn

[b] When entering a battle[/b] 
All supplies will be on cooldown
All reload times have been reduced by two thirds

Remember, these settings are experimental and will only be on the live server from 02:00 UTC on Saturday 11th March, till 02:00 UTC on Monday 13th March. Once the experiment is over, we will take into consideration the data, as well as your feedback, and decide on the next step.

On Wednesday, March 8th, the whole world will be celebrating Women’s Day. And while you may think Tanki Online is a “boy’s game”, you’ll be surprised how many times a girl might have been behind that Shaft bullet that saved your backside.

For this reason, we want to thank our female Tanki players with some well-deserved celebrations. Here’s what you can expect for 24 hours, from 02:00 UTC on March 8th till 02:00 UTC on March 9th:

Themed decorations

Throughout the festivities, we’ll be having themed billboards, parachutes, flags, gold box skin and gold box drop zone, plus a new set of gifts.

We’ll also have a free holiday paint that you can also buy for crystals if you’d like to keep it forever. Additionally there will be a Premium paint available for purchase exclusively as part of the exclusive Holiday Bundle (see details further down).

 
Double frequency box drops

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/1a499f0609a58fe2129a1088e50528ed04a6e84f.jpg[/img]

Hello Tankers!

In this episode of the V-LOG, we’ll be reviewing last week’s live-stream. We’ll also be discussing a new supplies experiment, and critical errors in the game.

Check out episode 126  [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dq6y-R8fHKI] right now[/url]!

notes.title: Tanki Online is on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27519363/6bc1a1af240665ef6688fea700cfc430a245b631.png[/img]

Tankers!

We’re pleased to announce that the tank action MMO Tanki Online is now available on Steam.

In Tanki Online, you can mix and match a variety of futuristic turrets, hulls, protection modules and paints, to customize your battle tank and face off against real players in DeathMatch, Capture the Flag, and other exciting game modes.

Tanki Online also features alterations for your favorite turret to further tweak it to fit your gameplay, and loads of battle arenas where you can rip enemy tanks to shreds.

We hope you have a great time in Tanki Online. Remember, if you have any questions, you can ask them in the Discussions section for Tanki Online.
